BattleFrontier_BattleArenaLobby_Text_Exp:
The Set KO Tourney has special rules,
unlike standard battles.

First, one battle lasts only
three turns.

If the outcome is not decided after
three turns, it goes to judging.

The REFEREE will choose the winner
based on how the POKéMON battled.

Also, a POKéMON cannot be switched out
until its battle's outcome is decided.

The third judging factor is “Body.”
This factor is based on how much HP
remained at the end of a battle.

The rating takes into account how much
HP a POKéMON had at the start of
battle, and what remained at the end.

In the BATTLE ARENA, we undertake
the Set KO Tourney.

All participants enter with a team of
three POKéMON.

The three POKéMON must be lined up in
the order in which they are to appear.

During battle, the POKéMON will appear
one at a time in the preset order.

Once a POKéMON enters battle, it must
remain out until the match is decided.

If a match remains undecided in
three turns, it goes to judging.

If you wish to interrupt your challenge,
please save the game.

If you don't save, you will not be able
to continue with your challenge.

If you pull off the feat of beating
seven TRAINERS in succession,
we will present you with Battle Points.

The first judging factor is “Mind.”
This factor evaluates how aggressive
the battlers were.

The judging is based on how often
the TRAINERS ordered the use of
offensive moves.

The second judging factor is “Skill.”
This factor evaluates how effectively
POKéMON moves were used.

If a move worked successfully,
the Skill rating goes up.

If a move failed, the Skill rating
is lowered.

If it was an offensive move, the Skill
rating goes up if the move was “super
effective” and goes down if it was
“not very effective.”

The Skill rating will not go up for
moves such as PROTECT and DETECT.

If the opponent used PROTECT or
DETECT, and your POKéMON failed to
hit with a move, its Skill rating will not
go down.

BattleFrontier_BattleDomeLobby_Text_Expl:
If battling POKéMON faint at the same
time--a double KO--in a tournament
match, the REFEREES will review
the match and declare the winner.

The DOUBLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--
a tournament of DOUBLE BATTLES.

All participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.

In each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.

The remaining two POKéMON must take
part in a DOUBLE BATTLE.

Choose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.

You win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.

Battle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.

If you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.

If you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

The tournament matchups are drawn up
based on the toughness of POKéMON
held by TRAINERS.

The matchups avoid having tough
TRAINERS face each other right away.

The SINGLE BATTLE Tournament
is exactly as the name suggests--
a tournament of SINGLE BATTLES.

All participating TRAINERS must
enter three POKéMON each.

In each battle, one of the three
POKéMON must be held in reserve.

The other two POKéMON can battle
one at a time.

Choose the two battling POKéMON after
examining the opponent's trio.

You win the tournament by defeating
four TRAINERS.

Battle Points are awarded to
the tournament winner.

If you want to interrupt your
tournament, please save the game.

If you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

The tournament chart, or as we call it,
the “Tree,” is available for viewing

with people behave differently
depending on their nature.

There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.

used to prepare for enemy attacks or
used to heal HP and so on.

moves that may enfeeble the foes with
stat problems including poison and 
paralysis.

these three categories.

may prefer to attack no matter what.

itself from any harm.

confounding its foes.

be unable to live up to its potential.

Advance Game Link cable.

entering, you will be required to take
a certain number of POKéMON.

three POKéMON.

BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HelloChampHe:
I knew you could!
I knew you would!
We're both big winners!

I'll return your Battle Points and,
of course, a little extra from me!
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowAboutEnte:
I'll see to it that you benefit, too.
So how about it?
How about entering that event for me?
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_HowMuchCanYo:
Great, great!
So, how much can you spot me?
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_KnowWinnerWh:
Giggle!
I know a winner when I see one!
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NiceTryCantR:
I hate to break it to you, but I can't
return your Battle Points…

I guess we'll have to let it motivate
us to try harder next time!
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_NotIntereste:
Not interested?! You shouldn't be
so afraid to take a chance!
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ShouldBeTaki:
Those TRAINERS…
What are they doing?
They should be taking challenges.
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_SpotMeSomeBa:
All right, that's perfect.
So, uh… How about spotting me some
of your Battle Points?

Trust me, I'll show you my gratitude
afterward.
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThanksOffYou:
Heheh! Thanks much!
So, off you go!
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_ThinkOfMeFor:
If you're up for another challenge,
please do think of me!
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_TrainerGoodB:
He's good, but he gets rattled too
easily to survive the BATTLE DOME…
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouDontHaveE:
Oh, no, no, no!
You don't have enough Battle Points!

I wish you wouldn't monkey around and
waste everyone's time!
BattleFrontier_Lounge3_Text_YouLookTough:
…Huh?
You look to me like a tough TRAINER.

Heheh…
Listen, I have this proposition.

We have a little group going here,
and we play a little game with what
goes on in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

First, we pick one of the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

Then, we each pick a different TRAINER
who's taking that facility's challenge,
and bet with our Battle Points.

The guy who bet on the TRAINER with
the best record takes all the Battle
Points in the pool.
BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_IfIOpenedRes:
If I opened a restaurant here,
it'd make money for sure.
BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_NeedBreather:
I need to take a breather after
some intense battles…

But even now, I never take a break
from plotting strategy and combos.
BattleFrontier_Lounge4_Text_WonderIfInte:
I wonder if they'll be airing interviews
with tough TRAINERS today?
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlPlaysAtR:
That little girl plays at the red house
a lot!
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_GirlSayingSo:
I have this feeling that the little girl
is saying something profound.
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_LadyClaimsSh:
How charming!
That little lady claims she can
understand POKéMON!
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlAt:
This one says it likes to battle!
It will battle even if it has a lot
of ouchies!

This one says it likes to battle!
But if it gets enough ouchies,
it will worry about itself!

This one says it likes to battle!
But if it gets enough ouchies,
it will turn sneaky!
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlDe:
This one says it looks after itself!
But if it gets enough ouchies,
it will hit back!

This one says it looks after itself!
It says it worries about itself whether
or not it has a lot of ouchies!

This one says it looks after itself!
But if it gets enough ouchies,
it will turn sneaky!
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlEg:
That's silly! An EGG is asleep!
I can't talk to it!
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlGr:
Ehehe!
I can tell what POKéMON are thinking!

Please!
Can I see your POKéMON?
BattleFrontier_Lounge5_Text_NatureGirlSu:
This one says it likes to be sneaky!
But if it gets enough ouchies,
it will hit back!

This one says it likes to be sneaky!
But if it gets enough ouchies,
it will worry about itself!

This one says it likes to be sneaky!
It says it likes to be sneaky even
if it has a lot of ouchies!
BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_DontTradeFor:
Oh, I'm sorry!
I don't intend to trade for anything
but a {STR_VAR_1}.
BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_PromiseIllBe:
Oh, it's adorable!
Thank you!
I promise I'll be good to it!

Oh! I hope you'll be good to
my {STR_VAR_2}, too!
BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_SkittySoMuch:
Giggle!
A SKITTY is so much cuter than I had
imagined. I'm delighted!
BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WellThatsFin:
Oh, you won't?
Well, that's fine, too.
Please come visit us again.
BattleFrontier_Lounge6_Text_WouldYouLike:
My POKéMON is a {STR_VAR_2}.
Do you know it?
It's quite cute and rather nice.

This little one, I could trade with
pride!

Would you like to trade me a {STR_VAR_1}
for my {STR_VAR_2}?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_BodySlamDesc:
A full-body slam
that may cause
paralysis.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_CounterDesc:
Retaliates any
physical hit with
double the power.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DefenseCurlD:
Curls up to con-
ceal weak spots
and raise DEFENSE.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_DreamEaterDe:
Recovers half the
damage inflicted
on a sleeping foe.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_EndureDesc:
Endures any at-
tack for 1 turn,
leaving 1HP.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_FirePunchDes:
A fiery punch
that may burn
the foe.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_HaventGotEno:
What the…
You haven't got enough Battle Points!
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcePunchDesc:
An icy punch
that may
freeze the foe.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IcyWindDesc:
A chilling attack
that lowers the
foe's SPEED.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_IllTakeBattl:
Do you see how skilled I am now?
I'll take your Battle Points, thanks!
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LadiesWereSt:
When I was just a wee YOUNGSTER,
those ladies were strong and beautiful.
They were idols among us TRAINERS.

Even now, age hasn't dulled their
abilities.

In fact, their POKéMON moves have
grown even more polished.

But… For some reason, I can't help
but feel this…
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorInt:
You couldn't tell it from looking now,
but I used to be one tough TRAINER.

I had a reputation as the toughest
BEAUTY around, I tell you!

What is it now?
You don't believe me.

I'm not like that blowhard woman over
there. I'm actually talented!

Let me prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON special and
yet cute moves.

But my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach
with a wee bit of Battle Points?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_LeftTutorWel:
Are you back to learn special and
yet cute POKéMON moves?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaKickDesc:
An extremely
powerful kick with
intense force.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MegaPunchDes:
A strong punch
thrown with
incredible power.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MoveWillBeXB:
The move {STR_VAR_1}, is it?
That will be {STR_VAR_2} Battle Points, okay?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_MudSlapDesc:
Hurls mud in the
foe's face to re-
duce its accuracy.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_PsychUpDesc:
Copies the foe's
effect(s) and
gives to the user.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorIn:
I know it's hard to see now, but I used
to be one fantastic TRAINER.

I had a reputation as the most
invincible SWIMMER around, I tell you!

What's wrong?
You don't believe me.

I'm not like that buffoonish woman over
there. I'm actually experienced!

I can prove it to you.
I can teach your POKéMON hard and
yet pretty moves.

But my lessons don't come free.
How about paying for the moves I teach
with a wee bit of Battle Points?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RightTutorWe:
Have you come to learn hard and
yet pretty POKéMON moves?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_RockSlideDes:
Large boulders
are hurled. May
cause flinching.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SeismicTossD:
Inflicts damage
identical to the
user's level.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SnoreDesc:
A loud attack
that can be used
only while asleep.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SoftboiledDe:
Recovers up to
half the user's
maximum HP.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwiftDesc:
Sprays star-
shaped rays
that never miss.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_SwordsDanceD:
A fighting dance
that sharply
raises ATTACK.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachMoveToW:
Fine, fine, now pick the POKéMON
I should teach the move to.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_TeachWhichMo:
Fine, fine, look here!
Which move should I teach?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThinkLadiesD:
Those ladies, the way they bad-mouth
each other, you probably think that
they don't get along.

But if that were true, they wouldn't
stay out here together, would they?
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderPunch:
An electrified
punch that may
paralyze the foe.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_ThunderWaveD:
A weak jolt of
electricity that
paralyzes the foe.
BattleFrontier_Lounge7_Text_YouDontWantT:
What's that?
You don't want to…

If you want to see how skilled I am,
you come see me anytime!
BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_KnowAboutFro:
Do you know about the FRONTIER
BRAINS?

That's what SCOTT calls the seven
special TRAINERS that run the seven
facilities in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_ToldMeIHaveT:
At the BATTLE TOWER, an older girl
told me that I have a lot of talent
for battling!
But I'm no good at CONTESTS!

I guess having talent and liking
something aren't the same.
BattleFrontier_Lounge8_Text_WhatATrainer:
Knowledge…
Strategy…
Luck…
Guts…
Spirit…
Bravery…
And ability…

Well, I'm all set in every way!
I'll be unstoppable at every building!
BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ChaperonGrandso:
We came here to chaperon our
grandson.

But since we're here, we thought
we should get some souvenirs.
BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_FacilitiesDontA:
A lot of the BATTLE FRONTIER's
facilities don't allow the use of items
during battles.

That rule makes things tougher than
they already are!
BattleFrontier_Mart_Text_ProteinMakeNice:
Dear, what do you think of this?
Wouldn't this make a nice gift?

It's…PRO…TE…IN?
It sounds delicious, doesn't it?
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleAr:
This is the BATTLE ARENA!
Let the toughest teams gather!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePa:
This is the BATTLE PALACE!
Keep your eyes on POKéMON battles!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattlePy:
This is the BATTLE PYRAMID!
Advance through the Battle Quest!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BattleTo:
The BATTLE TOWER feels special.
It's different from the others.

This is the BATTLE TOWER!
Keep the win streak as the toughest
TRAINER!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BelieveI:
ZIGG!
I believe in you, little buddy!

I'll make my little ZIGG any favorite
tasty treats you like if you win!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_BetterTh:
I'm better than my daddy
at POKéMON.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_CanDoAny: With you by my side, I can do anything.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ConquerL:
My grand ambition is to conquer both
the BATTLE FRONTIER and the POKéMON
LEAGUE.
And if my dream comes true…

I… I'm going to ask MIMI next door
if she will be friends with me!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_DidScott:
Did SCOTT bring you here, too?
What is it with that guy?

It sounds like he really does know
how to spot talented TRAINERS, but…

I've never seen him battling in person
ever.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_EnoughBa:
Yes!
I've finally got enough Battle Points!

I guess I'll trade for another giant
plush DOLL!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Exchange:
BATTLE POINT EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER
Exchange your Battle Points!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_FastOnBi:
I'm fast on my BIKE, and that goes for
the way I battle, too.

I win matches in the blink of
an eye!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Frontier:
The BATTLE FRONTIER isn't exclusively
for tough TRAINERS.

Many people with special abilities
have been invited, it seems.

He may have built this place to serve
a bigger objective…
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GoRackUp:
Go on, my baby sweetie!
Go rack up some wins for Daddy!

You're just like your mother,
so you'll be dominating!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_GotWiped:
Man! Oh man!
I've never lost once before!

But I got wiped out with no saving
grace at all!

And then I'm told I don't have any
talent?! Man!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_HeardPre:
It wasn't easy getting here,
but I'd heard about this knockout
pretty girl at the BATTLE ARENA.

Instead of her, do you know what
I found?

A whole teeming mob of sweaty,
stinky, and primitive martial artists!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LegendOf:
Do you know it?
The legend of the BATTLE PYRAMID?

When there comes a confident TRAINER
reaching for the golden pinnacle,
there shall appear a man among men.

Don't know that legend?
Well, of course not!
I just made it up!

What's it supposed to mean?
That, my friend, I can't say!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_LikeToHa:
Oh, yeah, okay!
So this is the RANKING HALL!

I'd like to go down in history as
a super champ and have my name
recorded here for posterity.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OddTreeH:
Excuse me, young one.
Have you good eyesight?

There is an odd tree past here, and to
my tired eyes it seems to wiggle.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceAnOd:
Excuse me, young one.
Have you a good memory?

I have this feeling there once was
an odd tree past here.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_OnceBeat:
I may not look that impressive now,
but I once beat a GYM LEADER.

Who knows, maybe I should give it
another shot at glory.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PeopleCa:
People call me a busybody,
but I can't help it.

Your hat's on crooked!
Oh, no, trash on the ground!
Oops, it's almost dinnertime!

I don't know if I can stand to just
watch at the BATTLE PALACE…
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PowerOfO: Ooh, darling, you are so wonderful!
Ooh, I just can't wait anymore!

Let's go to a MULTI BATTLE ROOM
right this instant!

If we get together in the BATTLE SALON,
the power of our love will overcome
everyone we meet.

Why, before us, darling, everything
will topple like dominoes!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PutToget:
I didn't sleep for a week, but then
I put together the ultimate team!

I can't see myself losing, no joke.
We're storming the BATTLE ARENA!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_PyramidT:
The BATTLE PYRAMID's too harsh!
I just can't make it to the top!

Since I'm out of options, maybe I can
climb the outside…
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_RankingH:
BATTLE FRONTIER RANKING HALL
Set your sights on new records!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_Sometime:
I sometimes see this really important-
looking old man going in there.

He has these really awesome POKéMON.
He seems really nice, though.
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_StickyMo:
There was a sticky sort of a POKéMON
with a long tail up ahead!

It was hiding under a boulder, and
it kept staring at me!
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ThriveIn:
I thrive in darkness…
Yes… What is worthy of me?
None other than the BATTLE PYRAMID…

What say you to wandering in darkness
and in utter and total desperation?
BattleFrontier_OutsideEast_Text_ToughTra:
This guy ran into a horribly tough
TRAINER while he was on the BATTLE
TOWER challenge.

You need to be cautious if you ever
decide to go to the BATTLE TOWER.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleDo:
This is the BATTLE DOME!
Your path to the invincible superstar!

The BATTLE DOME
Become the Unbeatable Superstar!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattleFa:
This is the BATTLE FACTORY!
Seek out the toughest POKéMON!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BattlePi:
This is the BATTLE PIKE!
Choose one of three paths!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BestOutO:
I'm the best out of all my friends.
But here…
I've been useless!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_BigGuySa:
Uh…
I'm sure it'll be okay.

But remember that big scary guy?
He said, “I'll lend you POKéMON!”
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_CantFind:
I want to go to the BATTLE TOWER,
but I can't find it even though I have
a map of the BATTLE FRONTIER.
This place is just too big!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ChooseFi:
I believe I'm the only person here who,
for some unknown reason, would choose
fishing over battling.

Huh? You can't catch anything here?
That's disappointing…
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceI:
Oh, shush!
Keep that racket down!

You fair-weather fans should stick
to cheering for some GYM LEADER!

The DOME ACE is mine!
The only idol for me!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeAceL:
That only happened because
I happened to be sitting next to you!

The DOME ACE only looked our way
because my cheering was so loud!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_DomeIsHe:
Grandpa, over here!
The BATTLE DOME is here!
Go get 'em, Grandpa!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FansOver:
It's hard to believe, but they once
were TRAINERS, and good ones, too.

They used to be incredibly tough,
and they were famous, too.

But they were obliterated by this
certain TRAINER at a tournament.

They were so thoroughly whipped,
they became smitten by the TRAINER.

Now they're just fans of the TRAINER.
They go cheer for their idol at the
BATTLE DOME every day now.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_FinallyA:
I've finally arrived at the BATTLE
FRONTIER!

I'm sure to grab attention with
my looks and ability!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_GotSeasi:
I wanted to take a challenge as soon
as I arrived here.

But on the way, I got seasick…
Urrrrp…
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_KeepBatt:
Today, I'm going to keep battling, no
matter what, until I get a Symbol.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LastTime:
Huh? Will you listen to yourself?
That's nothing!

Why, the last time I cheered for him,
our eyes met and sparks flew!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LetsPlay:
Let's play rock, paper, scissors!
One, two, three!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LongDrea:
The BATTLE FRONTIER…
I've long dreamed about a place like it.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_LostIllP:
I guess I'm not very lucky today.
I'll put off my BATTLE PIKE challenge
until tomorrow.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MayISeeY:
Hello, are you here for the ferry?
May I see your TICKET?
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MetOlder:
A while back, I met this older girl
at the BATTLE PIKE.

She had these eyes that were scary
in a real ornery way.

She got all furious: “Will you quit
eating!” Then she whaled on me.

It was a hair-raising kind of
scary experience, sure enough.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MonWithL:
I heard a rumor that someone saw
a POKéMON with an unusually long tail
somewhere in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
It must be adorable. I'm sure of it…

Oh, challenges can wait. I feel driven
to find the delightful creature!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_MustHave:
You must have a TICKET to board
the ferry.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_NothingH:
There used to be nothing here not all
that long ago.

But, now look at this place! Amazing!
I'll bring my mother out to see this.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_OnlyToug:
It's not as if just anyone can come
here, you know?

Only those TRAINERS who've been
recognized as tough are brought here.

That's why many TRAINERS don't even
know about the BATTLE FRONTIER.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_PleaseBo:
Please board the ferry and wait for
departure.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SailWith: Please sail with us another time!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ScaredOf:
I'm scared of going into the BATTLE
PIKE because of SEVIPER…

B-but I came all the way here, so I will
try to conquer everything!
…Shudder…
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SquareFi:
It looks like this square's filled with
tough people.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_SureWeCa:
Are you sure we can make challenges
even if we don't have any POKéMON?
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThenWher: Then, where would you like to go?
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_ThisIsBa:
TRAINERS bring their best-raised
POKéMON for elimination-style matches.
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhereWou: And where would you like to go?
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WhosRais:
That's the BATTLE FACTORY.
You can rent strong POKéMON there.

But it makes me wonder.
Who's raising those rental POKéMON?
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WonIllTa:
Yay! I won!
I will take the BATTLE PIKE challenge!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_WontLetG:
Ah, so this here is the BATTLE DOME?
I won't let GENTLEMEN beat me!
BattleFrontier_OutsideWest_Text_YoureOff:
Oh? You're off to challenge
the BATTLE DOME?

I'll wish you the best of luck.
Let us both win our way up and meet
in challenges.
BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Goi:
Giggle… I'm going to go through every
challenge with just this baby!
BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Nev:
There was someone here using a 
POKéMON I've never seen before.

I never learned about it at
TRAINER'S SCHOOL at least.

I wonder where you can catch POKéMON
like that.
BattleFrontier_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Nex:
Okay! Next stop, the BATTLE ARENA!
I'd better get the right POKéMON from
the PC Storage System.
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_DomePike:
BATTLE DOME, BATTLE PIKE,
and BATTLE FACTORY Records
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_ExplainR:
This is where we recognize the immortal
TRAINERS who left great records in
BATTLE FRONTIER events.
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_IsYourNa: Hi, is your name on this list?
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_MyNamesN:
Hmm…
My name's not up there…

Well, it's only natural since I haven't
taken any challenges yet.
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_PalaceAr:
BATTLE PALACE, BATTLE ARENA,
and BATTLE PYRAMID Records
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WorkHard:
If you saw your friend's name up here,
I bet it would make you work harder!
BattleFrontier_RankingHall_Text_WowThats:
Wow, that's super!
I'll have to try harder, too!
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Battle:
The BATTLE ARENA is the dojo-like
building at the center-right of
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

An event called the Set KO Tourney
takes place at the BATTLE ARENA.

The BATTLE DOME is the large building
shaped like a huge egg.

Events named Battle Tourneys are held
in this facility.

The Battle Tourneys are offered in
two courses--for SINGLE and DOUBLE
BATTLES.

The BATTLE FACTORY is the large
building that is the closest to us.

An event called the Battle Swap
is conducted there.

The Battle Swap event is offered in
two courses for SINGLE and DOUBLE
BATTLES.

The BATTLE PALACE is the red building
on the right of the BATTLE FRONTIER.

There are two kinds of BATTLE HALLS
for SINGLE and DOUBLE BATTLES.

The BATTLE PIKE is the building shaped
like a POKéMON at the center-left of
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

An event called the Battle Choice
is conducted there.

Battle Points are rewards given to
TRAINERS who battled outstandingly
at the BATTLE FRONTIER.

You may trade in your Battle Points
for prizes at the EXCHANGE SERVICE
CORNER.

The BATTLE PYRAMID is the enormous
pyramid.

An event called the Battle Quest
is conducted there.

It is the gigantic tower considered
to be the BATTLE FRONTIER's symbol.

There are four kinds of BATTLE ROOMS
in the tower for SINGLE, DOUBLE, MULTI,
and LINK MULTI BATTLES.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_EnjoyB:
We hope you enjoy all that the BATTLE
FRONTIER has to offer!
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Exchan:
The EXCHANGE SERVICE CORNER is near
the BATTLE TOWER.

The Battle Points you have earned in
the BATTLE FRONTIER may be exchanged
for fabulous prizes there.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_FirstT:
Is it your first time here?
Please step this way!
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_HoldIt:
When entering a challenge at a BATTLE
FRONTIER facility, POKéMON may not
be holding the same kind of item.

Please make sure that all POKéMON
entering a challenge are holding
different items.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IfItIs:
???: Well, if it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You came out here!
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_IssueF:
For a first-time visitor, we issue
the FRONTIER PASS.

It's for use at all the facilities
in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LearnA: What would you like to learn about?
Which would you like to learn about?
Which would you like to learn about?
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Level5:
The Level 50 course is open to POKéMON
up to and including Level 50.

Please keep in mind, however, that
no TRAINER you face will have any
POKéMON below Level 50.

This course is the entry level for
battles at the BATTLE FRONTIER.

To begin, we hope you will challenge
this course.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_LevelM:
All the challenges at the BATTLE
FRONTIER's facilities come in
two courses--Level 50 and Open Level.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_MonEnt:
Virtually any kind of POKéMON may take
on the challenges at all facilities.

EGGS and certain kinds of POKéMON,
however, are not permitted.

The numbers of POKéMON required for
challenges will depend on the facility.

At all facilities, however, two or more
of the same kind of POKéMON are not
permitted.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OhMrSc:
GUIDE: Oh! MR. SCOTT, sir!
Good day to you, sir!
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_OpenLe:
The Open Level course places no limit
on the levels of POKéMON entering
challenges.

The levels of your opponents will
be adjusted to match the levels of
your POKéMON.

However, no TRAINER you face will
have any POKéMON below Level 60.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Placed:
{PLAYER} placed the TRAINER CARD
in the FRONTIER PASS.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Rankin:
The RANKING HALL is located near
the BATTLE TOWER.

There, you may see the most fantastic
records left by the TRAINERS that
took on the many challenges of
the BATTLE FRONTIER.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Record:
It is possible to record one battle
on your FRONTIER PASS.

You may record a battle you had with
a friend or friends.

Or you may record a battle conducted
at the BATTLE FRONTIER excluding
matches at the BATTLE PIKE or
the BATTLE PYRAMID.

You may choose to record your match
at the end of a battle.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_ScottG:
SCOTT: It's great to see you here,
it really is!

I hope you'll take your time and
explore everywhere.

Naturally, I hope you'll also experience
the pure essence of battling.

I also have my quarters here, so feel
free to visit if you have time.
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Symbol:
There are seven facilities at
the BATTLE FRONTIER.

TRAINERS who gain recognition for
their abilities may be rewarded with
symbols from each of the facilities.

To earn a symbol, TRAINERS may need
to defeat other TRAINERS in a row,
and may need to win events repeatedly.

It's certainly not easy to win symbols.
I wish you the best of luck!
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_Welcom:
The front lines of POKéMON battling!
Welcome to the BATTLE FRONTIER!
BattleFrontier_ReceptionGate_Text_YourGu:
I'm your guide to the various facilities
here in the BATTLE FRONTIER.
I'm your guide to the FRONTIER PASS.

I'm your guide to the basic rules that
are common to all the challenges
offered by the facilities in the BATTLE
FRONTIER.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat100T:
SCOTT: Oh, my! I heard about you!
How you overwhelmed the BATTLE TOWER!
You beat over 100 TRAINERS in a row?

That's ridiculously spectacular!
You've got to have this!
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Beat50Tr:
SCOTT: Oh, I heard about you!
How you ruled the BATTLE TOWER!
You beat over 50 TRAINERS in a row?

That's fantastic!
I want you to have this!
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_BerryPoc:
Your BERRY POCKET seems to
be stuffed.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ComeBack:
Oops, well, if you have too much
stuff, come back for this later.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_Expectin: I'm expecting great things from you!

I'll be expecting to hear even greater
things about you now!
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_ExplainB:
SCOTT: You can check your Battle
Points on your FRONTIER PASS.

The more success you have here at
the BATTLE FRONTIER, the more Battle
Points you will collect.

Use your Battle Points the way you
see fit, like trading them for items.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveThis:
But that's all in the past.
No point dwelling on that!

All I want for you is to enjoy battling
to your heart's content here.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, I want you to have this
as a memento for all the time our
paths crossed on our journeys.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HaveYouM:
SCOTT: Have you met any of
the FRONTIER BRAINS?

Better yet, have you obtained any
symbols from them?

I handpicked the FRONTIER BRAINS
as the toughest TRAINERS anywhere.

But I'm sure that seeing how tough
you are will startle even them!
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_HowMuchE:
On reflection, it was a terribly long
journey…

I left home alone on a quest to find
strong TRAINERS.

No one can imagine how much effort
or time it took to make this real.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_MayFindW:
SCOTT: You don't just train for battle,
right?

I think I remember you working on
a POKéDEX as well.

You may run into wild POKéMON in
the BATTLE FRONTIER somewhere…
Fufufu!
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_SoGladIB:
I must say I have the gift of knowing
a good TRAINER when I see one.

I'm so glad I had the foresight to
bring you here!
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WelcomeT:
SCOTT: Well, hello and welcome!
Heheh… Sorry about the cramped space.

Anyway, {PLAYER}{KUN}, let me formally
welcome you to the BATTLE FRONTIER.

This is my dream come true.
It took me years and years, but I've
finally given shape to my dream.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_WhyIGoSe:
SCOTT: Every TRAINER is an individual.
They all lead lives of their own.

But when they're in a battle,
it doesn't matter who they are.

I love the purity of battle,
where everyone is equal.

That's why I go everywhere seeking
TRAINERS who are serious about
battling, and invite them here.
BattleFrontier_ScottsHouse_Text_YouveCol:
SCOTT: I hope you're enjoying
everything in the BATTLE FRONTIER.

…Wait a second…
Oh, my disbelieving eyes!

Your FRONTIER PASS!
You've gathered up the full set
of gold symbols!

That's more than stupendous!
You're incredible, just as I suspected!

I think you will be able to
appreciate the value of my gift!

SCOTT: Are you enjoying things in
the BATTLE FRONTIER?

Your FRONTIER PASS!
You've collected the full set
of silver symbols!

That's more than impressive!
You are tough, just as I suspected!

Normally, I wouldn't do something
like this, but this is a special time!

I want you to have this.
I'm sure you can put it to proper use.

CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub:
Let me explain how the POKéMON
WIRELESS CLUB works.

On this, the top floor, there are
two rooms.

First, the room on the left.
It's the UNION ROOM.

You may link up with TRAINERS
around you who have also entered
the UNION ROOM.

With them, you may do things like
chat, battle, and trade.

Second, the room on the right is
the DIRECT CORNER.

You may trade or battle POKéMON
with your friends in this room.

Sometimes, you may not be able to
find your friends in the UNION ROOM
or the DIRECT CORNER.

In that case, please move closer
to your friends.

If the Wireless Adapter isn't
connected, you may still link up
using a GBA Game Link cable.

If that is the case, you must go
to the DIRECT CORNER.

I hope you enjoy the Wireless 
Communication System.

CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytim: Come visit me anytime you wish.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf:
The DEFENSE stat of all your
POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use the move
SURF outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBa:
Which of the eight BADGES should
I describe?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughB:
Hm? You don't have enough
BERRY POWDER.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesA:
There's something new on the second
floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the
DIRECT CORNER.

They installed a Wireless Adapter
machine for crushing BERRIES.
This is where you come in.

I have a favor to ask, one that
I can entrust only to you.

Could you make BERRY POWDER for
me using that machine?

Don't forget, the machine is at the
DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.

I'll concoct medicine for you if
you bring me some BERRY POWDER.

Don't forget, crush BERRIES into
BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThin:
Ah, good! For you, then, I have
just the thing.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtB:
Er-hem! Have you brought me some
BERRY POWDER?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAga:
That's fine, then.
I'll hope to see you back again.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey
you.

That includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.

POKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.

It also lets you use the move
CUT outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strengt:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey
you.

That includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.

POKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.

It also lets you use the move
STRENGTH outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSma:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey
you.

That includes even outsiders you
obtain in trades.

POKéMON of higher levels will
be unruly in battle, however.

It also lets you use the move
ROCK SMASH outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLike:
Come see me if you'd like to trade
your BERRY POWDER.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfal:
The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of
all your POKéMON rise a little bit.

It also lets you use the move
WATERFALL outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly:
The SPEED stat of all your
POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use the move
FLY outside of battle.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInA: You have no interest in BERRIES?

Young one, it's important to take an
interest in all sorts of things.
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryP:
This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed.
It will make excellent medicine.

Would you like to trade more BERRY
POWDER for something else?
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNo: Why must you lie to me?

How many BERRIES do you have?
Not a one!
CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBe:
Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY
POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMF:
Look what they've done to my
house!

They stole a TM for teaching
POKéMON how to DIG holes!

I was going to use it on a
MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…
That cost me a bundle, it did!
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDig: I figure what's lost is lost.

I decided to teach DIGLETT how to
DIG without a TM.
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftW: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!
CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryin:
TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG
their way into no good!
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWith:
You're collecting POKéMON for your
POKéDEX, aren't you?
Would you please trade with him?
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfW:
I'm quite enjoying myself with all
sorts of news.

Yes, I am satisfied!
I won't be bored for a while.
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsH:
Amazing!
What an incredible piece of news!

I haven't seen a news story this
incredible in too long a time!

Thanks for sharing this fantastic
news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNews:
You've spread the news some more?
Magnificent!

That piece of news must be
delighted to be passed around so.

Consider this a show of
appreciation from me and the news.

I'll give you more BERRIES than
I usually do.
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformat:
I see!
That was quite informative!

I applaud you for taking interest
in the news at your young age.

As my thanks for sharing the news
with me, I want you to have this.
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertai:
Sigh…
Too much time, too little to do…
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpread: Ah, you've spread the news for me?

Good news becomes worthwhile when
all sorts of people share it.

As my thanks for your spreading
the news, take this!
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareN:
It seems such a shame to not share
this news with other folks…

I wish I could tell someone…
Let others know the news…
CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchI:
Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full.
My gift remains ungiven, then.
CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWha:
With what would you like to 
exchange it?
CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRar:
Do you know about RARE CANDY?
They don't sell it in shops.

I think it makes POKéMON grow
very quickly all of a sudden.
CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakM:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away,
it also works on weak POKéMON.

Put your strongest POKéMON at the
left of the POKéMON LIST.

If your first POKéMON is strong,
REPEL's effect is boosted.
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillC:
BILL has lots of POKéMON!
He collects rare ones, too!
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillD:
I heard that he'll do whatever it
takes to get rare POKéMON.

He's not above doing all sorts
of things, I've heard.
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Every:
I think people are just jealous of
BILL, though.

Who wouldn't want to boast about
their POKéMON?
CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTr:
Why don't you go upstairs and try
trading POKéMON with your friends?

You could get a lot more variety
by trading.

The POKéMON you get in trades grow
quickly, too.
CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign:
Grass and caves handled easily!
BIKE SHOP
CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign:
CERULEAN CITY
A Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds
It
CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmel:
A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.

I don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.

All right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!
CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat:
GRUNT: Stop! I give up!
I'll leave quietly!
CeruleanCity_Text_GruntIntro:
Hey! Stay out!
It's not your yard!

I'm an innocent bystander!
Don't you believe me?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}
CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign:
CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: MISTY
The Tomboyish Mermaid!
CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedi:
No! That's wrong!
It's so hard to control POKéMON!

Your POKéMON's obedience depends
on your abilities as a TRAINER.
CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCou:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you
could CUT down the small tree.

That way, you could get to the
other side.

I think there's a way around it,
though.
CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun:
Make room for this!
I can't run until I give it to you!
CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAs:
I feel sorry for you. No, really.
You're always plodding behind me.

So here, I'll give you a little
present as a favor.
CeruleanCity_Text_OkayIllReturnStolenTM:
…Okay.
I'll return the TM I stole.
CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed:
It's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is
behind this most heinous crime!

Even our POLICE FORCE has
trouble with the ROCKETS!
CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmu:
You're making an encyclopedia on
POKéMON? That sounds amusing.
CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt:
{PLAYER} recovered TM28 from
the TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalDefeat:
Hey!
Take it easy!
You won already!
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro:
You're still struggling along back
here?

I'm doing great! I caught a bunch
of strong and smart POKéMON!

Here, let me see what you caught,
{PLAYER}!
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle:
I went to BILL's and got him to
show me his rare POKéMON.

That added a lot of pages to my
POKéDEX!

After all, BILL's world famous as a
POKéMANIAC.

He invented the POKéMON Storage
System on PC, too.

Since you're using his system,
you should go thank him.

Well, I better get rolling!
Smell ya later!
CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave:
Horribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.

It takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.

You'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION for starters.

And, you would have to have
made a great achievement.
CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsnt:
Collecting, battling…
It's a tough life, isn't it?
CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems:
A POKéMON can be made to hold
an item.

Some items can even be used by
the holding POKéMON in battle.
CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle: I want a bright red bicycle.

I'll keep it at home, so it won't
get dirty.
CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTree:
Did you know that you can CUT down
small trees?

Even that small tree in front of
the shop can be CUT down.

I think there's a way around it,
though.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro:
I've studied POKéMON thoroughly.
You can't win!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle:
My theories are too complicated
for you to understand.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat:
I have burned down to nothing!
Not even ashes remain!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro:
I am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER
of CINNABAR GYM!

My fiery POKéMON are all rough
and ready with intense heat!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle:
TM38 contains FIRE BLAST.
Teach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.

VULPIX or CHARMELEON would be
ideal for that move.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro:
I know why BLAINE became a
TRAINER.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good.

Night fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared.

Its light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro:
I've been to many GYMS, but this
one best suits my style.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle:
PONYTA, NINETALES…
Those are popular FIRE POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro:
Do you know how hot POKéMON fire
breath can get?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle:
Fire, or to be more precise,
combustion…

…Oxygen in the air…
Blah, blah, blah, blah…
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBa:
The VOLCANOBADGE heightens the
SPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.
Here, you can have this, too!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltim:
FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire
technique.
Don't waste it on WATER POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
The hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE
POKéMON pro.

You'd better take some
BURN HEALS, too.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAnd:
It's a photo of BLAINE and
MR. FUJI.

They're standing shoulder to
shoulder with big grins.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules:
Get it right, and the door opens to
the next room.
Get it wrong, and face a TRAINER!

If you want to conserve your
POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…

Then get it right!
Here we go!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro:
I was a thief, but I went straight
as a TRAINER.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle:
I get this uncontrollable urge to
steal other people's POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2:
There are nine certified POKéMON
LEAGUE BADGES?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4:
Are electric moves effective
against GROUND-type POKéMON?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5:
POKéMON of the same kind and level
are not identical?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro:
I like using FIRE-type POKéMON.
I just do.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle:
I wish there were a thief POKéMON.
I'd use that!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle:
But fire melts ice, so the FIRE
type beats ICE-type POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAt:
I like it because it raises the
ATTACK stat in battle.
CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNever:
It never hurts to have extra items.
You never know what might happen.
CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Cin:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM,
but the door is locked tight.

There should be a key for it
somewhere.

Could it be in that burned-out
mansion?

The GYM LEADER's friend used to
live there, they say.
CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Evo:
POKéMON can still learn techniques
after canceling evolution.

Evolution can wait until new moves
have been learned.
CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhN: Oh, you're still not done yet?
CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rea:
BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting!
Ready to set sail to ONE ISLAND?
CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Vis: Do you have lots of friends?

Linking up with the usual friends
is fun, of course.

But how about visiting the
UNION ROOM every so often?

Who knows, you may end up making
new friends.

I think it would be worth your time
to check the UNION ROOM.
CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_:
A photo of the LAB's founder…
DR. FUJI?!

We study POKéMON extensively
every day.

People often bring us rare POKéMON
for examination.
CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom:
Your fossil is back to life!
It was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!

So!
You hurry and give me that!

{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the
{STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.

I am important doctor.
Yes, very much so, indeed.

Here, I study rare POKéMON fossils.
All the time, I study.

You!
Have you a fossil for me?
ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないね！

I take a little time!
You go for walk a little while!
ちょっと　じかん　かかるよ！

そこらへんを　すこし
ブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！

It is fossil of {STR_VAR_1},
a POKéMON that is already extinct!

My Resurrection Machine will make
that POKéMON live again!
CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_Fo:
I found this most remarkable fossil
inside MT. MOON.

I think it's of a rare, prehistoric
POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_T:
EEVEE can evolve into one of three
kinds of POKéMON.

There are three legendary bird
POKéMON.

They are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and
MOLTRES.

We plan to explore the cavern
close to CERULEAN.
CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSince:
CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the
odd fellow.

He's lived on the island since way
before the LAB was built.
CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIslan:
Look, it's me, BILL.
Long time no see!

I hope you're still using my
PC system.

Well, listen, since we met up here,
how about spending time with me?

There's this little island in the far
south called ONE ISLAND.

A friend invited me, so I'm on my
way out there.

How about it?
Do you feel like coming with me?
CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign:
CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM
LEADER: BLAINE
The Hotheaded Quiz Master!
CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouC: Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?

My buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy
your company.

I'm sure he'd welcome you if you
were to visit him again.

If you have a TRI-PASS, you can
always take a ferry there from
VERMILION PORT.
All right, thanks for your company!
CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCe:
Well, all right.
The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.

I'll be waiting at the POKéMON
CENTER over there.

Come see me when you're done with
your business here.
CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign:
CINNABAR ISLAND
The Fiery Town of Burning Desire
CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived:
Looks like my pal's boat arrived,
too.

He sent it specially here to
CINNABAR to pick me up.
CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperiment:
Scientists conduct experiments 
in the burned-out building.

You know, the one they call the
POKéMON MANSION.
Common_Text_LookCloserAtMap:
{PLAYER} took a closer look at the
{REGION} region map.
ContestHall_Text_AcceptYourPrize:
MC: Here you are!
Please accept your prize!
ContestHall_Text_AudienceWillVote:
The audience will vote on their
favorite POKéMON contestants.
ContestHall_Text_ConferRibbonAsPrize:
We confer on you this RIBBON
as your prize!
ContestHall_Text_CongratsPleaseCompeteAg:
MC: Congratulations!
Please do compete again!
ContestHall_Text_GettingStartedParticipa:
MC: Hello! We're just getting started
with a {STR_VAR_3} Rank POKéMON
{STR_VAR_2}!

The participating TRAINERS and their
POKéMON are as follows:

MC: Hello! We're just getting started
with a 4-player linked POKéMON
{STR_VAR_2}!

The participating TRAINERS and their
POKéMON are as follows:
ContestHall_Text_GettingStartedWireless:
MC: Hello! We're just getting started
with a 4-player linked POKéMON
{STR_VAR_2}!
ContestHall_Text_JudgeLooksReady:
Now, all that remains is the pulse-
pounding proclamation of the winner.

The JUDGE looks ready to make
the announcement!
ContestHall_Text_LetVotingBegin:
Without any further ado,
let the voting begin!
ContestHall_Text_LetsAppeal:
Let's see a little enthusiasm!
Let's appeal!
ContestHall_Text_OnlyRegister4Players:
I only register four players for
POKéMON CONTESTS.

If three other players link up, all
four may enter the same CONTEST.
Would you like to take part?
ContestHall_Text_ParticipantsAsFollows:
The participating TRAINERS and their
POKéMON are as follows:
ContestHall_Text_PickUpPrizeAtCounterLat:
Please pick up your prize at
the reception counter later.
Please do compete again!
ContestHall_Text_SecondStageOfJudging:
The second stage of judging is
the much-anticipated appeal time!

May the contestants amaze us with
superb appeals of dazzling moves!
ContestHall_Text_SeenContestantsAudience:
MC: We've just seen the four POKéMON
contestants.
Now it's time for primary judging!

The audience will vote on their
favorite POKéMON contestants.

Without any further ado, let the
voting begin!
ContestHall_Text_ThankYouForAppeals:
Thank you all for a most wonderful
display of quality appeals!

This concludes all judging!
Thank you for your fine efforts!
ContestHall_Text_VotingComplete:
While the votes are being tallied,
let's move on to secondary judging!
ContestHall_Text_VotingCompleteLetsAppea:
While the votes are being tallied,
let's move on to secondary judging!

The second stage of judging is the
much anticipated appeal time!

May the contestants amaze us with
superb appeals of dazzling moves!

Let's see a little enthusiasm!
Let's appeal!
ContestHall_Text_WeWillNowDeclareWinner: JUDGE: We will now declare the winner!
ContestHall_Text_WeveSeenContestants:
MC: We've just seen the four POKéMON
contestants.
Now it's time for primary judging!
ContestLadyShow_Text_Intro:
MC: Sorry to interrupt the regular
programming, and thanks for joining us!

We bring you this live from
the scene of a just-completed
{STR_VAR_1}!

MC: Oh! It looks like the CONTEST
participants are headed this way!

I'll try to get an impromptu interview
for you folks at home!
ContestLadyShow_Text_Lost:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!

You must be disappointed by that turn
of events. Do you have any comments?

BEAUTY: It's heartbreaking…
My {STR_VAR_2} and I, we did our best…

But I feel like I've let down everyone
who has supported us through this.

MC: I hate to say it, but the POKéMON's
coloration is a little wanting.

BEAUTY: {STR_VAR_3}, I'm so sorry…
I'll do better next time, I swear…
…Sniff… Waaaaah!

Spectators: See that?
The poor girl!

Uh… That's all the time we have today!
Thanks for tuning in!
ContestLadyShow_Text_LostBadly:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!
How did your CONTEST appearance go?

MC: I hate to say it, but the POKéMON's
coloration is a little wanting.

Spectators: See that?
The poor girl!

Uh… That's all the time we have today!
Thanks for tuning in!
ContestLadyShow_Text_Won:
MC: Excuse me!
Thanks for joining us on live TV!
May I congratulate you on your win?

What was the key factor in today's
stunning victory?

BEAUTY: We gave it our best effort
today, my {STR_VAR_2} and I!

But I'm sure we wouldn't have made it
if it weren't for all the help we
received leading up to the CONTEST!

MC: Do you have a special someone
with whom you'd like to share your joy?
Let's hear it live!

{STR_VAR_3}! Are you watching?
We did it!
Thank you!
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_BetterRound1:
Spectator: In terms of being {STR_VAR_1},
that {STR_VAR_2} was outstanding.

I hope it makes better appeals
next time, though.
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_BetterRound2:
Spectator: The {STR_VAR_2} didn't do
well in the primary judging, but it
cleaned up in the secondary judging!

It was a miraculous comeback
for that {STR_VAR_2}. Yippee!
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_EqualRounds:
Spectator: The {STR_VAR_2} remained
consistent throughout both primary
and secondary judging.

{STR_VAR_3} and the {STR_VAR_2},
they're no ordinary combo!
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_ExcitingAppeal:
Spectator: The winning {STR_VAR_2}'s
appeal got my heart pounding!
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_FailedToAppeal:
It failed to make a single appeal during
secondary judging out of nervousness.

Next time, I would like to see this
{STR_VAR_1} make even one appeal.
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_GotNervous:
Spectator: When the {STR_VAR_2} got
nervous, I couldn't stop myself from
shouting encouragement.

I'd like to say this to that
{STR_VAR_2}, “Congratulations!”
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_GotStartled:
Spectator: When the {STR_VAR_2} was
startled by another POKéMON's appeal,
I was close to tears.

{STR_VAR_2}, you were resilient!
Way to go!
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_Intro:
We're live from the just-ended
{STR_VAR_1} site.

The hall is still filled with
an audience unwilling to leave.

MC: Let's hear what the fans have
to say about this CONTEST.
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LastInBothRounds:
It came dead last in both primary
and secondary judging.

I hope that {STR_VAR_1} will retrain this
{STR_VAR_2} and erase the shame of
this undisputed last-place finish.
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LostAfterWinning:
While finishing first in the primary
judging, its appeals in the secondary
judging failed to click.

It suffered a humiliating come-from-
behind loss.

I'm sure {STR_VAR_1} is studying how to
make more effective appeals now.
ContestLiveUpdates_Text_LostBySmallMargi:
It lost to {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}
by only a small margin.

It must be heartbreaking to come
so close to victory only to fail.

I wouldn't be surprised if {STR_VAR_3}

I'll show you how strategy can
beat brute strength.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle:
So, you mix brawn with brains?
Good strategy!

That's remarkable for a child
TRAINER.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro: I was a magician once upon a time.

But I dreamt of becoming a ninja,
so I joined this GYM.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle:
Even though I've lost, I will keep
training according to the teachings
of KOGA, my ninja master.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat:
Humph!
You have proven your worth!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadg:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE,
the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.

It also lets you SURF outside of
battle.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06:
Sealed within that TM06 lies
TOXIC!

It is a secret technique dating
back some four hundred years.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro:
A mere child like you dares to
challenge me?

The very idea makes me shiver
with mirth!

Very well, I shall show you true
terror as a ninja master.

Poison brings steady doom.
Sleep renders foes helpless.

Despair to the creeping horror of
POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle:
When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON
suffers more and more.

It suffers worsening damage as the
battle wears on!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro:
Let's see you beat my special
techniques!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle:
I like poison and sleep techniques,
as they linger after battle!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro:
The famed invisible walls of
FUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle:
You impressed me!
Here's a hint!

Look very closely for gaps in the
invisible walls!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat:
You're more skilled than I'd
thought!
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro:
Master KOGA comes from a long line
of ninjas.
FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle:
Where there is light, there is
shadow!

Light and shadow!
Which do you choose?
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnM:
BILL files his own POKéMON data on
his PC.
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson:
He always liked collecting things,
even as a child!
FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFa:
The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old, 
but he's still very much active.
All his teeth are false, though.
FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_DoYouLikeToFish:
I'm the FISHING GURU's older
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can't bear to go without.
Tell me, do you like to fish?
FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_GoodRodCanCatchB:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

A crummy OLD ROD could only catch
MAGIKARP, yes?

But with a GOOD ROD, you can
catch much better POKéMON.
FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_LikeYourStyleTak:
Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.
Take this and fish, young friend!
FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_ReceivedGoodRod:
{PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from
the FISHING GURU's brother.
FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_YouHaveNoRoomFor:
I had a gift for you, but you have
no room for it!
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForge:
Come again if there are other
moves to be forgotten.
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneM:
{STR_VAR_1} seems to know only one
move…
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonsMoveShouldBe:
Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}?
That move should be forgotten?
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowM:
What?
No EGG should know any moves.
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMonShouldFo:
Which POKéMON should forget a
move?
FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToFo:
Uh…
Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.

I can make POKéMON forget their
moves.
Would you like me to do that?
FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DidYouTryXSpeed:
Did you try X SPEED?
It speeds up a POKéMON in battle.
FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveSafari:
Don't they have any pennants
promoting the SAFARI ZONE?

How about some paper lanterns?
Aren't there even any calendars?
FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantBe:
You can't become a good TRAINER
with just one strong POKéMON.

But raising many POKéMON evenly
is no easy task, either.
FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokemo:
There's a narrow trail west of
VIRIDIAN CITY.

It goes to the POKéMON LEAGUE HQ.
The HQ governs all TRAINERS.
FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitS:
If you're working on a POKéDEX,
visit the SAFARI ZONE.

All sorts of rare POKéMON breed
there.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Cal:
We'll call you on the PA when you
run out of time or SAFARI BALLS.

Well, I'll wish you the best of
luck!
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Cat:
Did you catch your fair share?
Come again!
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Exp:
The SAFARI ZONE actually has
four zones in it.

Each zone has different kinds of
POKéMON, even some rare ones.

Use the supplied SAFARI BALLS to
catch them.

You can also throw BAIT or ROCKS
besides the SAFARI BALLS.

If you throw BAIT, the POKéMON
becomes less likely to flee, but
harder to catch.

If you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON
becomes more likely to flee, but
easier to catch.

When you run out of time or SAFARI
BALLS, it's game over for you!
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Fir:
Hi! Is it your first time here at
the SAFARI ZONE?
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Goi:
Are you going to leave the
SAFARI ZONE early?
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Pla:
For just ¥500, you can play the
SAFARI GAME.

You can roam the wide-open safari
and catch what you like.

{PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS
from the attendant.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Ple:
Please return any SAFARI BALLS
you may have left.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Tha:
We only use a special kind of 
POKé BALLS here.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Could:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but
I couldn't understand him.
I think he's got a speech problem!
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Nickn:
You know, he has that vacant look
like a SLOWPOKE.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Prize:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a
promotion campaign right now.

Try to get to the farthest corner
of the SAFARI ZONE.

If you can make it, you'll win a
very convenient prize.
FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Warde:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very
knowledgeable about POKéMON.

He even has some fossils of rare,
extinct POKéMON.
FuchsiaCity_Text_ChanseySign:
Name: CHANSEY
Catching one is all up to chance.
FuchsiaCity_Text_CitySign:
FUCHSIA CITY
Behold! It's Passion Pink!
FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame: Did you try the SAFARI GAME?

There are some rare POKéMON that
can only be caught there.
FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign:
FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: KOGA
The Poisonous Ninja Master
FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere:
That item ball in there…
Were you wanting that?
FuchsiaCity_Text_KabutoSign:
Name: KABUTO
An extremely rare POKéMON that was
regenerated from a fossil.
FuchsiaCity_Text_KangaskhanSign:
A maternal POKéMON that raises its
young in a pouch on its belly.
FuchsiaCity_Text_LaprasSign:
Name: LAPRAS
AKA the king of the seas.
FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader:
My father is the GYM LEADER of
this town.

I'm training to use POISON POKéMON
as well as my father.
FuchsiaCity_Text_OmanyteSign:
Name: OMANYTE
An extremely rare POKéMON that was
regenerated from a fossil.
FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneOfficeSign:
POKéMON PARADISE!
Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
SAFARI ZONE OFFICE
FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront:
The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front
of the entrance.

Out back is the SAFARI GAME for
catching POKéMON.
FuchsiaCity_Text_SlowpokeSign:
Name: SLOWPOKE
Friendly and very slow moving.
FuchsiaCity_Text_VoltorbSign:
Name: VOLTORB
The very image of a POKé BALL.
FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara:
ERIK: Where's SARA?
I said I'd meet her here.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHo:
Ah howhee ho hoo!
Eef ee hafahi ho!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStr:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find
STRENGTH.

It lets POKéMON move boulders when
you're outside of battle.

Oh yes, did you find the SECRET
HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTe:
{PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH
to the WARDEN.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHa:
Ha?
He ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHef:
Ha lof ha feef ee hafahi ho.
Heff hee fwee!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosF:
POKéMON photos and fossils are on
display.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_OldMonMerc:
Old POKéMON merchandise is on
display.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLass:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie!
You're a real lifesaver!

No one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!

I was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.

Let me give you something for your
trouble.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonG:
WARDEN: Thanks, son!
You're a real lifesaver!

No one could understand a word
that I said, not a one!

I was too ashamed to show my face
around the OFFICE, even.

Let me give you something for your
trouble.
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPopp: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!
FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_YouHaveToo:
なんや　にもつ
いっぱいやんけ！
GabbyAndTy_Text_CleverItemSkillsIntervie:
The last time we battled, your item
skills cleverly did us in.

Anyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?
GabbyAndTy_Text_DescribeYourFeelings:
Okay, I need you to describe your
feelings about our battle, but it
has to be short and sweet. Go!
GabbyAndTy_Text_DontGiveUpKeepingEyeOut:
Okay, but don't give up!
We'll be keeping an eye out for you!
GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeat:
GABBY: That was an intense battle!
Did you get all that on camera?
GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyDefeatFirstTime:
GABBY: My eyes didn't lie!
I did discover an astonishing TRAINER!
GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyIntro:
GABBY: Oh! You're {PLAYER}! Hi!
Do you remember us from last time?

Can you show us how much stronger
you've become? Okay, cue interview!
GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyNotEnoughMons:
GABBY: Is there a strong TRAINER
anywhere with a lot of POKéMON?
GabbyAndTy_Text_GabbyPreFirstBattle:
GABBY: Oh! We've just spotted a tough-
looking TRAINER here of all places!

Okay, roll camera!
Let's get this interview.
GabbyAndTy_Text_GiveUsAnInterviewThisTim:
You've gotten a lot stronger--a lot--
since we last battled.

We were right about you when we
spotted you as a hot TRAINER.

So, anyway, what do you think?
Are you willing to give us an interview
this time?
GabbyAndTy_Text_InterviewAgain:
Anyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?
GabbyAndTy_Text_KeepingAnEyeOutForYou:
GABBY: We'll be keeping an eye out
for you!
GabbyAndTy_Text_PerfectWellBeSeeingYou:
GABBY: Mmm, yeah!
That's the perfect clincher!

I get the feeling that this will make
a great TV show.

There's a chance that they'll air this
on TV, so make sure to look for us!
GabbyAndTy_Text_QuoteFromLastInterview:
Remember? That's the quote you gave
us as the battle clincher last time.
I never, ever forget stuff like that!
GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeat:
TY: Yep, I got it all.
That whole battle's on camera.
GabbyAndTy_Text_TyDefeatFirstTime:
TY: Yep, we sure spotted a hot TRAINER.
This is a huge scoop for us!
GabbyAndTy_Text_TyIntro:
TY: Hey, lookie here!
I remember you!

I'll get this battle all on this
here camera!
GabbyAndTy_Text_TyNotEnoughMons:
TY: Do you only have the one POKéMON
and that's it?

If you had more POKéMON, it'd make for
better footage, but…
GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPostBattle:
TY: You're a natural!
Got me some prime footage right here!
GabbyAndTy_Text_TyPreFirstBattle:
TY: Hey, lookie here! A tough-looking
TRAINER here, of all places!
Camera's rolling!
GabbyAndTy_Text_WeLookedRespectableInter:
The last time we battled, we managed
to look respectable.

Anyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?
GabbyAndTy_Text_WhoAreYouInterview:
GABBY: Awesome! Awesome!
Who are you?!

I knew we were onto something wild
when we spotted you!

Oh, please let me explain. We travel
around everywhere interviewing all
sorts of TRAINERS.

So, would you give us a bit of your time
for an interview?
GabbyAndTy_Text_YouStompedUsInterviewAga:
The last time we battled, you stomped
us before we could brace ourselves…

Anyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?
GabbyAndTy_Text_YouThrewABallAtUsIntervi:
The last time we battled, didn't you
throw a POKé BALL at us?

We were shocked! So we told everyone,
just everyone, about it!

Anyway, what do you think?
Do you want to be interviewed again?
GiddyText_IBoughtCrayonsWith120Colors:
I bought crayons with 120 colors!
Don't you think that's nice?
GiddyText_ISoWantToGoOnAVacation:
I so want to go on a vacation.
Would you happen to know a nice place?
GiddyText_LyingBackInTheGreenGrass:
Lying back in the green grass…
Oh, it's so, so nice!
GiddyText_SecretBasesAreSoWonderful:
SECRET BASES are so wonderful!
Can't you feel the excitement?
GiddyText_WhatsTheBottomOfTheSeaLike:
What's the bottom of the sea like?
Just once I would so love to go!
GiddyText_WhenYouSeeTheSettingSunDoesIt:
When you see the setting sun, does it
make you want to go home?
GiddyText_WhenYouWriteOnASandyBeach:
When you write on a sandy beach,
they wash away. It makes me sad.
GiddyText_WouldntItBeNiceIfWeCouldFloat:
Wouldn't it be nice if we could float
away on a cloud of bubbles?
GraniteCave_1F_Text_ExplainFlash:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to
a POKéMON and use it.

It lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.

But, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.
GraniteCave_1F_Text_GetsDarkAheadHereYou:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.
It'll be tough trying to explore.

That guy who came by earlier…
STEVEN, I think it was.

He knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but…

Well, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.
Here you go, I'll pass this on to you.
GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_CouldBecome:
STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite
capable.

If you keep training, you could even
become the CHAMPION of the POKéMON
LEAGUE one day. That's what I think.

I know, since we've gotten to know each
other, let's register one another in
our POKéNAVS.
GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ImStevenLet:
I'm interested in rare stones,
so I travel here and there.
GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_IveGotToHur: Now, I've got to hurry along.
GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_OhBagIsFull:
Oh, your BAG is full…
That's too bad, then.
GraniteCave_StevensRoom_Text_ThankYouTak:
You went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.

Let me see…
I'll give you this TM.

It contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.
IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Agat:
AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are
horrifically terrifying in toughness.

I took my FIGHTING-type POKéMON
and raised them to the max.

I went at AGATHA feeling pretty
confident, but she whupped us.

That old lady's also got a really
short fuse, too.

It doesn't take anything to get
that scary lady hollering.
IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Face:
From here on, you face the
ELITE FOUR one by one.

If you win, a door opens to the
next TRAINER. Good luck!
IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymG:
At the POKéMON LEAGUE, you will
face the ELITE FOUR all in a row.

If you lose, you have to start all
over again!

This is it!
Go for it!
IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lanc:
Maybe becoming an ELITE FOUR
member is in the blood.

From what I've heard, LANCE has
a cousin who's a GYM LEADER
somewhere far away.
IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lore:
I am so sorry, but you've wasted
your time coming here.

LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR is
absent, you see.

As a result, the POKéMON LEAGUE is
closed for the time being.
InsideOfTruck_Text_BoxPrintedWithMonLogo: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.

It's a POKéMON brand moving and
delivery service.
JaggedPass_Text_AutumnIntro:
I climb this hill every day.
I have confidence in my strength!
JaggedPass_Text_AutumnPostBattle:
What is that odd rock protrusion
a little up the hill from here?
JaggedPass_Text_BoulderShakingInResponse:
Oh! This boulder is shaking in response
to the MAGMA EMBLEM!
JaggedPass_Text_DianaDefeat:
Ohhh, no!
The ground is too bumpy…
JaggedPass_Text_DianaIntro:
This place isn't your casual hike.
It's not suited for a picnic.
JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostBattle:
Some people cleverly ride their
bicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.
JaggedPass_Text_DianaPostRematch:
I'll forget about losing and just
enjoy this bumpy hike.
JaggedPass_Text_DianaRegister:
Will you ever be back in this area?
If you do return, I'd like a rematch.
JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchDefeat:
I only lost because the ground is
too bumpy!
JaggedPass_Text_DianaRematchIntro:
Picnics are fun wherever you go.
Just like POKéMON!
JaggedPass_Text_EricIntro:
Now this is what I've always wanted
in a mountain.

This jagged bumpiness…
It rocks my soul!
JaggedPass_Text_EricPostBattle: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON…

But, when it comes to the love of
the mountains, I have you beat!
JaggedPass_Text_EthanDefeat:
It was all over while we were still
trying to find a good footing…
JaggedPass_Text_EthanIntro:
JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on.
It's a good place for training.
JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostBattle:
If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to
jump ledges.
JaggedPass_Text_EthanPostRematch:
I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL
in MAUVILLE CITY…
JaggedPass_Text_EthanRegister:
When I get more used to this bumpiness,
I'll be sure to win!
Can you register me in your POKéNAV?
JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchDefeat:
It's still not easy to battle on this
bumpy ground…
JaggedPass_Text_EthanRematchIntro:
I got used to this bumpiness.
I sing while I climb now.
JaggedPass_Text_GoWhereverYouWant:
Okay, oh-kay!
I admit it--you're strong!

Don't worry about me.
Go wherever you want!
JaggedPass_Text_GruntDefeat:
I should've ducked into our HIDEOUT
right away…
JaggedPass_Text_GruntIntro:
Wah!
What are you doing here?
What am I doing in a place like this?
What business is it of yours?
JaggedPass_Text_JulioDefeat: I feel like I'm falling apart…
JaggedPass_Text_JulioIntro:
Aiyeeh! It's awfully scary to shoot
down the mountain in one go!
JaggedPass_Text_JulioPostBattle:
My bicycle bounced around so much,
my rear end's sore…
Kecleon_Text_SomethingUnseeable: Something unseeable is in the way.
Kecleon_Text_UseDevonScopeMonAttacked:
An invisible POKéMON became completely
visible!
Kecleon_Text_WantToUseDevonScope: Something unseeable is in the way.
Want to use the DEVON SCOPE?
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleDefeat: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxleIntro:
I'm trying to relieve my stress.
Don't come along and stress me out!
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_AxlePostBattle:
If you spend too much time buried in
hot sand, it tuckers you out…
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColeDefeat: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes…
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ColePostBattle:
Being buried in hot sand promotes
circulation.

It's effective for healing pain in
your joints.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DanielleIntro:
Um…
Okay, I'll battle with you.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_DaniellePostBa:
I'm going to be a pretty and strong
TRAINER just like FLANNERY.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainHeatBad:
If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON
up to Level 50, even those you get in
trades from other people, will obey
you completely.

And, it lets POKéMON use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.

This is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainOverhea:
That move inflicts serious damage on
the opponent.

But it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK
of the POKéMON using it. It might not
be suitable for longer battles.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryDefeat:
Oh…
I guess I was trying too hard…

I… I've only recently become
a GYM LEADER.

I tried too hard to be someone
I'm not.

I have to do things my natural way. If
I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.

Thanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryIntro:
Puny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!

I have been entrusted with the…
No, wait.

I am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM
LEADER here!

Uh…
Dare not underestimate me, though
I have been LEADER only a short time!

With skills inherited from my grand-
father, I shall, uh…demonstrate the
hot moves we have honed on this land!
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostBa: Your power reminds me of someone…

Oh! I know! You battle like NORMAN,
the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPostRe:
FLANNERY: I lost the match,
but I'm completely satisfied.

It's not often I get to enjoy a battle
this heated.

Let's have another one like this
again sometime!
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryPreRem:
FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.

I love POKéMON.
I love to battle.
And… I love this GYM!

Let's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_FlanneryRematc:
Whew!
On the verge of eruption!

FLANNERY: Losing a battle isn't going
to deflate me.

I love POKéMON.
I love to battle.
And… I love this GYM!

Let's exchange superhot moves
in another battle!

Oh, wait. Do you only have one POKéMON
that can battle?

I hate to say this, but when you come
see me, bring at least two POKéMON.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GeraldPostBatt:
The temperature of magma is
392 degrees.

Your POKéMON beat me, so they should
easily survive in magma.
LavaridgeTown_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

LAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY
uses FIRE-type POKéMON.

Her passion for POKéMON burns stronger
and hotter than a volcano.

Don't get too close to her--you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and then
go for it!

LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainCo:
There are four ranks of POKéMON
CONTESTS.

NORMAL, SUPER, HYPER, and MASTER
are the four ranks.

In the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may
enter.

Any POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank
CONTEST may move up to the SUPER Rank
in the same category.

In the same way, a SUPER Rank winner
can move up to the HYPER Rank, and
a HYPER Rank winner can advance to
the MASTER Rank in the same category.

A POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank
may compete in the MASTER Rank as
often as its TRAINER wants.
There are five kinds of CONTESTS.

COOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and
TOUGH are the five categories.

Choose the CONTEST that is right for
the POKéMON you plan to enter.

A POKéMON CONTEST involves four
TRAINERS entering one POKéMON each
in competitive judging.

A CONTEST has two stages of judging,
primary and secondary.

Primary judging is a popularity poll
involving the audience.

Secondary judging features appeals
by the POKéMON using their moves.

Plan appeals carefully to earn the
most attention of the JUDGE and
excite the audience.
Do your best to stand out.

The primary and secondary scores are
added at the end.

The POKéMON garnering the highest
score is declared the winner.
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainEM:
In E-MODE (EMERALD MODE),

two to four players. Each player must

The players must be linked with each
other using Wireless Adapters or
GBA Game Link cables.

If there are fewer than four players,

the 4-player CONTEST lineup.

available in POKéMON Ruby or Sapphire.
LilycoveCity_ContestLobby_Text_ExplainGM:
