of you help me study POKéMON.

Thanks to your help, new facts
are coming to light.

It appears that in the HOENN region,
there are also POKéMON from other
regions.

It goes to show how rich and varied
the natural environments of HOENN
happen to be.

That's why I think it's necessary for
me to upgrade your POKéDEX to
the NATIONAL Mode.
Here, let me see your POKéDEX units.
LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_P:
It's a PC used for research.
Better not mess around with it.

PROF. BIRCH: I see!
You picked a fine POKéMON!

{PLAYER}'s POKéDEX was upgraded
to the NATIONAL Mode!
LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_S:
SCOTT: Hi, hi, {PLAYER}!
It's me, SCOTT.

I'm aboard the S.S. TIDAL now.
It feels great to be on the sea!

There's this place that I'd like to
invite you to for a visit.

If you're interested, board a ferry
at either SLATEPORT or LILYCOVE.

I'll fill you in on the details when
we meet. I'll be waiting!

It's a serious-looking machine.
The PROF must use this for research.
LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_T:
PROF. BIRCH: Take your time before
you decide.
LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_W:
PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not
give a nickname to that {STR_VAR_1}?
LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_Text_Y:
PROF. BIRCH: The GRASS POKéMON
CHIKORITA is your choice!
You sure know what you're doing.

PROF. BIRCH: The FIRE POKéMON
CYNDAQUIL caught your eye!
So the CYNDAQUIL is your choice?

PROF. BIRCH: The WATER POKéMON
TOTODILE is your choice!
You know how to pick a good one.
LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSomethingToShow:
PROF. BIRCH: Well, well, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
That was good work out there!

I knew there was something special
about you when I first saw you,
but I never expected this.

Oh, yes. Do you still have the POKéDEX
I gave you?

I have something to show you.
Let's go to my LAB.
LittlerootTown_Text_BirchSpendsDaysInLab:
PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB
studying, then he'll suddenly go out in
the wild to do more research…

When does PROF. BIRCH spend time
at home?
LittlerootTown_Text_CanUsePCToStoreItems:
If you use a PC, you can store items
and POKéMON.
The power of science is staggering!
LittlerootTown_Text_CanYouGoSeeWhatsHapp:
There are scary POKéMON outside!
I can hear their cries!

I want to go see what's going on,
but I don't have any POKéMON…

Can you go see what's happening
for me?
LittlerootTown_Text_ComeHomeIfAnythingHa:
To think that you have your very own
POKéMON now…
Your father will be overjoyed.

…But please be careful.
If anything happens, you can come home.
Go on, go get them, honey!
LittlerootTown_Text_DangerousIfYouDontHa:
It's dangerous if you don't have
your own POKéMON.
LittlerootTown_Text_ExplainRunningShoes:
MOM: {PLAYER}, those shoes came with
instructions.

“Press the B Button while wearing these
RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!

“Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race
in the great outdoors!”
LittlerootTown_Text_GoodLuckCatchingPoke:
Are you going to catch POKéMON?
Good luck!
LittlerootTown_Text_IfYouGoInGrassPokemo:
If you go outside and go in the grass,
wild POKéMON will jump out!
LittlerootTown_Text_OurNewHomeLetsGoInsi:
It must be tiring riding with our things
in the moving truck.

How do you like it?
This is our new home!

It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?

And, you get your own room, {PLAYER}!
Let's go inside.
LittlerootTown_Text_SwitchShoesWithRunni:
{PLAYER} switched shoes with the
RUNNING SHOES.
LittlerootTown_Text_TownSign:
LITTLEROOT TOWN
“A town that can't be shaded any hue.”
LittlerootTown_Text_WearTheseRunningShoe:
MOM: {PLAYER}! {PLAYER}! Did you
introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?

Oh! What an adorable POKéMON!
You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!

You're your father's child, all right.
You look good together with POKéMON!

Here, honey! If you're going out on an
adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.
They'll put a zip in your step!
LittlerootTown_Text_YouSavedBirch:
You saved PROF. BIRCH!
I'm so glad!
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Defeat:
I'm always late for training sessions,
too!
I hate to say it, but I'm wimpy…
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1Intro:
When TEAM MAGMA has roll call, we get
important guarding assignments in
the order that we line up.

That's why I'm stuck off in this corner.
I'm always late to roll call!
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
Okay, I'll try to put a little more
effort into things from now on…
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Our leader told us to dig into
MT. CHIMNEY, so we dug and dug.

And in the course of digging, we came
across something that blew our minds!

Fuhahaha!
I'll tell you if you beat me!
MagmaHideout_1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
I won't tell you after all.
You'll find out when you get there!

It'd be better if you saved surprises
to the end, don't you think?
MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Defeat:
Aiyiyi…
My pride as a TEAM MAGMA member…
MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14Intro:
Only TEAM MAGMA members are supposed
to be in here!

But you're not dressed in TEAM MAGMA's
uniform…

You rouse my suspicion!
Battle with me!
MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt14PostBattl:
If you suffer from chills, you should
join TEAM MAGMA.
MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3Intro:
You don't really expect me to keep
my trap shut and let you waltz by me?
MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt3PostBattle:
Maybe it would've been better if I did
just let you go unchallenged…
MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt4PostBattle:
Do I really need to keep running
around in a circle?
MagmaHideout_2F_1R_Text_Grunt5PostBattle: Actually, I'm no expert at battling…
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15Intro:
I don't have a bone to pick with you.
I'm just following orders!
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt15PostBattl:
We dug up something beyond belief!
And, we got the BLUE ORB!

All that's left is for our leader to…
Fufufu… Fwahahaha!
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Defeat:
Yeah, I really may not be right for
TEAM MAGMA…
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6Intro:
I can't stand heat. Maybe I should've
joined TEAM AQUA instead…
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt6PostBattle:
Don't you get lonely for the sea
being in a place like this?
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Defeat:
You're a fiery battler.
Just like a volcano!
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7Intro: You can hear tremors here sometimes.

Could it be the volcano rattling?
Or is it GROU…
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt7PostBattle:
You just happened to win this time,
but that doesn't matter.

TEAM MAGMA's goal is about to be
reached!
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8Intro:
One of our guys was freaking out that
he lost his MAGMA EMBLEM…

Wait a minute!
Was it you who found it?
MagmaHideout_2F_2R_Text_Grunt8PostBattle:
I'm getting this feeling that our plan
is going to end in failure…
MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Defeat:
Oh, no!
You're not to be trusted at all!
MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16Intro:
We joined so we can help our leader
achieve his fantastic vision.

I don't care if you're with TEAM AQUA
or if you're just some kid passing by.

No one interferes with us and gets
away with it!
MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt16PostBattl:
Listen to me.
TEAM MAGMA is right!

Don't listen to TEAM AQUA.
Don't believe their lies!
MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9Intro:
What did I do to deserve this guard
posting?
My left ear is burning up!
MagmaHideout_3F_1R_Text_Grunt9PostBattle:
Do you think it's odd that we're wearing
hoods in this magma-filled volcano?
MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Defeat:
Yeah, I think we are doing something
wrong somehow.
MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10Intro:
I understand everything our leader
says. But you know what?

Doing stuff like digging up a super-
ancient POKéMON and ripping off
someone's METEORITE…

I think we're going a little too far.
What do you think?
MagmaHideout_3F_2R_Text_Grunt10PostBattl: You know, losing to you cleared my mind.

The next time I see our leader,
I'm going to ask him about what we do.
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Defeat:
I guess it's impossible to win if one
doesn't have a calm mind…
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11Intro:
I want to see GROUDON, too, but they
won't let me see even its tail…
It's got me feeling really frustrated.

Oh, no!
I blabbed about GROUDON!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt11PostBattle: I wonder if GROUDON even has a tail?
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Defeat:
Grrr…
I've come so far, but now this?
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12Intro:
Fuhahaha!
Soon! Very soon!
Our grand objective will be achieved!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt12PostBattle:
MAXIE, sir!
An intruder is headed your way!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Defeat: Was I that easy to knock down?
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_Grunt13Intro:
You're not finished yet!
You're not getting by me easily!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieAwakenGroudon:
Nothing could awaken you from your
sleep bathed in magma…

This BLUE ORB is what you sought.
Wasn't it?

I have brought you the BLUE ORB.
Let its shine awaken you!

And show me…
Show me the full extent of your power!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieDefeat:
What makes you so adept at handling
POKéMON?
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieGroudonWhatsWr: Wasn't the BLUE ORB the key?
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieImGoingAfterGr:
MAXIE: There has to be some reason
why GROUDON fled…

That's what you're trying to say,
aren't you?

Humph…
You think I didn't know that?

With GROUDON gone, there is no longer
any need for this blasted volcano.

I am going after GROUDON, so this
is where we part!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_MaxieOhItWasYou: MAXIE: Oh, so it was you?

I've seen you poking around uninvited
here and there…

I get it now!
You must have pulled a cheap stunt!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaIntro:
Hehehe!
You made it this far, so I'll tell you!

That's right!
Up ahead, GROUDON is sleeping!

MAXIE went to GROUDON just seconds
ago!

It's going to awaken real soon!
Hehe! Hehehe!
MagmaHideout_4F_Text_TabithaPostBattle:
…And while you wasted time with me,
MAXIE should have awakened GROUDON…

I've been getting healthier and
more physically fit.

I hope I can become a TRAINER like
you soon, {PLAYER}!
MatchCall_Text_Wally2:
After RUSTURF TUNNEL went
through, WANDA's been very happy!
MatchCall_Text_Wally3:
I… I left my uncle's place in
VERDANTURF without telling anyone.
I wonder if he's furious with me…

{PLAYER}, you understand how
I feel, don't you?
MatchCall_Text_Wally4: The world of TRAINERS is amazing!

When I have my POKéMON with me,
all sorts of people say hi!

It's as if everyone's getting
connected through POKéMON!
MatchCall_Text_Wally5:
WALLY: {PLAYER}? It's awesome!
That RALTS we caught together?
It evolved, {PLAYER}!

Oh, but I shouldn't get a big head
like that!

After all, it's the POKéMON that
should be praised!
MatchCall_Text_Wally6:
WALLY appears to be out of
the POKéNAV's service area…
MatchCall_Text_Wally7:
Before I met you, I hardly ever
left my house…

But now, I'm on an adventure with
my very own POKéMON…
MatchCall_Text_Wattson_PostRematch:
A battle with you is always charged
with shocking power!
MatchCall_Text_Wattson_Preparing:
After you left, I've been redoing
my training from scratch.

I'd say I could use a wee bit more
time to reopen my GYM.

You'll have to wait till then!
Wahahahaha!
MatchCall_Text_Wattson_PreparingPostGame:
You've really done it, haven't you?
I've been getting word about you!

It seems I need to retrain some
more still.

I'd say I could use a wee bit more
time to reopen my GYM.

You'll have to wait till then!
Wahahahaha!
MatchCall_Text_Wattson_RematchReady:
WATTSON: Oh, it's you!
My GYM's ready!
MatchCall_Text_Winona_PostRematch:
WINONA: {PLAYER}…
Though I have lost, my wings will
never break.

Yes, in exactly the same way that
you never lost sight of your dream.
MatchCall_Text_Winona_Preparing:
Thanks to our battle, I've come
to understand my weak points!

When I reopen the GYM, I won't go
down in defeat again!
MatchCall_Text_Winona_PreparingPostGame:
News about the new CHAMPION
has reached us in FORTREE!

But… The next time we battle,
it's not going to end the same way.
MatchCall_Text_Winona_RematchReady:
WINONA: Is this {PLAYER}?
Our GYM is back in operation!
We're waiting for you in FORTREE!
MatchCall_WildBattleText1:
I saw this {STR_VAR_2} a while back
but I couldn't catch it.

It was so close, too!
Well, see you again!
MatchCall_WildBattleText10:
Listen, I came within a whisker of
catching this {STR_VAR_2}…
But, it gave me the slip…

I need to try harder.
See you around.
MatchCall_WildBattleText11:
Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
This is {STR_VAR_1}.
How are things with you?

I tried to catch a wild {STR_VAR_2}
earlier, but it managed to flee.
MatchCall_WildBattleText12:
Hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
It's me, {STR_VAR_1}.
Are you still catching POKéMON?

I've been trying to catch them
myself, but it's not so easy.
The way of POKéMON is deep!
MatchCall_WildBattleText13:
Ah, hello, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
This is {STR_VAR_1}!
Have you been catching POKéMON?

I've been trying to catch them
myself, but with little success.
The way of POKéMON is deep!
MatchCall_WildBattleText14:
Oh, hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how do you do?
This is {STR_VAR_1}.

Just now, I tried to catch a cute
{STR_VAR_2}.

It got away, though!
Oh, you bet I was disappointed!
MatchCall_WildBattleText15:
I've been thinking about trying
to catch me some POKéMON.

But I can't seem to find any.
It's a real puzzler for me!

I'm at my wit's end!
See you around!
MatchCall_WildBattleText2:
I tried to catch a nice {STR_VAR_2}
a little while ago.

But, it got away.
I was sure disappointed!
MatchCall_WildBattleText3:
I just took a shot at catching
this {STR_VAR_2}, but it took off.
I came oh so close, too!

It spoiled my day…
All right, see you!
MatchCall_WildBattleText4:
You know the POKéMON {STR_VAR_2}?
I came close to getting one.

It was just a while back.
I thought I had it but it escaped.

If I see it again, I'll get it for
sure, though.
MatchCall_WildBattleText5:
Hiya, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's {STR_VAR_1}.
Catching any POKéMON lately?

A little while ago I came close to
nabbing one, but it got loose.
MatchCall_WildBattleText6:
Hey, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
{STR_VAR_1} here.
Caught any POKéMON lately?

I nearly nabbed one the other day.
But it evaded me somehow.
MatchCall_WildBattleText7:
Oh, wait! Wait!
I can catch this {STR_VAR_2}…

Aaarrrgh! It bolted loose!
That wasn't just close!
MatchCall_WildBattleText8:
Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}, how do you do?
This is {STR_VAR_1} speaking.

Have you had success catching
POKéMON lately?

I came very close a little while
ago, but my target got free.

I need to try harder!
See you again!
MatchCall_WildBattleText9:
So? Are you getting more POKéMON
together?

I'm having a rotten time of it!
They all get away from me!
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_AcroHandbookW: It's a handbook on the ACRO BIKE.
Which page do you want to read?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_BunnyHops:
Keeping the B Button pressed,
your BIKE can hop on the spot.
This technique is called a bunny hop.
You can ride while hopping, too.
Want to read a different page?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ComeBackToSwi:
RYDEL: If you get the urge to switch
BIKES, just come see me!
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_DidYouComeFro:
RYDEL: Your RUNNING SHOES…
They're awfully filthy.
Did you come from far away?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedAcro:
{PLAYER} got the ACRO BIKE exchanged
for a MACH BIKE.
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedMach:
{PLAYER} got the MACH BIKE exchanged
for an ACRO BIKE.
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_ExplainBikesC:
You're saying that you came all this
way from LITTLEROOT?

If you had one of my BIKES, you could
go anywhere easily while feeling the
gentle caress of the wind!

I'll tell you what!
I'll give you a BIKE!

I forgot to tell you that there are
two kinds of BIKES!

They are the MACH BIKE and
the ACRO BIKE!

The MACH BIKE is for cyclists who want
to feel the wind with their bodies!

And an ACRO BIKE is for those who
prefer technical rides!

I'm a real sweetheart, so you can
have whichever one you like!
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_GuessYouDontN:
Then, I guess you have no need for
any of my BIKES.
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HandbooksAreI:
I'm learning about BIKES while
I work here.

If you need advice on how to ride your
BIKE, there're a couple handbooks in
the back.
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HappyYouLikeI:
RYDEL: Good, good!
I'm happy that you like it!
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToRideMach:
A BIKE moves in the direction that
the + Control Pad is pressed.
It will speed up once it gets rolling.

To stop, release the + Control Pad.
The BIKE will slow to a stop.
Want to read a different page?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_HowToTurnMach:
A MACH BIKE is speedy, but it can't
stop very quickly.

It gets a little tricky to get around
a corner.

Release the + Control Pad a little
before the corner and slow down.
Want to read a different page?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_IllSwitchBike:
RYDEL: Okay, no problem!
I'll switch BIKES for you!
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Jumps:
Press the B Button and the + Control
Pad at the same time to jump.

Press the + Control Pad to the side
to jump sideways.

Press it backwards to make the BIKE
change directions while jumping.
Want to read a different page?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_MachHandbookW: It's a handbook on the MACH BIKE.
Which page do you want to read?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_OhYourBikeIsI:
Oh? What happened to that BIKE
I gave you?
Oh, I get it, you stored it using your PC.

Well, take it out of PC storage,
and I'll be happy to exchange it!

May the wind always be at your back
on your adventure!
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_RydelGreeting:
Well, well, what have we here?
A most energetic customer!

Me? You may call me RYDEL.
I'm the owner of this cycle shop.
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_SandySlopes:
There are small sandy slopes
throughout the HOENN region.

The loose, crumbly sand makes it
impossible to climb normally.

But if you have a MACH BIKE, you can
zip up a sandy slope.
Want to read a different page?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_WantToSwitchB:
RYDEL: Oh? Were you thinking about
switching BIKES?
MauvilleCity_BikeShop_Text_Wheelies:
Press the B Button while riding,
and the front wheel lifts up.

You can zip around with the front
wheel up using the + Control Pad.
This technique is called a wheelie.
Want to read a different page?
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantCarryAn: Oh, you can't carry any more than that.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantPlayWit:
You can't play if you don't have
a COIN CASE.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CantWinJack:
There's a prize I want, but I can't win
the jackpot.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsF:
Oh?
Your COIN CASE is full.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinsAreNee:
COINS are needed to play here
in the GAME CORNER.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DifficultTo:
It's very difficult to make it stop
right on “7.”

If it stops on “7” during the REEL TIME
bonus game, you'll receive extra COINS.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontBeNegat:
Oh, don't be so negative!
You can have this!
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveEno:
Um… You don't appear to have
enough money…
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_DontNeedCoi:
Oh… You don't need COINS, then?
Good luck on your adventure!
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_EasyToLoseT:
It's easy to lose track of time in here. 
I should get back to work.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ExchangeCoi:
You can exchange your COINS for
prizes here.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_GotTwoOfSam:
I made a mistake and got two of
the same DOLLS.
Would you like one of them?
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_HeresSomeSl:
Here's some information for you
about the SLOTS.

The more lightning bolts you stock,
the more REEL TIME chances you get.

In a game with the maximum five
REEL TIME chances…

It is possible to receive four regular
bonuses, then a big bonus.

That would total 660 COINS, but it's
very difficult to get.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_LuckOnlyLas:
My luck can only last so long.
This is too much for me.
Here, take some COINS!
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_MauvilleSom: For me, it's the GAME CORNER.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedCoinCas:
Okay, you wanted some COINS for
the games?

But you don't have a COIN CASE for
stowing the COINS.

Hey, kid, if you want to play here,
you need a COIN CASE.

I think the young lady next door
had one. Go see her!
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_NoRoomForPl:
There isn't any room available for
placing {STR_VAR_1}.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_OhIsThatSo:
Oh, is that so? 
You need to save some COINS before
coming back here.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteOnl:
This ROULETTE thing…
It's rather demanding.
Win or lose, it's only by luck.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_RouletteTab:
The ROULETTE tables have different
rates.

Check your COINS if you're going to
pick a table.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_SendToYourH:
Thank you!
We'll send it to your PC at home.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_ThankYouHer:
Thank you very much!
Here are your COINS!
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_UpTo3CoinsC:
Up to three COINS can be used to play
the SLOTS.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_WereYouLook:
It's ¥1000 for 50 COINS.
Would you like some?
MauvilleCity_GameCorner_Text_YouWantItBu:
Huh?
You want it, but not right now?
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_AngeloPostBattle:
MAUVILLE GYM's WATTSON has a shiny
forehead. It makes me happy!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenIntro:
This GYM's got puzzles!
Isn't it fun?
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_BenPostBattle:
WATTSON says he likes setting up
little traps with switches.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainDynamoBadge:
With the DYNAMO BADGE, POKéMON can
use ROCK SMASH out of battle.

And, it will make your POKéMON a little
bit faster, too.

Hmm…
You should take this, too!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ExplainShockWave: That TM34 there contains SHOCK WAVE.

It's a trustworthy move that never
misses! You can count on it!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

WATTSON, the LEADER of MAUVILLE
GYM, uses ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.

If you challenge him with WATER-type
POKéMON, he'll zap them! Bzzt!

And, he's put in switch-controlled
doors all over his GYM! Eccentric!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor:
Whoa, you're electrifying!
You've powered the door open!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkDefeat:
That was plugged in, amped up,
over-driven electric, man!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro:
My electric soul, it'll shatter your
dreams whole, whoa-yeahah!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle:
POKéMON and rock, it's all about heart,
whoa-yeah!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedDynamoBadg:
{PLAYER} received the DYNAMO BADGE
from WATTSON.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredWattson:
Registered GYM LEADER WATTSON
in the POKéNAV.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro:
I trained under WATTSON!
There ain't no way I'll lose easily!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle:
WATTSON, our GYM LEADER, has been
around for a long, long time.

He was battling even before your
daddy was born, that tough coot.
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianIntro:
With my charm and my POKéMON's moves,
you'll be shocked!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_VivianPostBattle:
I've heard that MAUVILLE was founded
by WATTSON.

He was a TRAINER long before we
became TRAINERS.
He must know all sorts of things!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonDefeat:
You ended up giving me a thrill!
Take this BADGE!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonGoForthAndE:
Wahahahah!
Go forth and endeavor, youngster!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonIntro:
I've given up on my plans to convert
the city, I have.

And so, I put my time into making
door traps in my GYM.
Oh? Now, what are you doing here?

What's that? You say you've gotten
past all my rigged doors?

Then, I, WATTSON, the LEADER of
MAUVILLE GYM, shall electrify you!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostBattle:
I swell with optimism, seeing a promising
young TRAINER like you!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPostRematch:
WATTSON: We'll have to recharge our
batteries again.

When we're fully charged up, we'll
gladly accept your challenge.

So, come back again sometime,
won't you?
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonPreRematch:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.
You want to battle my POKéMON!

I'll make sparks fly from you!
Don't say I didn't warn you!
MauvilleCity_Gym_Text_WattsonRematchNeed:
WATTSON: Ah-ha! Here at last!
I know what you want.
You want to battle my POKéMON!

Oops! Wait!
You've only one POKéMON with you!

Come see me with two or more
POKéMON, all right?
MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ExplainRockSmas:
If you come across large boulders
that block your path…

Well, use that HM move and smash
them right out of your way!

Yes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say!
Woohoo!
MauvilleCity_House1_Text_ImRockSmashDude:
I hear people call me the ROCK SMASH
GUY, but I find that sort of degrading.

I think I deserve a bit more respect,
like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE.

Anyways, your POKéMON look pretty
strong.

I like that!
Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!
MauvilleCity_House1_Text_MonCanFlyOutOfS:
Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON
could come flying out of hiding.
MauvilleCity_House2_Text_BuyHarborMailAt:
If I had a BIKE, it'd be easy to cycle to
SLATEPORT for some shopping.

I'd be able to buy HARBOR MAIL at the
POKéMON MART in SLATEPORT…
MauvilleCity_House2_Text_IllTradeYouCoin:
Oh, I'm so happy!
Okay, I'll trade you a COIN CASE!
MauvilleCity_House2_Text_ThatsDisappoint:
A COIN CASE is needed for the
GAME CORNER.
MauvilleCity_House2_Text_TradeHarborMail:
Oh! You have HARBOR MAIL?
Will you trade it for a COIN CASE?
MauvilleCity_House2_Text_UseCoinCaseAtGa:
That COIN CASE can be used
at the GAME CORNER.
MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_DecisionsDetermin:
Use a certain move, or use an item
instead…

The TRAINER's decisions determine how
battles turn out, I think.
MauvilleCity_Mart_Text_ItemsToTemporaril:
There are items that temporarily
elevate the stats of POKéMON.

The ones I know you use in battle
are X ATTACK and X DEFEND…

I do believe that there are others
like them.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BardF:
Oh…
You've left me feeling the blues…

Oh…
You've left me feeling the blues…
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Battl:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER took the BATTLE TOWER
challenge {STR_VAR_1} times!

{STR_VAR_3} is a TRAINER who aspires
for excellence in the BATTLE TOWER!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Berri:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

{STR_VAR_3} is a legendary lover of
BERRIES!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BikeT:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

{STR_VAR_3} must love BIKES deeply
and passionately!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantT:
Oops! Sorry! That's a really rare
piece of decoration.
I can't trade that one away!
Can I interest you in something else?
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Check:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER checked the time
{STR_VAR_1} times!

{STR_VAR_3} must be a punctual TRAINER
who's conscious of the time.

This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER checked a POKéDEX
{STR_VAR_1} times!

{STR_VAR_3} must love inspecting
POKéMON in a POKéDEX!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Could:
It gets me thinking, could there be
other TRAINERS with more impressive
legends awaiting discovery?
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EggsH:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER hatched {STR_VAR_1} POKéMON
from EGGS!

{STR_VAR_3} is a legendary warmer
of EGGS!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Enter:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

{STR_VAR_3} must love showing off
POKéMON to others!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Fishi:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER caught
{STR_VAR_1} POKéMON while fishing!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Giddy:
Oh…
You've left me feeling the blues…
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveY:
Then tell me, have you any tales that
are even remotely legendary?

What's it mean? Well…
Ask your daddy or mommy, okay?
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearA:
Incidentally… Would you care to hear
another legendary tale?
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearM:
I'm GIDDY!
I have a scintillating story for you!
Would you like to hear my story?
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HotSp:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER bathed in hot springs
{STR_VAR_1} times!

{STR_VAR_3} must be a TRAINER with
baby-smooth skin!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IAlre:
But, hey, I taught you what's hip and
happening already.

I'd like to spread the good word to
other folks.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IKnow:
But, I know of no legendary TRAINERS.
Hence, I know no tales.

Where does one find a TRAINER worthy
of a legendary tale?
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IWish:
I wish more people would be interested
in hearing my epic tales of legendary
TRAINERS.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IllSi:
Okay! That's it, then.
I'll sing this song for a while.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Inter:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

{STR_VAR_3} must be a TRAINER who's
attracting much attention!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IveGo:
But, hey, you already know a lot about
what's hip and happening.
I've got nothing new to teach you!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Ledge:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER jumped down ledges
{STR_VAR_1} times!

If there's a ledge to be jumped,
{STR_VAR_3} can't ignore it!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LetMe:
Thank you kindly!
Let me sing it for you.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MadeP:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

There is none better at using a BERRY
BLENDER than {STR_VAR_3}!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManOv:
That man over there, he says weird
things!

He's funny in a weird way.
I doubt I'll forget about him!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Moved:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

This TRAINER moved the SECRET BASE
{STR_VAR_1} times!

{STR_VAR_3} is a TRAINER who loves
to move houses often!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MyDat:
When I accessed the RECORD CORNER,
the data for what's hot in DEWFORD
got updated.

Now that bit of data is the same
as my friend's!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NotWo:
I wish you would bring me news worthy
of being called a legend.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnceB:
That decorative item once belonged
to {STR_VAR_1}.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PickA:
If you see any decorative item that
you want of mine, speak up.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PickT:
Okay, pick the decoration that you'll
trade to me.
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokem:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

{STR_VAR_3} is a legendary catcher of
wild POKéMON!

This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

{STR_VAR_3} is the ultimate evolver
of POKéMON!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Recei:
This is a tale of a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_3}.

{STR_VAR_3} must be a TRAINER who
loves to collect RIBBONS!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Recor:
A RECORD CORNER opened upstairs in
the POKéMON CENTER.

I don't know what it's about, but it
sounds fun. I'll go check it out!
MauvilleCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Reste:

you have to nurse it back to health.

and make them battle. That isn't what
being a real TRAINER is about.

battle with him just this once?

any reason the way he is now.

down on yourself.

stronger and stronger?

Everyone's waiting for you.

anytime, {PLAYER}!

a battle with me?

rope with the A Button.

or less may participate.

or fly are not good at jumping.

around 28 inches or less.

POKéMON that can't jump.

swim, burrow, or fly.

please tell the old man beside me.

Wireless Communication?
Can you wait just a little bit?

of sync, too!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_BlakeIntro:
Fufufufu… Watch me levitate a POKé
BALL telekinetically!

psychically. But this dust bunny…

No, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!

of youth!

you not patronize me.

TATE: That TM04 contains…
LIZA: CALM MIND!

TATE: It raises SP. ATK and…
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!

TATE: It's a move that's perfect…
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!

TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the
SP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.

LIZA: It also lets you use the HM move
DIVE outside of battle.
TATE: You should also take this, too.

The GYM LEADERS here use
PSYCHIC-type POKéMON.

If you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,
they'll inflict horrible damage!

Plus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.

If you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with your
POKéMON. Go for it!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor:
Wow, you're astounding!
You're one great TRAINER!

on yourself.

It's not that you're weak--I'm just
too strong!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_HannahPostBattle:
I'm not going to get down on myself for
losing. I just need to train harder.

horrifying time!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_KathleenPostBattle:
Your vitality is contagious!
Get away from me quickly!

strong?

You're not getting through to the end!

not suitable for the PSYCHIC type!
The way you battle is somehow brutal!

learned!

worked diligently.

For those who lazed idly, there is
only despair at the end.

the PSYCHIC type can be.

however b-badly.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasIntro:
Wroooar! Have a taste of my super
POKéMON hard-battling power!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_NicholasPostBattle:
All right! I think I'll develop a special
invincible POKéMON power next.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonDefeat:
I lost!
I must temper my spirit again!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro:
Battles hinge on the strength of your
spirit! The weak-spirited will never win!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle:
The indecisive lose.
That's my warning to you.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedMindBadge:
{PLAYER} received the MIND BADGE
from TATE and LIZA.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredTateAndL:
Registered GYM LEADERS TATE & LIZA
in the POKéNAV.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaIntro:
I see it…
I see your future…

If you can beat me, I will tell you
your future!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SamanthaPostBattle:
You will wage a terrifically intense
battle with our GYM LEADERS…

The result…
You won't hear it from me!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaDefeat:
What you do…
It horrifies me…
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaIntro:
Even at the risk of life, I will win
this battle!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_SylviaPostBattle:
It won't be my fault if something
horrible befalls you…
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaDefeat:
TATE: What?! Our combination…
LIZA: Was shattered!

TATE: It can't be helped. You've won…
LIZA: So, in recognition, take this.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaIntro:
TATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?

TATE: We're twins!
LIZA: We're twins!

TATE: We don't need to talk because…
LIZA: We can each determine what…

TATE: The other is thinking…
LIZA: All in our minds!

TATE: This combination of ours…
LIZA: Can you beat it?
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaNeedTwo: LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?

TATE: Oops, you have only one…
LIZA: POKéMON that can battle.
TATE: We can't battle that way!

LIZA: If you want to challenge us,
bring some more POKéMON.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostBat:
TATE: Looks like the bond between you
and your POKéMON is far stronger than
the bond that we share as twins.

LIZA: You will become even stronger!
We've battled you, so we know.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPostRem:
TATE: You can knock us down,
but we'll never stay down!

LIZA: Because the two of us,
we always support each other!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaPreRema:
TATE: By changing the party's mix…
LIZA: The battle style changes.

TATE: But me…
LIZA: But me…

TATE: I'll always be with LIZA!
LIZA: I'll always be with TATE!

TATE: Our combination…
LIZA: We'll show you again and again!
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_TateAndLizaRematch:
TATE: You and your POKéMON…
LIZA: It's as if you were siblings!

TATE: You're back again…
LIZA: You're back again…

TATE: To give us a rematch.
LIZA: To give us a rematch.

TATE: But…
LIZA: For our match…

TATE: You brought just one POKéMON!
LIZA: You brought just one POKéMON!

TATE: We need you to bring at least…
LIZA: Two POKéMON when you come back.
MossdeepCity_Gym_Text_VirgilPostBattle:
If there are prodigies in the world,
then our GYM LEADERS are them!

However, you may be even more talented
than them…
MossdeepCity_House1_Text_DoesntLikeOrDis:
It doesn't appear to like or dislike
any {POKEBLOCK}S.
MossdeepCity_House1_Text_HusbandCanTellP:
My husband can tell what kind of
{POKEBLOCK}S a POKéMON likes at a glance.
MossdeepCity_House1_Text_ItLikesXPokeblo:
No, I'm positive of it! It definitely
likes {STR_VAR_1}S!
MossdeepCity_House2_Text_PokemonCarriesM:
Even though I can't see my friend in
FORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL
back and forth for us.

I'm not lonesome, even though we're
apart.
MossdeepCity_House2_Text_SisterMailsBoyf:
My little sister exchanges MAIL with
her boyfriend in FORTREE.
I don't envy her one bit at all.
MossdeepCity_House3_Text_DontYouLikeToFi:
Hunh?
Don't you like to fish?
MossdeepCity_House3_Text_GoAfterSeafloor:
Go after the seafloor POKéMON with
your SUPER ROD.
MossdeepCity_House3_Text_SuperRodIsSuper:
You bet, you bet!
After all, a SUPER ROD is really super!
MossdeepCity_House3_Text_TryDroppingRodI:
If there's any water, try dropping in
your ROD and see what bites!
MossdeepCity_House3_Text_YouWantSuperRod:
Hey there, TRAINER!
A SUPER ROD really is super!

Say all you want, but this baby can
catch POKéMON off the seafloor!

What do you think?
You want it, don't you?
MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToF:
My little brother says he likes to go
find people's SECRET BASES.
MossdeepCity_House4_Text_BrotherLikesToV:
My little brother says he likes to
visit people's SECRET BASES and have
POKéMON battles.
MossdeepCity_House4_Text_MakeSecretBase:
You should make a SECRET BASE
somewhere. I'll go find it!
MossdeepCity_House4_Text_YouMadeSecretBa:
Was it you who made a SECRET BASE
near {STR_VAR_1}?
MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelLastsLong: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.

Out of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts
the longest.
MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_NetAndDiveBallsRa:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.

A NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.

A DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON
at the bottom of the sea.
MossdeepCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsFantastic:
Give it to a fainted POKéMON,
and the POKéMON will arise.

But be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore
the used-up PP of moves.
MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Abili:
Depending on the special abilities of
POKéMON, some moves might change
or not work at all.
MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymLe:
The GYM LEADERS in this town are
a formidable duo.

Their combination attacks are, like,
excellent and wow!
MossdeepCity_PokemonCenter_2F_Text_Woman:
If I win a whole lot of link battles
and show everyone how good I am,
I might get a fan following!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_AquaSho:
TEAM AQUA should take care of
TEAM MAGMA!

But if they did that, TEAM AQUA will
become bold and brazen, won't they?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_CantStr:
With TEAM MAGMA around, I guess
strolls on the beach aren't safe.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_DidPoke:
Some people claim that POKéMON came
from space. Could it be true?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_FoundTh:
I was taking a stroll down the beach
when I found this.

It's not anything I need, so you can
have it.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1D:
Grrr…
We should've used sneaky treachery…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1I:
We gave you fair warning!
There's nothing sneaky about us!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt1P:
Okay, I get it already! The next time,
we'll come unannounced.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2I:
Our leader said no one, but no one,
gets past me!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt2P:
Please, tell our leader that
I never abandoned my post.
That I stayed to the bitter end…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3I:
As promised, we've come for
the rocket fuel!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt3P:
Don't think you're on a roll just
because you've beaten me!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4D:
Please, can you spare some fuel?
Even a chintzy cup will do!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4I:
The rocket fuel the SPACE CENTER has
in storage--that's what we're after.
We mean to take every last bit of it!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Grunt4P:
What are we going to do with
the rocket fuel?

How would I know?
Ask our leader upstairs!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Haywire:
I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

I know that things are a little
haywire right now, but…

The rocket launched safely!
That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_HoennFa:
The HOENN region has been famous for 
its meteor showers for a long time.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaCa:
TEAM MAGMA can't be allowed to steal
the rocket fuel.

Oh, by the way, you can have this stone
I found on the beach.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaHa:
Those MAGMA thugs have their sights
set on our SPACE CENTER.

But we can't allow anything that minor
to interfere with our rocket launch!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaIn:
“To the staff of the SPACE CENTER:
How are you? We are doing fine.

“We will soon visit you to take your
rocket fuel.

“Please don't try to stop us.
We will take the fuel no matter what.

“Let there be more land!
                                          TEAM MAGMA”
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_MagmaWa:
A giant chunk of metal bursts through
the skies and flies into space…

But TEAM MAGMA wants to spoil
that dream of mine!
I'm not having any of that!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_RocketL:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.

Even if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.

Despite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Rockets:
A giant chunk of metal bursts through
the skies and flies into space…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_StevenM:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, have you read that
proclamation already?

TEAM MAGMA is coming after the rocket
fuel on this island.

I don't know what they'd need it for,
but they can't be allowed to take it.

I'll keep an eye on things for
a while longer.

In the meantime, why don't you go
check out the town?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_1F_Text_Success:
The rocket launched safely!
That's successful launch no. {STR_VAR_1}!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_DoesMag:
TEAM MAGMA…
Do they want to go to space, too?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_GoodAns:
Good answer!
That's what a smart person'll do!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5I:
A reckless go-getter, are you?
Okay, I'll go first!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt5P:
Are we being useful to our leader
at all?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6I:
It's too soon to be relieved!
I'm up next!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt6P:
Three of us here, and look at the sorry
mess we got ourselves into.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7D:
We should've taken a break…
That's what we should've done…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7I:
I bet you want to take a break.
But I'm not about to let you do that!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Grunt7P:
We three losing like this…
We look worse than usual by triple!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_JustWan:
All I want…
I just want to expand the land mass…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MagmaCa:
If TEAM MAGMA takes the rocket fuel,
I won't be able to go to space!

They can't be allowed to get away
with such an outrage!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieDo:
MAXIE: Clear out of the way!
Don't you dare interfere!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieUs:
MAXIE: Fufufu… Since you're so
curious, you deserve an explanation.

We're going to jettison the entire
load into MT. CHIMNEY!

With GROUDON gone, we have no need
for that slag heap of a mountain!

So we'll use the fuel's power to make
the volcano erupt!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_MaxieWe:
MAXIE: We failed to make the volcano
erupt…

We failed to control GROUDON after
we had awoken it…

Is our goal to expand the land
misguided?

If…
If we, TEAM MAGMA, are wrong…
… … … … … …

Then might TEAM AQUA's goal to expand
the sea also be equally misguided?

MAXIE: All right…
We will give up on the fuel…

There appear to be more important
matters that I must examine…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Mossdee:
MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,
and its winds are stable.

It's an ideal location for launching
rockets.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenA:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
You're going to help me?

Let's go into battle together!
Are you ready?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenH:
STEVEN: Then, hurry!
Get ready quickly!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenT:
STEVEN: Whew, that was too tense.
{PLAYER}{KUN}, thank you.

I have something to give you as
thanks for your support.

Please come see me at home
after this.

Oh, yes, I don't live in RUSTBORO CITY.
I live right here on this island.
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_StevenW:
What's the point of stealing rocket
fuel?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WellTak:
We come all the way here to get some
fuel, and we're interfered with again!

If you're going to mess with us too,
we'll take care of you at the same time!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WhyWoul:
Why would TEAM MAGMA want to steal
our rocket fuel in the first place?
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_WishOrd:
I wish ordinary people could go into
space one day…
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_Wouldve:
If only I was a little younger, I would
have liked being an astronaut…

No… It's not too late!
I can and will try!
MossdeepCity_SpaceCenter_2F_Text_YoureOu:
You're outnumbered three to one,
but you still want to take us on?
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Collectio:
It's a collection of rare rocks and
stones assembled by STEVEN.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_ExplainDi:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.

Use DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.

When you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.

In some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LeftPokeB:
{PLAYER} left the POKé BALL where
it was.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_LetterFro:
I've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.

I don't plan to return home for some
time.
I have a favor to ask of you.

I want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.

Inside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_NoSpaceFo: There is no space for another POKéMON.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_Underwate:
STEVEN: Apparently, there's an
underwater cavern between
MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.

You know, the one that CAPT. STERN
found in his submarine.
MossdeepCity_StevensHouse_Text_YouveEarn:
As you can see, there's not much here,
but this is my home.
Thank you for all that you've done.

This is my token of appreciation.
It's the HIDDEN MACHINE DIVE.

No need to be shy--you've earned
this HM.
MossdeepCity_Text_FeelReliefOnLand:
I'm a SAILOR, so the sea's obviously
more important to me.

But you know? When I get back on land
after a long voyage, I do feel relief!
MossdeepCity_Text_GymSign:
MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADERS: LIZA & TATE
MossdeepCity_Text_LifeNeedsSeaToLive:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.

Life, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.

And the sea is always connected to
the land.
Yes, like the very shoreline here.
MossdeepCity_Text_MossdeepTargetedByMagm:
I heard from a SAILOR buddy that
TEAM AQUA set up shop in LILYCOVE.

I also heard that someone came along
and wiped the floor with them!

But MOSSDEEP here's been targeted
by that TEAM MAGMA.

If you want to know what they're up to,
go visit the SPACE CENTER.
MossdeepCity_Text_NiceIfWorldCoveredByFl:
If the whole world was covered in
plants and flowers like this island?
MossdeepCity_Text_ScottSomethingWrongWit:
SCOTT: {PLAYER}{KUN}, feeling good?
I'm doing great!

I'd heard MOSSDEEP's GYM LEADER is
pretty strong, so I decided to come
take a look-see for myself.

But there's something wrong about
this town.

People are going on about a warning
letter and the SPACE CENTER…

I don't think it concerns me in any
way, though.
MossdeepCity_Text_SootopolisNewGymLeader:
Ahh… It feels great letting the waves
wash over my feet…

Speaking of the waves, you know that
island city SOOTOPOLIS?

I think the GYM there had a new
LEADER come in.

People tell me the new LEADER once
mentored WALLACE.
MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterLaunchingRo:
The island's SPACE CENTER has been
launching huge rockets.
MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterReceivedLet:
The island's SPACE CENTER has been
launching huge rockets.

There's been some kind of an uproar
over a letter they received recently.
MossdeepCity_Text_SpaceCenterSign:
MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER
“The closest place to space.”
MossdeepCity_Text_SpecialSpaceCenterRock:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the SPACE CENTER.

They put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.

When you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?

I use a wish tag to make it happen.
That's what I do.
MossdeepCity_Text_StevensHouseOverThere: STEVEN's house is right over there!
MossdeepCity_Text_SurfExhilarating: A voyage on a ship is fine.

But crossing the sea with POKéMON
using SURF…

Now that's an exhilarating trip!
Wouldn't you agree, youngster?
MossdeepCity_Text_WailmerWatching:
Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild
WAILMER.

It's called, uh…
What was it now…
MossdeepCity_Text_WantKingsRockStevenGav:
I got this from STEVEN, but I don't
know what it's good for.

I think it's called KING'S ROCK.
Do you want it?
MossdeepCity_Text_WhatToDoWithWeirdRock:
Yeah, you think so, too! What are you
supposed to do with some weird rock?
MossdeepCity_Text_YouCanKeepIt:
Why would you want it?
You're weird.

You can keep it, but keep it a secret
from STEVEN.
MoveRelearner_Text_AnythingElse: Is there anything else I may do for you?
MoveRelearner_Text_CantTeachMoveToEgg:
Sorry…
But an Egg can't learn moves.
MoveRelearner_Text_CantTeachMoveToPkmn:
It doesn't appear as if I have any move
I can teach that Pokémon.
MoveRelearner_Text_ThankYouComeAgain:
Thank you for using our services.
Please come again!
MoveRelearner_Text_WouldLearnNewMoves:
Hi, I'm the Move Relearner.
Would you like to learn new moves?
MoveTutor_MimicDeclined:
Oh, boo! I wanted to teach MIMIC
to your POKéMON!
MoveTutor_MimicTeach:
I am also a young one, but I mimic
the styles and speech of the elderly
folks of this town.

What do you say, young one?
Would you agree to it if I were to
offer to teach the move MIMIC?
MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTaught:
I won't live for love anymore!
I'll become tough!
MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeTeach:
SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER is really
lovably admirable.

But that also means I have many
rivals for his attention.

He's got appeal with a DOUBLE-EDGE.
I couldn't even catch his eye.

Please, let me teach your POKéMON
the move DOUBLE-EDGE!
MoveTutor_Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon:
Okay, which POKéMON should I teach
DOUBLE-EDGE?
MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchDeclined:
Darn! You're even making fun of me?
Punch! Punch! Punch!
MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTaught:
I want you to win at the MOSSDEEP GYM
using that DYNAMICPUNCH!
MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchTeach:
I'm a FIGHTING-type TRAINER,
so I can't win at the MOSSDEEP GYM
no matter how hard I try!

Argh! Punch! Punch! Punch!
Punch! Punch! Punch!

What, don't look at me that way!
I'm only hitting the ground!

Or do you want me to teach your
POKéMON DYNAMICPUNCH?
MoveTutor_Text_DynamicPunchWhichMon:
What? You do? You're a good person!
Which POKéMON should I teach?
MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionDeclined:
Gaah! You're turning me down because
I live in the country?
MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTaught:
For a long time, I've taught POKéMON
how to use EXPLOSION, but I've yet
to ignite my own EXPLOSION…

Maybe it's because deep down,
I would rather stay here…
MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionTeach:
I don't intend to be going nowhere
fast in the sticks like this forever.

You watch me, I'll get out to the city
and become a huge hit.

Seriously, I'm going to cause
a huge EXPLOSION of popularity!

If you overheard that, I'll happily
teach EXPLOSION to your POKéMON!
MoveTutor_Text_ExplosionWhichMon:
Fine! An EXPLOSION it is!
Which POKéMON wants to blow up?
MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterDeclined: We're not on the same wavelength.
MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTaught:
I get a thrill watching to see if
the move keeps hitting in succession!
MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterTeach:
There's a move that gets stronger
when you keep using it in a row.

It's a BUG-type move, and it is
wickedly cool.

It's called FURY CUTTER.
Want me to teach it to a POKéMON?
MoveTutor_Text_FuryCutterWhichMon:
Yay!
Show me which POKéMON I should teach.
MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeDeclined:
Okay. I'll be here if you change
your mind.
MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTaught:
When a POKéMON waggles its finger
like a METRONOME, all sorts of nice
things happen.

Wouldn't it be nice if we could
use it, too?
MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeTeach:
I want all sorts of things!
But I used up my allowance…

Wouldn't it be nice if there were
a spell that made money appear when
you waggle a finger?

If you want, I can teach your POKéMON
the move METRONOME.

Money won't appear, but your POKéMON
will waggle a finger. Yes?
MoveTutor_Text_MetronomeWhichMon:
Okay! I'll teach it!
Which POKéMON should I teach?
MoveTutor_Text_MimicTaught: MIMIC is a move of great depth.

Could you execute it to perfection
as well as me…?
MoveTutor_Text_MimicWhichMon:
Fwofwo! And so I shall!
Let me see the POKéMON
you wish me to teach.
MoveTutor_Text_RolloutDeclined:
You don't need to be shy about it.
Let's roll!
MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTaught:
Rolling around in the grass makes me
happy. Come on, let's roll!
MoveTutor_Text_RolloutTeach:
Did you know that you can go from
here a long way in that direction
without changing direction?

I might even be able to roll
that way.

Do you think your POKéMON will
want to roll, too?

I can teach one the move ROLLOUT
if you'd like.
MoveTutor_Text_RolloutWhichMon:
Ehehe, sure thing! It'd be great if
the POKéMON looked like me.
MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkDeclined:
Oh, fine, fine. You want to stay awake
with HIDDEN POWER, too…
MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTaught:
I've never once gotten my wife's
coin trick right.

I would be happy if I got it right
even as I SLEEP TALK…
MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkTeach:
Humph! My wife relies on HIDDEN
POWER to stay awake.

She should just take a nap like I do,
and SLEEP TALK.

I can teach your POKéMON how to
SLEEP TALK instead. Interested?
MoveTutor_Text_SleepTalkWhichMon:
Ah, an appreciative child!
Which POKéMON should I teach?
MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteDeclined:
A POKéMON can make a copy of
itself using it, you know.
MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTaught:
We human beings should enjoy our
own lives to the utmost!
I hope you'll get that way, too!
MoveTutor_Text_SubstituteTeach:
When I see the wide world from up
here on the roof…

I think about how nice it would be
if there were more than just one me

MtChimney_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarR:

MtChimney_Text_LavaCookiesJust200:

It burns me up that they'd use such

I'll teach you the consequences of

MAXIE: But, enough.

Even without the METEORITE, if we

MtChimney_Text_MelissaPostBattle:
The heat of MT. CHIMNEY warms

MtChimney_Text_MeteoriteFittedOnMachine:

By amplifying its power with this

MtChimney_Text_SawyerDefeat: Oh, you're a real firebrand, too!

This is one fine mountain! Plenty of

I think I need a dip in LAVARIDGE
HOT SPRING with the locals!

MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchDefeat:
Gosh, you're still the same

MtChimney_Text_SawyerRematchIntro:
I'm happily surrounded by hot people

The way you battle…

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyDefeat:
Oh, my goodness.
Now, aren't you something!

I've been to the hot springs and

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyPostRematch:
Perhaps your heart has become one

MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRegister:
Thank you, child. It was fun, as if

Please, come see me again for
a rematch.
MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchDefeat:
Oh, my goodness.
Now, aren't you something!
MtChimney_Text_ShelbyRematchIntro:
If you can mesh your heart with those

able to achieve great things.

Since I bathed in the hot springs,

MtChimney_Text_ShirleyPostBattle:
I'll have to take another dip in the
hot springs. Want to join me?
MtChimney_Text_TabithaDefeat:
Even though I've lost, if our leader
awakens that thing…

I've already delivered the METEORITE

MtChimney_Text_TabithaPostBattle:
BOSS, hurry!
Give it the METEORITE's energy!
MtChimney_Text_TeamAquaAlwaysMessingWith:
That annoying TEAM AQUA…

MtChimney_Text_YouBetterNotMessWithUs: You'd better not mess with us!

Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if
you've not got the money.

You've been eavesdropping on us,

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro:
Trying to horn in on our treasure?

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
Develop amnesia conveniently and

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat: I think I tried to overdo it…
MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro:
I've been in training so I can mend

It toughened me up physically at

MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle:
The way you battle, it reminds me

POKéMON lived here long before

CLEANSE TAG.

It is my duty to protect this
mountain…

Memories of my darling SKITTY…

Ooch, ouch… There are holes in the

That was amazing!
You're a very special TRAINER.

POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.

And the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…

POKéMON no longer of this world.
POKéMON that are with you now.

And the POKéMON that you will meet
in the future…

They are all to be equally cherished.

I would like to see your POKéMON

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchDefeat:
How amazing!

MtPyre_3F_Text_GabrielleRematchIntro:
Have you come to show me your grown

This is no place for children, least

MtPyre_3F_Text_KaylaPostBattle:

enough…

I've got to keep working toward the
summit…

The rich atmosphere of the mountain
has elevated my psychic power!

You dream of winning?
MtPyre_3F_Text_WilliamPostBattle:
My psychic powers have surely
grown several times, but…

I love all things horrifying…
It's like a disease…

When I'm here…
I shiver with fear…
MtPyre_4F_Text_TashaPostBattle:
I want to see dreadful things…
I can't leave…

Stay…
Won't you stay with me?
MtPyre_5F_Text_AtsushiIntro:
Teacher…
Please watch over my progress!

Until I improve, my teacher, who rests

Have you lost your bearings?
Have no fear for I am here!

I had this feeling that a lost TRAINER

It's dirty and I won't try it again…
MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieIntro:
When I'm here…
A curious power flows into me…
MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostBattle:
Perhaps the power is from the spirits
of POKéMON in fitful sleep here…
MtPyre_6F_Text_ValeriePostRematch:
The POKéMON at rest here…
Sometimes, they play…
MtPyre_6F_Text_ValerieRegister:
Fufufu… I lost the match, but…
I have this little ability…

Without ever laying my hands on
your POKéNAV… Hiyah!

ARCHIE: TEAM MAGMA's MAXIE got ahead

I, ARCHIE, now have it in my possession!

Fufufu… Now we can bring our ultimate
objective to fruition!

Not only the BLUE ORB, but even
the RED ORB has been taken…

The BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.

What are those men trying to do with
the two ORBS?

Oh, yes. Was it TEAM MAGMA who came
and took the BLUE ORB first?

Well, in their haste, they left this
behind.

I couldn't imagine what exactly it
could be.

I would like you to have it.
Perhaps it will be useful in some way.

You say that both GROUDON and KYOGRE
have been awakened?

It is said that the BLUE ORB and
the RED ORB quelled the rage of
the two POKéMON…

It is also said that the true owner
of the ORBS still exists.

However, no one knows who, or what
exactly, the ORBS belong to.

It could be a human, or perhaps
a POKéMON, but no one knows.

The world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land
and the POKéMON of the sea…

The POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…

The POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…
Their fierce duel raged without end.

The world was engulfed in massive
infernos and vicious storms.

The BLUE ORB and the RED ORB brought
an end to the calamity.

Light poured from the two ORBS and
becalmed the enraged adversaries.

The pair, made docile, dove deep into
the sea where eventually they
disappeared…

I thought you were one of the MAGMAS
who happened to come back…
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1Intro:
No! Those TEAM MAGMA goons got
here ahead of us!
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
Yeah, so you are strong…

MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Defeat:
Urgh… I should've let you take on
TEAM MAGMA first…
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2Intro:
If you came earlier, you only would've
had to battle the wimpy TEAM MAGMA.

to take on us toughies!
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
You don't know anything!
So why are you messing with us?
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Defeat:
If you're going to mess with anyone,
let it be TEAM MAGMA…
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3Intro:
You…
We saw you at MT. CHIMNEY.

You don't belong to either TEAM,
so why would you be here?
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt3PostBattle:
Heh, it doesn't matter!
We bought ourselves some time!

The BOSS should have snatched what
he was after!
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Defeat:
If you want to join TEAM AQUA that
badly, we can consider it…
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4Intro:
Oh, I know!
You tried to join TEAM MAGMA,
but they wouldn't have you!

Well, don't think that we'll let you
join our TEAM AQUA!
MtPyre_Summit_Text_Grunt4PostBattle:
We have a great combination going
with us members and our leader.
MtPyre_Summit_Text_HearTheNewLegendOfHoe:
It is my role to pass on the legends
of HOENN to future generations.

And the crisis that just ended in
SOOTOPOLIS rewrote a legend…

Have you the time to hear the new
legend of HOENN?
MtPyre_Summit_Text_HoennTrioTale:
The world was wracked by a ferocious
clash between the POKéMON of the land
and the POKéMON of the sea…

The POKéMON of the land raised
mountains and created continents…

The POKéMON of the sea raised huge
waves and carved out oceans…
Their fierce duel raged without end.

The world was engulfed in massive
fires and vicious storms.

It was then that the POKéMON of
the sky descended from a storm.

The POKéMON, shining a vivid green,
becalmed the two enraged POKéMON.

Then, its duty done, the green POKéMON
flew off into the wild blue yonder…
MtPyre_Summit_Text_OrbsHaveBeenTaken:
The BLUE ORB and RED ORB taken by
those sinister men…

They must never be apart…
I fear something terrible will happen…
MtPyre_Summit_Text_SuperAncientPokemonTa:
The embodiments of the land, sea,
and the sky…

That is said to be the identities of
the super-ancient POKéMON…

In the same way that we humans and
POKéMON have life, our world, too,
is alive…

The super-ancient POKéMON have
taught us that…

The two men who took the ORBS came

To make a complete guide on all

When a wild POKéMON appears,

try to catch it!

POKéMON around the world wait for

I urge you to make them the best

undertaking in POKéMON history!

Of course I need your help, too.

POKéDEXES.

Now these units can record data on
a lot more POKéMON.

POKéMON you've seen or caught.

Take these with you.

This POKéMON is really quite

Oh, that's right, I told you to

The POKéMON are held inside

When I was young, I was a serious
POKéMON TRAINER.

But now, in my old age, I have
only these three left.

You can have one.

PROF. OAK took both POKéDEX
units.

Inside those three POKé BALLS are
POKéMON.

Which one will you choose for
yourself?

town.

GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.

stronger.

my training.

not avenge my loss to you, {PLAYER}!

I'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.

Oh, I see.

Hm… Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, {PLAYER}.

right now…

Just when you think you're going to
win, your opponent restores HP…

Can you just imagine how awful that
must feel?

feels!

I'm going to keep training at GYMS.
One day, I'll become a LEADER.

I should have expected no less from
our LEADER's kid.

No, wait! A TRAINER's abilities are
earned only through effort.

I lost because my own efforts
weren't enough.

I just received a very rare BERRY.

Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

The doors in this GYM open when you
beat the awaiting TRAINERS.

Whoops! The doors in this room are

The TRAINERS of PETALBURG GYM

What a stunning turn of events!

LEADER's kid!

Go on through! The GYM LEADER, your

lands without fail.

DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the

battle a greenhorn TRAINER.

when you become a lot stronger.

I'll battle you, {PLAYER}, when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?

a GYM LEADER to win.

{PLAYER}, you'd better give it your
best shot, too!

DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.

I would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.
