PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchDefe:
Uh… Haha…
Maybe that was going too hard…
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_NormanRematchNeed:
DAD: {PLAYER}…
I had a feeling that you would come.

I would never refuse to accept
a challenge from you.

Inside a GYM, it doesn't matter that
we are a parent and child.

Do you only have one POKéMON that is
capable of battle?

Sorry, but you'll have to come back
with at least two POKéMON.
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerDefeat:
I couldn't confuse your team enough…
You share a strong bond together.
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerIntro:
Let me see how well bonded you are
with your POKéMON!
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBadge:
After you beat our LEADER, the
training has become a lot tougher.
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ParkerPostBattle:
The next room is the STRENGTH ROOM.
Can you withstand brute force?
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_PleaseComeWithMe:
Please come with me.
I have something I want you to have.
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallIntro:
The ability to attack before the
opponent…

Just that alone puts me at a great
advantage, don't you agree?
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBadge:
Whomever you beat, and whomever you
may lose to, you never shirk from
training yourself and your POKéMON.

That's what I think being a
GYM LEADER is all about.
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_RandallPostBattle:
Go on to the next room where a new
challenge awaits you.
At the left is the CONFUSION ROOM.

The right door leads to the DEFENSE
ROOM.
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedBalanceBa:
{PLAYER} received the BALANCE BADGE
from DAD!
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIdLikeAPokem:
Um… I…
I'd like to get a POKéMON, please…
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyIveNeverCaug:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.

I thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.

But I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how…
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouAndD:
DAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.
Go for it!
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WallyThankYouBye:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.

{PLAYER}, thank you for coming along
with me.

You two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.

I promise I'll take really good
care of it.

Oh! My mom's waiting for me,
so I have to go!
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_WouldYouReallyCom:
{PLAYER}… Would you really come
with me?
PetalburgCity_Gym_Text_YouHaveGottenStro:
DAD: Hm… {PLAYER}, you have gotten
stronger.

I can tell by the number of BADGES
that you've earned.
PetalburgCity_House1_Text_GoOnAdventure:
I wish I could go on an adventure
with some POKéMON…

Crawl through some damp grass…
Climb rocky, rugged mountains…

Cross the raging seas…
Wander about in dark caves…

And, sometimes, even get a little
homesick…
It must be fabulous to travel!
PetalburgCity_House1_Text_TravelingIsWon:
When I was young, I roamed the seas
and the mountains!
PetalburgCity_House2_Text_BattledNormanO:
I battled NORMAN once, but, whew,
he was way too strong.

I just got the feeling that he
lives for POKéMON.
PetalburgCity_House2_Text_NormanBecameGy:
NORMAN became our town's new
GYM LEADER.

I think he called his family over from
somewhere far away.
PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_RepelIsUseful:
Do you use REPEL?
It keeps POKéMON away, so it's
useful when you're in a hurry.
PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_TakeSomeAntidote:
Do you have any ANTIDOTES with
you?

If you walk around with a poisoned
POKéMON, it will lose HP until it faints.
Take some ANTIDOTES with you.
PetalburgCity_Mart_Text_WeakWillGrowStro:
Even if a POKéMON is weak now,
it will grow stronger.

The most important thing is love!
Love for your POKéMON!
PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Many: There are many types of POKéMON.

All types have their strengths and
weaknesses against other types.

Depending on the types of POKéMON,
a battle could be easy or hard.
PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Mudk:
For example, your MUDKIP
is a WATER type.
It's strong against the FIRE type.

But, it's weak against GRASS-type
and ELECTRIC-type POKéMON.
PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Oran:
When my POKéMON ate an
ORAN BERRY, it regained HP!
PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCSt:
Whoever made it must be some kind
of a scientific wizard!
PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Torc:
For example, your TORCHIC
is a FIRE type.

It's strong against the GRASS and
BUG types.

But, it's weak against WATER-type
POKéMON.
PetalburgCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Tree:
For example, your TREECKO
is a GRASS type.

It's strong against the WATER and
GROUND types.

But, it's weak against FIRE-type
POKéMON.
PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouATrainer:
Let me guess, from the way you're
dressed, are you a POKéMON TRAINER?
PetalburgCity_Text_AreYouRookieTrainer:
Hiya! Are you maybe…
A rookie TRAINER?

Do you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?

They first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.
PetalburgCity_Text_CitySign:
PETALBURG CITY
“Where people mingle with nature.”
PetalburgCity_Text_FullPartyExplanation:
Let's say you have six POKéMON.
If you catch another one…

It is automatically sent to a STORAGE
BOX over a PC connection.
PetalburgCity_Text_GymSign:
PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: NORMAN
“A man in pursuit of power!”
PetalburgCity_Text_ImLookingForTalentedT:
I'm roaming the land in search of
talented TRAINERS.
I'm sorry to have taken your time.
PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsGymSign:
This is the GYM's sign. Look for it
whenever you're looking for a GYM.
PetalburgCity_Text_ThisIsPetalburgGym: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.
PetalburgCity_Text_WaterReflection: My face is reflected in the water.
It's a shining grin full of hope…

Or it could be a look of somber silence
struggling with fear…
What do you see reflected in your face?
PetalburgCity_Text_WellMaybeNot:
Well, maybe not.
Your clothes aren't all that dirty.

You're either a rookie TRAINER,
or maybe you're just an ordinary kid.
PetalburgCity_Text_WhereIsWally:
We have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN
very soon…
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_PleaseExc:
{PLAYER}{KUN}! Please excuse us for
dragging you here this way.

But our WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.
We owe it all to you!

When WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?

I think that made WALLY really
happy.

Actually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.

Happy that he's gained such a great
friend as you.

This isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_SurfGoAll:
If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be
able to go to all sorts of places.
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_ThanksFor:
You're…
Ah, you must be {PLAYER}{KUN}, right?

Thank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.

He's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.

We've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.

The air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.

What's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.

I wonder where he could have
gotten by now?
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyIsCo:
WALLY's coming home soon.
I'm looking forward to that.
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyLeft:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband…

But our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.

You know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.

I'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WallyWasR:
WALLY was really happy when he told
us that he caught a POKéMON.

It's been ages since I've seen him
smile like that.
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_WonderHow: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?
PetalburgCity_WallysHouse_Text_YouMetWal:
Oh? You met WALLY in
EVER GRANDE CITY?

He may have gotten healthy, but he
can't go somewhere far away like
that all by himself.
PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfILose: I can't be popular if I lose.
PetalburgWoods_Text_CantBePopularIfLose: I can't be popular if I lose.
PetalburgWoods_Text_GoBugPokemonTeam: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!

Go, go, go!
My BUG POKéMON team!
PetalburgWoods_Text_HaveYouSeenShroomish:
Hello, have you seen any POKéMON
called SHROOMISH around here?
PetalburgWoods_Text_HiddenItemsExplanati:
Sometimes, there are things on the
ground even if you can't see them.

That's why I always check where I'm
walking.
PetalburgWoods_Text_ICantBeWastingTime:
Uh-oh! It's a crisis!
I can't be wasting time!
PetalburgWoods_Text_ICouldntWin:
I have all these POKéMON,
but I couldn't win…
PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch1:
I want a rematch when my BUG
POKéMON grow up!
I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
PetalburgWoods_Text_IWantRematch2:
I want a rematch when my BUG 
POKéMON grow up!
I'm registering you in my POKéNAV!
PetalburgWoods_Text_IWasGoingToAmbushYou:
I was going to ambush you, but you
had to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS
forever, didn't you?
I got sick of waiting, so here I am!
PetalburgWoods_Text_ImOutOfPokeBalls:
I caught a bunch of POKéMON.
Now I'm out of POKé BALLS.
PetalburgWoods_Text_InstantlyPopularWith:
If you take BUG POKéMON to school,
you get to be instantly popular!
PetalburgWoods_Text_IveBeenTrainingHard:
You get to be popular if you have
strong POKéMON, right?
So, I've been training hard.
PetalburgWoods_Text_MiracleSeedExplanati:
It's a MIRACLE SEED.
If a POKéMON holds that item, its
GRASS-type moves become stronger.

Besides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are
other convenient items for POKéMON
to hold.
PetalburgWoods_Text_MyPokemonHaveGrown:
My BUG POKéMON have grown.
I'll be popular again.
PetalburgWoods_Text_NoOneCrossesTeamAqua:
Hunh? What do you think you're doing?
What, you're going to protect him?

No one who crosses TEAM AQUA
gets any mercy, not even a kid!
PetalburgWoods_Text_NotAOneToBeFound:
Hmmm…
Not a one to be found…
PetalburgWoods_Text_PeopleRespectYou:
If you have a big BUG POKéMON,
people respect you for it.
PetalburgWoods_Text_StayOutOfTallGrass:
Yo, there!
Your POKéMON doing okay?

If your POKéMON are weak and you want
to avoid battles, you should stay out
of tall grass.
PetalburgWoods_Text_TeamAquaAfterSomethi:
Didn't that TEAM AQUA thug say
they were after something in
RUSTBORO, too?
PetalburgWoods_Text_ThatWasAwfullyClose:
Thanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.

I know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!
PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsExperienc:
Any POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.

To raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
left of the team list.

As soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points without
being exposed to any harm.
PetalburgWoods_Text_TrainerTipsPP:
In addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON
have Power Points (PP) that are used to
make moves during battle.

If a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be
taken to a POKéMON CENTER.
PetalburgWoods_Text_TryUsingThisItem:
Oh, neat!
That's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!

You must be a TRAINER.
You should try using this item.
PetalburgWoods_Text_YouHaveToHelpMe:
You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?
You've got to help me, please!
PetalburgWoods_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems:
You're loaded with items.
I can't give you this GREAT BALL.
PetalburgWoods_Text_YouveGotSomeNerve:
Grrr… You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM AQUA!
Come on and battle me again!

I wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON…

And, hey, we of TEAM AQUA are also
after something in RUSTBORO.
PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat:
I took you for granted, and so
I lost.

As proof of your victory, I confer
on you this…the official POKéMON
LEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.

{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes
your POKéMON more powerful.

It also enables the use of the
move FLASH outside of battle.

Of course, a POKéMON must know the
move FLASH to use it.
PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK.
I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.

My rock-hard willpower is evident
even in my POKéMON.

My POKéMON are all rock hard, and
have true-grit determination.

That's right - my POKéMON are all
the ROCK type!

Fuhaha! You're going to challenge
me knowing that you'll lose?

That's the TRAINER's honor that
compels you to challenge me.
PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in
this huge world of ours.

You appear to be very gifted as a
POKéMON TRAINER.
So let me make a suggestion.

Go to the GYM in CERULEAN and test
your abilities.
PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis: You don't have room for this.
PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a
technique for POKéMON.

Using a TM teaches the move it
contains to a POKéMON.
A TM is good for only one use.

So, when you use one, pick the
POKéMON carefully.

It hurls boulders at the foe and
lowers its SPEED.
PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappen:
It's a free service!
Let's get happening!
PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop:
Hiya!
Do you want to dream big?

Do you dare to dream of becoming
the POKéMON champ?

I'm no TRAINER, but I can advise
you on how to win.
Let me take you to the top!
PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamDefeat:
Light-years isn't time…
It measures distance!
PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro:
You're ten thousand light-years 
from facing BROCK!
PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle:
You're pretty hot.
…But not as hot as BROCK!
PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrd:
The first POKéMON out in a match is
at the left of the POKéMON LIST.

By changing the order of POKéMON,
you may gain an advantage.

Try different orders to suit your
opponent's party.
PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial:
Just as I thought!
You're POKéMON champ material!
PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinic:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's
finicky and hard to handle.

An outsider is a POKéMON that you
get in a trade.

It grows fast, but it may ignore an
unskilled TRAINER in battle.
If only we had some BADGES…
PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIf:
A POKéMON becomes easier to 
catch if it has a status problem.

Sleep, poison, burn, or paralysis…
Those are all effective.

But catching POKéMON is never
a sure thing!
PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniqu:
POKéMON learn new techniques as
they grow.

But some moves must be taught to
them by people.
PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFrom:
A shady old guy sucked me into
buying this weird fish POKéMON!
It's totally weak and it cost ¥500!
PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMo:
Good things can happen if you raise
POKéMON diligently.

Even the weak ones can surprise
you if you don't give up on them.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFoss:
AERODACTYL Fossil
A primitive and rare POKéMON.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsG:
AMBER contains the genetic matter
of ancient POKéMON.

There's a LAB somewhere trying to
resurrect POKéMON from AMBER.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossili:
AMBER is actually sap, that gooey
stuff that oozes from trees.

The ancient sap fossilized over
time to become rock-hard AMBER.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCa:
I want a PIKACHU!
It's so cute!
I asked my daddy to catch me one!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPiece:
There is a beautiful piece of
AMBER in a clear gold color.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVF:
Humankind first set foot on the
moon that day.

I bought a color TV just so I
could watch that news.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatA:
You can't sneak in the back way!
Nice try, kid, but no.

Oh, whatever!
Do you know what AMBER is?
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceF: You don't have space for this.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_GetOldAmberChe:
Ssh!
Get the OLD AMBER checked!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChild:
Yes, yes.
It's ¥50 for a child's ticket.
Would you like to come in?
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil:
KABUTOPS Fossil
A primitive and rare POKéMON.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatF:
A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON.
It is thought to be a MOON STONE.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPr: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseGoAround: あちらへ　おまわりください
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmb:
{PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER
from the man.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceEx:
This month, we're running a space
exhibit.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratef:
I should be grateful for my long
life.

Never did I think I would get to
see the bones of a dragon!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAm:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.

I think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!

It would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be
resurrected from it.

But, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.
So, I have a favor to ask!

I want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossi:
We have two fossils of rare,
prehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAb:
What's so special about it?
Looks like an ordinary rock to me.
PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRoc:
TEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON?
Huh?
PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trading:
I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm
trading my CLEFAIRY for one.

I'm trading POKéMON with that kid
there.

I had two PIKACHU, so I figured
I might as well trade one.
PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJig:
When JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get
drowsy…
PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis:
I'm glad I caught up to you.
I'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.

I've been asked to deliver this,
so here you go.
PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerH:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.

They're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.

But PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like
that, not one bit.
PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChalleng:
BROCK's looking for new
challengers. Follow me!
PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieve:
Thieves have been stealing POKéMON
fossils from MT. MOON.

Please call the PEWTER POLICE if
you have any information.
PewterCity_Text_CitySign:
PEWTER CITY
A Stone Gray City
PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon:
CLEFAIRY came from the moon.
That's what the rumor is.

They appeared after MOON STONES
fell on MT. MOON.
PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum: Did you check out the MUSEUM?
PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing:
Psssst!
Do you know what I'm doing?
PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes:
Press the B Button to run.
But only where there's room to run!
PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock:
If you have the right stuff,
go take on BROCK!
PewterCity_Text_GymSign:
PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: BROCK
The Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!
PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab:
Well, I must be going back to
the LAB.
PewterCity_Text_ReallyYouHaveToGo:
Really?
You absolutely have to go!
PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFrom:
{PLAYER} received the
RUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.
PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMo:
Here is a pair of RUNNING SHOES
for my beloved challenger.

Remember, I'll always cheer for
you! Don't ever give up!
PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildM:
I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild
POKéMON out of my garden!
PewterCity_Text_SwitchedShoesWithRunning:
{PLAYER} switched shoes with the
RUNNING SHOES.
PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum:
You have to pay to get in, but it's
worth it. See you around!
PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP:
All POKéMON that appear in battle,
however briefly, earn EXP Points.
PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazin:
Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON
amazing?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ArentYouInterestedI:
Aren't you interested in seeing your
very own room?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_BetterGetBackToGym: I'd better get back to PETALBURG GYM.

MOM, thanks for looking after the house
while I'm away.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DadShouldStayLonger:
He comes home for the first time in a
while, but all he talks about is POKéMON.
He should relax and stay a little longer.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DidYouMeetProfBirch:
MOM: Did you introduce yourself to
PROF. BIRCH?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_DontPushYourselfToo:
Don't push yourself too hard, dear.
You can always come home.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoIntroduceYourself:
Oh, yes.
One of DAD's friends lives in town.

He lives right next door, so you should
go over and introduce yourself.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GoSetTheClock: Go set the clock in your room, honey.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_GotDadsBadgeHeresSo: MOM: Oh? Did DAD give you that BADGE?
Then here's something from your MOM!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatABreakingStor: MOM: Is that a breaking news story?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsThatAPokenav:
MOM: What is that, honey? A POKéNAV?
Someone from DEVON gave it to you?

Well, honey, how about registering
your mom?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_IsntItNiceInHere:
MOM: See, {PLAYER}?
Isn't it nice in here, too?
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ItsOverWeMissedHim:
I think DAD was on, but we missed him.
Too bad.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LatiEmergencyNewsFl:
We bring you this emergency
news flash!

In various HOENN locales, there have
been reports of a BZZT…colored
POKéMON in flight.

The identity of this POKéMON is
currently unknown.

We now return you to the regular
movie program.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MaybeDadWillBeOn:
MOM: Look! It's PETALBURG GYM!
Maybe DAD will be on!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MoversPokemonGoSetC:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work
of moving us in and cleaning up after.
This is so convenient!

{PLAYER}, your room is upstairs.
Go check it out, dear!

DAD bought you a new clock to mark
our move here.
Don't forget to set it!
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_PortsInSlateportLil: DAD: Hm, a TICKET for a ferry?

If I recall, there are ferry ports in
SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.
PlayersHouse_1F_Text_ReportFromPetalburg:
INTERVIEWER: …We brought you this

PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureAgatha:
In her youth, AGATHA and PROF.
OAK were rivals who vied for
supremacy as TRAINERS.

Special Feature: CINNABAR GYM
LEADER BLAINE!

BLAINE is said to remove his dark
shades only when he is thinking up
new quiz questions.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBrock:
Special Feature: PEWTER GYM
LEADER BROCK!

BROCK rarely laughs, but is said to
be unable to stop if he starts.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureBruno:
BRUNO apparently joined the ELITE
FOUR out of his burning ambition to
battle the best TRAINERS.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureDaisyO:
This is a POKéMON JOURNAL from
years ago…

The Spring POKéMON CONTEST's
Grand Champion is DAISY OAK of
PALLET TOWN!
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureErika:
Special Feature: CELADON GYM
LEADER ERIKA!

Rumor has it that if you peek into
CELADON GYM, you can often
see ERIKA snoozing.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureKoga:
Special Feature: FUCHSIA GYM
LEADER KOGA!

KOGA is said to have a thorough
knowledge of medicine.

He even concocts medicine to nurse
his POKéMON to health.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLance:
LANCE's grandfather is thought to
be the elder of a famous clan of
dragon masters.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLorele:
Known for her logical, calculated,
and cool battling style, LORELEI
has a surprising secret!
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureLtSurg:
Special Feature: VERMILION GYM
LEADER LT. SURGE!

LT. SURGE is rumored to have been
a pilot while home in America.

by POKéMON to power his plane.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMisty:
Special Feature: CERULEAN GYM
LEADER MISTY!

MISTY is said to worship LORELEI
of the ELITE FOUR.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureMrFuji:
Special Feature:
MR. FUJI of POKéMON HOUSE!

Editor: The shy MR. FUJI turned
down our interview requests.

He is a kindly man who is adored
and respected in LAVENDER TOWN.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureProfOa:
Special Feature: PROF. OAK,
the POKéMON Researcher!

PROF. OAK reportedly lives with his
grandchildren DAISY and {RIVAL}.
PokemonJournal_Text_SpecialFeatureSabrin:
Special Feature: SAFFRON GYM
LEADER SABRINA!

People say that SABRINA can
communicate with her POKéMON
during battle without speaking.

ProfileMan_Text_CollectTrainerProfiles:
Hello there, TRAINER!
You've got a wonderful smile, there.

I have a hobby--collecting the profiles
of POKéMON TRAINERS.
ProfileMan_Text_EasyChatExplanation:
You make your own profile by putting
together four words or phrases.

Here, I'll show you an example of a
profile using four pieces of text.

You can switch those four pieces with
other text pieces any which way you
like to make your own profile.

There are a lot of text pieces that
you can use.

They are arranged in groups like
POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies so
it is easier to look them up.

So, first, choose the group of text
pieces to display a list of choices.
Then, pick the choice you want.

Repeat for the remaining text choices,
and you'll have your very own profile.

then spitting them out fast!
You can have this, so you try it out!

Use it on a POKéMON, and it will learn
a move for firing seeds rapidly.
Route104_Text_MayDefeat:
Yikes!
You're better than I expected!
Route104_Text_MayHaventRaisedPokemon:
Haven't you caught or raised your
POKéMON very much?
That's not very good for a TRAINER!
Route104_Text_MayHowsYourPokedex:
MAY: Oh, by the way, {PLAYER}{KUN},
how's your POKéDEX coming along?
Route104_Text_MayIntro:
MAY: You just became a TRAINER,
{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!
Route104_Text_MayLetsBattle:
MAY: So, what do you think?
How about a little battle here?
Route104_Text_MayMinesDecentLetsBattle:
Mine's looking pretty decent.
So…
How about a little battle?
Route104_Text_MayPostBattle:
MAY: I can tell you've gotten pretty
good with the way you handle POKéMON.

But instead of only making them
battle, you should be like MR. BRINEY.

It's important to become friends with
POKéMON, too.
Route104_Text_MayWeShouldRegister:
DEVON upgraded your POKéNAV with
the MATCH CALL system, huh?

We should register each other so we
can get in contact anytime.
Route104_Text_MiaDefeat:
MIA: We battled together, but we
both lost…
Route104_Text_MiaIntro:
MIA: We are twins, so we battle
POKéMON together.
Route104_Text_MiaNotEnoughMons: MIA: You want to battle with us?

It's a big no-no if you don't have two
POKéMON with you.
We're too strong for you!
Route104_Text_MiaPostBattle:
MIA: We will train our POKéMON more
and be strong like you.
Route104_Text_OnlyThrowBallAtWildPokemon:
You're a thief if you try to steal
someone else's POKéMON.

You should throw POKé BALLS only at
wild POKéMON.
Route104_Text_PlantBerriesInSoilTakeThis:
If you see BERRIES growing in loamy
soil, feel free to take them.

But make sure you plant a BERRY in the
same spot. That's common courtesy.
Here, I'll share this with you.
Route104_Text_RegisteredDadInPokenav:
Registered DAD NORMAN
in the POKéNAV.
Route104_Text_TMsAreOneTimeUse:
A TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only
for one-time use.

Once you use it, it's gone.
Think twice before using it!
Route104_Text_ThrowBallAtWeakenedPokemon:
If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,
weaken the wild POKéMON first.

It will be easier to catch if it's been
poisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.
Route104_Text_TrainerTipsDoubleBattles:
In the HOENN region there are pairs
of TRAINERS who challenge others
for 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called
DOUBLE BATTLES.

In a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must
send out two POKéMON, the one at the
left of the list and the top one.
Watch how POKéMON are lined up.
Route104_Text_TrainersOftenMakeMonHoldBe:
The way you look, you must be a
TRAINER, no?

TRAINERS often make POKéMON hold
BERRIES.

It's up to you whether to grow BERRIES
or use them.
Route104_Text_WhatsItLikeAtBottomOfSea:
I wonder what it's like at the bottom
of the sea?
Route104_Text_WinstonIntro:
Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge.
I have a lot of money.
Route104_Text_WinstonPostBattle:
There are some things money can't buy.
That's POKéMON…
Route104_Text_WinstonPostRematch:
I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't
seem to win at POKéMON…
It's so deep, the world of POKéMON…
Route104_Text_WinstonRegister1:
Hm?
Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV.

I will gladly register you.
After all, I have plenty of money.
Route104_Text_WinstonRegister2:
Hm?
Ah, you've obtained a POKéNAV.

I will gladly register you.
After all, I have plenty of money.
Route104_Text_WinstonRematchDefeat:
I lost again?
Why couldn't I win?
Route104_Text_WinstonRematchIntro:
After I lost to you, I learned a bunch
of things about POKéMON.
Route105_Text_AndresDefeated:
Yes…
I am no good at battling…
Route105_Text_AndresIntro:
I'm convinced that the sea keeps
secrets from us.
Route105_Text_AndresPostBattle:
I'm sure there are many secrets to be
discovered in the world's seas.
I mean to find them all!
Route105_Text_AndresRegister:
Huh? I'm so weak, but you're willing
to register me in your POKéNAV?
Route105_Text_AndresRematchDefeated:
Yes…
I didn't think I could win.
Route105_Text_AndresRematchIntro:
I've told you that I'm weak…
Are you sure you want to do this?
Route105_Text_AndresRematchPostBattle:
I may be weak at battling, but my
drive to explore can't be bested.

I will travel the seas all around
the world!
Route105_Text_BeverlyIntro:
My body feels lighter in the water.
It's as if I've gotten slimmer!
Route105_Text_DominikDefeated:
I lost…
Now I'm feeling blue…
Route105_Text_DominikIntro:
Swimming the deep blue sea…
It feels the greatest!
Route105_Text_DominikPostBattle:
I learned about that at the MUSEUM in
SLATEPORT, but I forgot.
Route105_Text_FosterDefeated:
I was thinking too much about that
rock, while my POKéMON remained weak…
Route105_Text_FosterIntro:
There's supposed to be a mystical
rock around here.
Do you know anything about it?
Route105_Text_FosterPostBattle:
I can spend hours and hours staring
at a nice rock without growing bored.
Route105_Text_ImaniDefeated: I lost while I was lounging!
Route105_Text_ImaniIntro:
The blue, blue sky…
The vast sea…
It's so peaceful…
Route105_Text_ImaniPostBattle:
I want to be told I'm relaxing to be
with. Giggle.
Route105_Text_JosueDefeated: I lost because I battled at sea.
Route105_Text_JosueIntro:
I'm exhausted from swimming.
I'm just not used to it.
I need a battle for a change of pace!
Route105_Text_JosuePostBattle:
Yeah, for me, the sky is a much better
match than the sea.
Route105_Text_LuisIntro:
Whew! I was worried that a kid was
drowning when I saw you.

You seem to be okay, so what do you
say to a battle?
Route105_Text_LuisPostBattle:
If you are drowning, the signal is to
wave one arm toward the beach.
Route105_Text_PostBattle:
Your body weight is reduced to just
one tenth in the water.

That would make me…
Whoops! I'm not telling you my weight!
Route106_Text_DouglasIntro:
Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in
the water you can't catch me!
Route106_Text_DouglasPostBattle: I wouldn't lose in a swim race…
Route106_Text_ElliotDefeated:
Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost
spectacularly!
Route106_Text_ElliotIntro:
Which do you prefer, fishing in the
sea or a stream?
Route106_Text_ElliotPostBattle:
Fishing is the greatest whether it's
in the sea or a stream.
You agree with me, right?
Route106_Text_ElliotRegister:
Fishing's great, but so is battling.
If you don't mind, can we meet again?
Route106_Text_ElliotRematchIntro:
I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.
I'll show you an impressive battle!
Route106_Text_ElliotRematchPostBattle:
Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!
You agree with me, right?
Route106_Text_KylaDefeated:
Did you take it easy on me by any
chance?
Route106_Text_KylaIntro:
The sea is my backyard. I'm not going
to take it easy because you're a kid!
Route106_Text_KylaPostBattle:
Drifting along with the waves…
I love it! Why don't you give it a try?
Route106_Text_NedDefeated:
I lost because I'm trying to not go
to the washroom…
Route106_Text_NedIntro:
What do people do if they need to go
to a washroom?

What if my ROD hooks a big one while
I'm in the washroom? I just can't go…
Route106_Text_NedPostBattle:
Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook
a big one!
Route106_Text_TrainerTips:
Advice on catching POKéMON with a ROD:
Press the A Button if you get a bite.
Route107_Text_BethDefeated: I wasn't good enough for you.
Route107_Text_BethIntro:
Did you want to battle me?
Sure, I'll go with you!
Route107_Text_BethPostBattle:
I think you're going to keep getting
better. I'll go for it, too!
Route107_Text_CamronIntro:
I'm in the middle of a triathlon,
but I'm nowhere near tired!
Route107_Text_CamronPostBattle:
I still have swimming and running left
to do after this.
Am I going to be okay?
Route107_Text_DarrinDefeated:
Ahaha, I lost…
I'll take a snooze, I think…
Route107_Text_DarrinIntro:
I must have drifted off to sleep while
I was drifting in the waves.
Route107_Text_DarrinPostBattle:
Floating and being rocked by
the waves--it's like sleeping in
a plush, comfy bed.
Route107_Text_DeniseIntro:
Do you know a little town called
DEWFORD?
Route107_Text_DenisePostBattle:
A weird saying is getting really
trendy at DEWFORD HALL.
Route107_Text_LisaDefeated:
LISA: Awesome.
You're in a different class of tough.
Route107_Text_LisaIntro:
LISA: We challenge you as a sister
and brother!
Route107_Text_LisaNotEnoughPokemon:
LISA: If you want to battle with us,
bring more POKéMON.
Route107_Text_LisaPostBattle:
LISA: Do you have any friends who
would go to the beach with you?
Route107_Text_RayDefeated:
RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level
than us!
Route107_Text_RayIntro:
RAY: We always battle POKéMON,
me and my sister.

I always lose, but we can beat you
2-on-2!
Route107_Text_RayNotEnoughPokemon:
RAY: If you want to battle us,
go bring some more POKéMON!
Route107_Text_RayPostBattle:
RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.
I raised it, and now it's my important
partner!
Route107_Text_TonyDefeated:
I lost on my home field…
I'm in shock!
Route107_Text_TonyIntro:
The sea is like my backyard.
Let's battle!
Route107_Text_TonyPostBattle:
I swim the seas with a heart full of
dreams…

It's a song!
Anyways, I'm swimming some more.
Route107_Text_TonyRegister:
You've shocked me to the bone!
Well, so you won't forget me…
Route107_Text_TonyRematchDefeated:
My POKéMON has gotten stronger, but
I stayed weak as a TRAINER!
Route107_Text_TonyRematchIntro:
Swimming in the big, wide sea,
my POKéMON has grown stronger!
Route107_Text_TonyRematchPostBattle:
What you learn in battle makes you
a stronger TRAINER.
The waves taught me that.
Route108_Text_CarolinaIntro:
I take huge pride in my POKéMON.
We'll show you one speedy battle!
Route108_Text_CarolinaPostBattle:
Since I'm at sea like this, I wouldn't
mind putting on a pink, frilly swimsuit…
Route108_Text_CoryIntro:
I love WATER-type POKéMON.
I love other POKéMON, too!
Route108_Text_CoryPostBattle:
Shouting is good for me!
It uplifts me!
Route108_Text_CoryRegister:
I love tough TRAINERS, too!
Register me in your POKéNAV!
Route108_Text_CoryRematchDefeated:
Waaah! I lost again!
Waaah! Waaah!
Route108_Text_CoryRematchIntro: Win or lose, I love battling at sea!
Route108_Text_CoryRematchPostBattle:
If you're faced with a challenge,
try shouting at the sea!
Route108_Text_JeromeDefeated:
I won't be able to swim the seven seas
like this…
Route108_Text_JeromeIntro:
My dream is to swim the world's seven
seas!
Route108_Text_JeromePostBattle:
Playing with marine POKéMON is one of
the pleasures of swimming!
Route108_Text_MatthewIntro:
Ahoy, there! Are you going out to
the ABANDONED SHIP, too?
Route108_Text_MatthewPostBattle:
Some people even go inside that
ABANDONED SHIP.
Route108_Text_MissyDefeated:
When I lose a battle, I get all
stressed out!
Route108_Text_MissyIntro:
I love the sea!
I forget all my worries when I swim!
Route108_Text_MissyPostBattle:
Work off your stress by swimming!
It's so healthy!
Route108_Text_TaraIntro:
My liar of a boyfriend told me that
I look great in a bikini…
Route108_Text_TaraPostBattle:
Even if it's a lie, I love being told
I look great…
We girls are so complex…
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_BagFull:
Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full.
I'll hang on to these for you.
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneDefeat:
That was a hot battle!
I can accept that loss, matey!
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwayneIntro:
If you're looking for a battle in the
SEASHORE HOUSE, you'll find no
hotter TRAINER than me, matey!
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_DwaynePostBa:
Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy
hot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaIntro: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.

Fiery hot battles are what toughen up
TRAINERS and POKéMON!
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_JohannaPostB:
Whew, I'm all thirsty.
Maybe I'll have a SODA POP.
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SeashoreHous:
I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE.
But you can call me MR. SEA!

What I love above all is to see hot
POKéMON battles.
Let me see that your heart burns hot!

If you can defeat all the TRAINERS
here, I'll reward your efforts.
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_ShowMeSomeHo:
I run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for
that reason alone!
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonIntro:
I'm going to show you how great
my POKéMON are, but don't cry!
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_SimonPostBat:
If one of my POKéMON knew the move
for carrying me across water on its
back, I could get rid of this inner tube.
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_TakeTheseSod:
You're scorching hot!
Those battles blazed!
I'm more than just satisfied!

As thanks for showing me your hot
streak, I want you to take these.
It's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!
Route109_SeashoreHouse_Text_WantToBuySod:
Want to buy some SODA POP?
POKéMON love it!
Route109_Text_AliceIntro:
Are you properly protected against
the sun?
Route109_Text_AlicePostBattle: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!
Route109_Text_AustinaDefeated:
Did I lose because I have an inner
tube?
Route109_Text_AustinaIntro:
I can't swim without my inner tube,
but I won't lose at POKéMON!
Route109_Text_AustinaPostBattle:
My inner tube is a fashion item.
I can't be seen without it.
Route109_Text_BrineyDeliverDevonGoods:
MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver
the DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.
Route109_Text_BrineyDewfordItIs: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!

Anchors aweigh!
PEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!
Route109_Text_BrineySailToDewfordQuestio:
MR. BRINEY: I thought you're supposed
to deliver the DEVON GOODS.

Would you like to sail back to
DEWFORD, then?
Route109_Text_BrineyTellMeWhenYouNeedToS:
MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever
you need to set sail again!
Route109_Text_BrineyWhereAreWeBound:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
For you, I'll go out to sea anytime!
Now, my friend, where are we bound?
Route109_Text_CarterIntro:
Wahahah! This dude's going to catch
himself a big one!
Route109_Text_CarterPostBattle:
This dude thinks you're a big one.
No, you're a big-one-to-be!
Route109_Text_ChandlerIntro:
Tadaah! See?
My inner tube's round!
Route109_Text_ChandlerPostBattle:
After I showed you my round inner
tube, too…
Route109_Text_ChillAtMyPapasSpot:
Yo, TRAINERS!
Whether you're hot to trot,
or cool cat not,
chill at my papa's spot!
Route109_Text_DavidIntro:
Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!
This is what you call “cut”!
Route109_Text_DavidPostBattle:
My sculpted abs have nothing to do
with POKéMON battles!
Route109_Text_EdmondPostBattle:
I'm usually stronger than this!
I'm just seasick as a dog!
Route109_Text_ElijahDefeated: I'm cool even in defeat, hey?
Route109_Text_ElijahIntro:
For a guy as macho as me, this kind
of POKéMON is the perfect match!
Route109_Text_ElijahPostBattle:
For a guy as macho as me, a port
is the perfect setting!
I guess I'll head for SLATEPORT.
Route109_Text_GwenIntro:
Hi, big TRAINER.
Will you battle with me?
Route109_Text_GwenPostBattle: How did you get to be so strong?
Route109_Text_HaileyDefeated:
I thought so!
I didn't think we could win.
Route109_Text_HaileyIntro:
I can't swim, so I'm pretending
to swim.
Route109_Text_HaileyPostBattle:
When I learn how to swim, I think
my POKéMON will become tougher.
Route109_Text_HueyIntro:
I've laid anchor in ports around
the world, but SLATEPORT's the best.
Route109_Text_HueyPostBattle:
In the best port was the best
TRAINER…
Route109_Text_LittleKidsDartAround: Little kids can dart around so quickly…

You don't dare take your eyes off them
for an instant. It's very taxing.

Mine are with my POKéMON, so they
should be okay, but…
Route109_Text_LolaIntro:
Doesn't a beach umbrella look like
a giant flower?
Route109_Text_LolaPostBattle:
If you look at the beach from the sky,
it looks like a big flower garden!
Route109_Text_LolaRematchIntro:
I'm not losing to you again!
That's why I have my inner tube!
Route109_Text_LolaRematchPostBattle:
If I have an inner tube, me and my
POKéMON's cuteness goes way up!
Route109_Text_MelDefeated:
MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!
PAUL will hate me!
Route109_Text_MelIntro:
MEL: We're, like, totally in love.
Our romance is heating up all of HOENN!
Route109_Text_MelNotEnoughPokemon:
MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.
That's why we make our POKéMON
battle together.
Route109_Text_MelPostBattle:
MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?
Please don't be angry.
Route109_Text_PaulIntro: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.

I wish you wouldn't disturb our
precious time together.
Route109_Text_PaulNotEnoughPokemon:
PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.
That's why we make our POKéMON battle
together.
Route109_Text_PaulPostBattle:
PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that
we're here.
This is just our private world of two!
Route109_Text_RickyIntro:
I'm thirsty… I could go for a SODA POP
at the SEASHORE HOUSE…
Route109_Text_RickyPostBattle:
I'm getting famished… My inner tube
looks like a giant doughnut…
Route109_Text_RickyRegister:
Will you have another match with me
when I'm not all thirsty?
Route109_Text_RickyRematchDefeated:
I lost…
It's because I'm hungry…
Route109_Text_RickyRematchIntro:
I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in
me for a battle!
Route109_Text_RickyRematchPostBattle:
When you eat on a beach, everything
seems to taste a little better.
Route109_Text_SandCastleTakingLongTime:
Our sand castle's taking a long time
to make.
Route109_Text_SeashoreHouseSign:
“May hot battles rage on hot sands!
The place for hot TRAINERS!”
Route109_Text_TrainerTipsSign:
POKéMON at the same level may not
always have identical stats.

POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said
to grow stronger than wild POKéMON.
Route109_Text_WereGoingToMakeBigCastle:
We're going to get all the sand from
the beach and make a big castle!

And then we're going to be a king and
queen.
We'll let you be a servant.
Route109_Text_ZigzagoonPicksUpLitter: The water around these parts is clean.

But, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.

Dirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from…

If we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryTypeS:
The types of POKéMON match up
differently with each other.

Every type is stronger than some
types and weaker than others.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainEve:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly
can add to the POKéDEX.

However, at times, you may not
want a certain POKéMON to evolve.

In that case, give the EVERSTONE
to that POKéMON.

It will prevent evolution according
to the PROFESSOR.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GiveEverst:
Oh… {PLAYER}!
I've been looking for you!

It's me, one of the ever-present
AIDES to PROF. OAK.

If your POKéDEX has complete data
on twenty species, I'm supposed to
give you a reward from PROF. OAK.

He entrusted me with this
EVERSTONE.

Have you gathered data on at least
twenty kinds of POKéMON?
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatHereY:
Great! You have caught or owned
{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardGhost:
I heard that ghosts haunt
LAVENDER TOWN.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NuggetUsel:
A NUGGET is totally useless.
So I sold it for ¥5000.
Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedEv:
{PLAYER} received the EVERSTONE
from the AIDE.
Route10_Text_CarolDefeat:
I'm too tired.
I wasn't up for it.
Route10_Text_CarolIntro:
I'm feeling a bit faint.
I haven't hiked in some time.
Route10_Text_CarolPostBattle:
The POKéMON here in the mountains
are so chunky…

I wish there were pink POKéMON
with a floral pattern!
Route10_Text_CarolRematchIntro:
My head is starting to spin.
I've been hiking for too long…
Route10_Text_ClarkDefeat:
Ha-haha!
Not laughing!
Ha-hay fever! Haha-ha-choo!
Route10_Text_HeidiIntro:
I've been out at a POKéMON GYM
a few times.
Route10_Text_HeidiPostBattle:
I noticed some POKéMANIACS
prowling around.

Can you imagine? Them?
Up here in the mountains?
Route10_Text_HeidiRematchIntro: I went out to a POKéMON GYM again.
Route10_Text_HermanIntro:
Hi, kid!
Want to see my POKéMON?
Route10_Text_HermanPostBattle:
I don't like you.
I don't like anyone better than me!
Route10_Text_HermanRematchIntro:
Hi, kid!
Did I show you my POKéMON?
Route10_Text_MarkIntro:
Wow, you came all the way here?
Maybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?
Want to see my collection?
Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle: I have more rare POKéMON at home!
Route10_Text_MarkRematchIntro:
Wow, you came here again?
Maybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too?
Want to see my collection?
Route10_Text_RockTunnelDetourToLavender:
ROCK TUNNEL
Detour to LAVENDER TOWN
Route10_Text_TrentIntro:
Ah!
This mountain air is delicious!
Route10_Text_TrentPostBattle: I feel bloated on mountain air!
Route10_Text_TrentRematchIntro:
Ah!
This mountain air is delicious!
It's so good, I can't leave!
Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadNorthEntrance:
On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out
and cycle as fast as you'd like.

It feels great to go that fast, but try
not to crash into anyone!

Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING
ROAD. It's too dangerous.
Please come back with a BIKE.
Route110_SeasideCyclingRoadSouthEntrance:
On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out
and cycle as fast as you'd like.

It feels great to go that fast, but try
not to crash into anyone!

Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING
ROAD. It's too dangerous.
Please come back with a BIKE.
Route110_Text_AbigailIntro: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.

You have to complete the three events
of swimming, cycling, and running.
Route110_Text_AbigailPostBattle:
I'm exhausted, so I need a break.
It's important to get proper rest.
Route110_Text_AbigailRegister:
You know, I like you!
Let's have a rematch on CYCLING ROAD.
Route110_Text_AbigailRematchDefeated:
Wow…
How could you be so strong?
Route110_Text_AbigailRematchIntro:
Isn't it neat to hold a battle while
cycling?
Route110_Text_AbigailRematchPostBattle: Were you going after a record?
I'm sorry if I held you up!
Route110_Text_AcroBikesDoNotQualify:
On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding
MACH BIKES are rated for their number
of collisions and their total times.

ACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating.
They are easy to turn, so it's not fair.
Route110_Text_AlwaysAimHigher:
Regardless of the results, I count on
seeing more challenges from you.
Always aim higher!
Route110_Text_AlyssaIntro:
I'll get over my embarrassment by
battling with you!
Route110_Text_AlyssaPostBattle:
Falling… Losing…
This is so humiliating for me!
Route110_Text_AnthonyIntro:
Yo, you!
Can you keep up with my speed?
Route110_Text_AnthonyPostBattle:
Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.
I need to reconsider this…
Route110_Text_AquaActionsBringSmiles:
TEAM AQUA's actions should bring
smiles to people's faces!
Route110_Text_AquaWasHere:
Someone painted that onto this sign,
but then someone else painted over it.

“TEAM MAGMA rules!” is what it
says now.
Route110_Text_BenjaminDefeated:
I shouldn't panic during POKéMON
battles…
Route110_Text_BenjaminIntro: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!
Route110_Text_BenjaminPostBattle:
There's no need to panic or stress.
Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
Route110_Text_BenjaminRegister:
I'll keep chugging on without stressing.
Give me a shout if you're up to it.
Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchDefeated: I didn't panic, but I still lost…
Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchIntro:
Aren't you going a little too fast?
Take it easy and let's battle.
Route110_Text_BenjaminRematchPostBattle:
There's no need to panic or stress.
Take it easy. There's plenty of time.
Route110_Text_BikeTechniques:
Learning techniques will make BIKE
riding even more fun.

There are some places that you can
reach only by using a BIKE technique.
Route110_Text_BrendanExplainItemfinder:
Use it to root around for items that
aren't visible.

If it senses something, it emits
a sound.

Anyway, I'm off to look for new
POKéMON.
Route110_Text_BrendanLetsBattle:
BRENDAN: Hey, {PLAYER}.
So this is where you were.
How's it going?

Have you been raising your POKéMON?
I'll check for you.
Route110_Text_BrendanTakeThis:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}, you've trained
without me noticing…
Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBad:
My word… Your cycling skills border
on terrifying.

Most certainly, you need much more
practice riding.
Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionBest:
Your love of cycling comes from deep
within your heart.
You've shaken me to my very soul!
Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionGood:
I suggest you speed up a bit while
still avoiding collisions.
Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionOk:
I would consider you a work in
progress.

Still, I hope you don't forget the
sheer pleasure of cycling.
Route110_Text_ChallengeReactionWorst:
You're perhaps not cut out for this
unfortunate cycling business.

You ought to give serious thought to
returning that BIKE to RYDEL.
Route110_Text_DaleIntro:
Hey!
Don't sneak up behind me like that!
Route110_Text_DalePostBattle:
Fishing is all about concentration.
You have to focus on the floater.
Route110_Text_EdwardDefeated: I failed to prophesize my own demise!
Route110_Text_EdwardIntro:
I have foreseen your intentions!
I cannot possibly lose!
Route110_Text_EdwardPostBattle:
Hmm…
I see a shining light…
Route110_Text_EdwinDefeated:
I wanted to complete
my collection…
Route110_Text_EdwinIntro:
Could I see your POKéMON?
Just one look, please?
Route110_Text_EdwinPostBattle:
When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,
my passion as a collector is ignited!
Route110_Text_EdwinRegister:
I like collecting MATCH CALL
registrations, too…
Route110_Text_EdwinRematchIntro: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?

Could I see your POKéMON?
Just one look, please?
Route110_Text_EdwinRematchPostBattle:
Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON
mine!
Route110_Text_HairStreamsBehindMe:
How do you like the way my raven-
colored hair streams behind me?
I grew my hair out just for that.
Route110_Text_HeardYouInstallMatchCall:
Oh, I see!
You two are running separately.
Well, that's fine.

Oh, yes, I heard that your POKéNAV
had the MATCH CALL system installed.

Well, then, I should register you in
my POKéNAV as well.

That way, even when we're apart,
I can rate your POKéDEX anytime.
Route110_Text_ImagineSeeingYouHere:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Imagine seeing you here!
Route110_Text_IsabelIntro:
Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show
off my delightful POKéMON.
Route110_Text_IsabelPostBattle:
Rather than battling, perhaps I should
show off my POKéMON at the FAN CLUB.
Route110_Text_IsabelRegister:
That wasn't close to what I could
do to show off my POKéMON.

I'll have you as my captive audience
as often as possible!
Route110_Text_IsabelRematchIntro:
Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show
off my POKéMON as often as you like!
Route110_Text_IsabelRematchPostBattle:
I don't think that I could ever stop
from showing off my POKéMON.
But I like to battle, too!
Route110_Text_JaclynIntro:
Ahahahaha!
I'll dazzle you with my wonders!
Route110_Text_JaclynPostBattle:
You managed to win only because it was
a wonder! Yes, a wonder!
Don't think you can win all the time!
Route110_Text_JacobIntro:
Whoa! Watch it!
I guess you're not used to BIKE racing.
Route110_Text_JacobPostBattle:
Flat tires and brake problems can
cause serious injury!
Inspect your BIKE for problems!
Route110_Text_JasmineIntro:
I've been riding without stopping.
My thighs are like rocks!
Route110_Text_JasminePostBattle:
Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?
No wonder you're so strong!
Route110_Text_JosephDefeated: You got into the groove all right…
Route110_Text_JosephIntro:
Okay! Full-throttle time! If you can't
groove, you get left behind!
Route110_Text_JosephPostBattle:
This isn't going to bring me down!
Losing has made me a better man!
Route110_Text_KalebDefeated: Have you no compassion or pity?
Route110_Text_KalebIntro:
When cute POKéMON help each other…
You won't see a more adorable sight!
Route110_Text_KalebPostBattle:
Okay, okay, you've done the best you
could, my pretties.
Route110_Text_KeepAnEyeOutForRival:
Please keep an eye out for my {RIVAL}.
… … … … … …

Well, I had better get going.
See you again, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Route110_Text_KickUpARuckus:
I want to get going to SLATEPORT and
kick up a ruckus!
Route110_Text_MayDefeated:
Yikes!
You're better than I expected!
Route110_Text_MayExplainItemfinder:
Try it out. If there is an item that's
not visible, it emits a sound.

I know it's a little silly coming from
me, but I think you should train a lot
harder for the next time.
Route110_Text_MayLetsBattle: MAY: Hi, {PLAYER}{KUN}, long time no see!

While I was searching for other
POKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.

So…
How about a little battle?
Route110_Text_MayTakeThis:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've been busy
training, too, haven't you?

I think you deserve a reward!
This is from me!
Route110_Text_MyFirstJobInAqua:
This is my first job after joining
TEAM AQUA. It's a little scary.
Route110_Text_RatedForNumberOfCollisions:
If you were to ride from MAUVILLE to
SLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would
be rated for the number of collisions
and your total time.
Route110_Text_RegisteredBirchInPokenav:
Registered PROF. BIRCH
in the POKéNAV.
Route110_Text_RideBikeAtFullSpeed:
Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE
at full speed on CYCLING ROAD?
Route110_Text_ThereIsNoRecord:
No one seems to have taken the
challenge. There is no record…
Route110_Text_TimmyDefeated: Being cool isn't enough to win…
Route110_Text_TimmyIntro:
I found some cool POKéMON in the grass
around here!
Route110_Text_TimmyPostBattle:
It's hard to battle with POKéMON you
just caught.
Route110_Text_TrainerTipsPrlzSleep:
The foe can be made helpless by
paralyzing it or causing it to sleep.

It is an important technique for
POKéMON battles.
Route110_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterItems:
The items in the BAG can be reorganized
by pressing SELECT.
Route110_Text_TrickHouseSign:
“Three steps {RIGHT_ARROW} and two steps {UP_ARROW}
to reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”
Route110_Text_TwoRoads: The two roads, one above, one below…

A road each for people and POKéMON.
Perhaps that is right and fair.
Route110_Text_WalkOnTheLowRoad:
I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take
a leisurely walk on the low road.
Route110_Text_WeCantTalkAboutAquaActivit:
TEAM AQUA's activities…
We can't talk about them yet.
Route110_Text_WhichShouldIChoose:
Make a beeline for MAUVILLE on
CYCLING ROAD, or take the low road
and look for POKéMON?
Route110_Text_YouGotBikeFromRydel: Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!

Oh, it's glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike…

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,

RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL…
That name's everywhere.

You should ride it around all over
the place--it's good advertising!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightPoli: It took me all night polishing floors…

You're above me in greatness!
Possibly…
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightSett: It took me all night setting up arrows…
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToIn:
It took me all night to install
the doors…
You're almost my equal in greatness!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToMa: It took me all night to make the maze…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three, four, five places!

It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS
and another to think up the quiz…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two places!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPl:
It took me all night to plant all those
trees…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three, four, five, six places!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToPr:
It took me all night to prepare
the wall panels…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three, four places!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_AllNightToSh:
It took me all night to shove in those
boulders…

You're almost my equal in greatness by
one, two, three places!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_DefeatedMePr:
I hate to admit defeat, but you have
bested me!

Still, you must have been reeled in by
my charisma for you to visit me again
and again. Yes, you must have!

But that has nothing to do with my
losing!

In recognition of the friendship
between you, the driven, and the genius
that is myself, I demand that you take
this keepsake!

Actually there are two--
a RED TENT and a BLUE TENT.
Which do you prefer?
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_FountainOfId:
Wh-what should I do?
My fountain of ideas for tricks has
run dry…

Perhaps it is time I toured the country
on a quest to devise new tricks…
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_LeavingOnJou:
I am leaving on a journey of discovery.
A quest in search of new tricks.

I wish that you will one day visit and
entertain me again.
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_MakeNewTrick:
Scrub that smug smirk from your face!
It's much too early to think you've won!

I'll make new tricks to stump you, I will.
You may mock me only when you're done.

Come back for the next exciting
installment!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomForThi:
What? Have you no room for this?
What manner of items do you carry?

But fine, since you've reached me,
your reward will be with me till later.
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_NoRoomInPC:
What? No room in your PC?
What am I to make of that?

I wish I could say that, but I am much
too kind and caring, so come back later!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouHaveEarne:
Fine!
You have earned this reward!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YoureIgnorin:
Now, now! You're ignoring me now?
Now that, I consider heartbreaking!
Route110_TrickHouseEnd_Text_YouveMadeItT:
Aak!
You've made it to me?
Hmmm… You're sharp!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_ComeToC:
You, you've come to challenge
my TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?

That's why you're here, isn't it?
Yes, it is!

Enter through the scroll there,
and let your challenge commence!
I shall be waiting in the back!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Conceal:
How did you know I concealed myself
behind this tree? You're sharp!

How did you know I concealed myself
behind this window? You're sharp!

How did you know I concealed myself
beneath this cushion? You're sharp!

How did you know I concealed myself
beneath this desk? You're sharp!

How did you know I concealed myself
in this cupboard? You're sharp!

How did you know I concealed myself
in this dresser? You're sharp!

How did you know I concealed myself
in this planter? You're sharp!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Coneale:
How did you know I concealed myself
beyond this window? You're sharp!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DidYouN:
Hah?
Did you not come to claim your reward?
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_DoorLoc:
…On closer inspection, this is written
on it: “Write the secret code here.”
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_GoInHol: There is a big hole behind the scroll!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_InMidst:
I'm in the midst of devising new tricky
challenges!

It's not too much to ask for a bit more
time for me to think, is it now?
You wouldn't begrudge me that?
Come back in a little while!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Leaving: There is a note affixed to the scroll…

“I am leaving on a journey.
Don't look for me. TRICK MASTER”
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_Mechado:
MECHADOLL 5 I AM!
IF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU,
THEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW.

RED TENT OR BLUE TENT,
WHICH DO YOU PREFER?
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_NextTim:
For the next time, I'll use this trick,
and that scheme, and those ruses…

Mufufufu… If I may say so, it's
brilliantly difficult, even for me!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_PCFullA:
YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN.
MEAN, YOU ARE.
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_TheyCal:
For I am the greatest living mystery
of a man in all of HOENN!
They call me…

The TRICK MASTER!
Wahahaha! Glad to meet you!
Route110_TrickHouseEntrance_Text_YoureHe:
Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the
reward from before, isn't that right?
Yes, right I am!

Here!
I'll give it to you now!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddieInt:
I wandered into this weird house
by accident…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_EddiePos:
I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm
now even more lost… I can't get out…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinDef: I lost while I was lost in thought!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinInt: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_RobinPos:
You're strong!
Just who are you?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyInt:
I'll hack and slash my way to victory
with the CUT we just learned!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_SallyPos:
I never get tired of hacking
and slashing!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle1_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaI:
I want to make my own GYM one day.
So, I'm studying how to set traps.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_GeorgiaP:
You're strong, aren't you?
Maybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulIntr:
Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE
challenge!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_PaulPost:
The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks
in this house all by himself.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedDefea:
After that battle, I'm even more
confused!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_TedPostB:
Can I get you to push all the buttons
for me?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle2_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanDefe:
I don't get it.
How did I lose?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanIntr:
I don't get it. What would anyone want
with a house this bizarre?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_AlanPost:
I don't get it.
How many traps are in this house?
You may be the one to solve that.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinDe:
I'm already having trouble, and then
you have to beat me? It's not fair!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinIn: I keep coming back to this same place!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_JustinPo:
It's full of doors here!
It's too small and dark in here! Help!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaIn:
I don't know what's going on here.
I'm starting to feel sad…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_MarthaPo:
I know I'm weak!
And, I have no sense of direction!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle3_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraDefe:
Even though I lost, I still like battling
the best!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraIntr:
It's too much bother to think this out.
I only wanted to battle!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_CoraPost:
Wouldn't you agree? You would go
anywhere if TRAINERS were there.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaInt:
The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier,
isn't it?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_PaulaPos: Has anyone made it to the end?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiDefe:
I can push boulders, but I can't solve
the puzzle…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiIntr:
Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush
aside with one finger!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle4_Text_YujiPost:
It's not good enough to be brawny…
You have to use your head. Be brainy!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_CorrectG:
CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.
GO THROUGH. PLEASE.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_Mechadol:
CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 1 AM I!

IF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES CORRECTLY,
THEN YOU WILL GO TO MECHADOLL 5.
THEN YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.
MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.

One of these POKéMON is not found
on ROUTE 110. Which one is it?
MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.

One of these POKéMON is not of the
WATER type. Which one is it?
MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.

One of these POKéMON does not use
LEECH LIFE. Which one is it?

CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 2 AM I!

MECHADOLL 1'S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL
IS SET TOO LOW.
MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.

Which of these POKéMON did WALLY
borrow from your father?
MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.

Which of these POKéMON was chasing
PROF. BIRCH?
MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.

Which of these POKéMON did TEAM AQUA
use in PETALBURG FOREST?

CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 3 AM I!
MATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.
MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.

Which costs more?
Three HARBOR MAILS or one BURN HEAL?
MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.

Sell one GREAT BALL and buy
one POTION. How much money remains?
MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.

Do one REPEL and SODA POP cost
more than one SUPER POTION?

CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 4 THAT IS ME!
MY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.
MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.

In SEASHORE HOUSE, were there more men
or women?
MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.

In LAVARIDGE TOWN, were there more
elderly men or elderly women?
MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.

In the TRAINER'S SCHOOL, how many
girl students were there?

CLICKETY-CLACK…
MECHADOLL 5 AM I!

THE MASTER'S BEST AND PROUDEST
ACHIEVEMENT AM I.
MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.

In SLATEPORT's POKéMON FAN CLUB,
how many POKéMON were there?
MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.

In FORTREE CITY, how many
tree houses were there?
MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.

On the CYCLING ROAD, how many
TRIATHLETES were there?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WaitForN: YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle5_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyInt:
Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON
to fly over the wall…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_BennyPos:
Ehehehe… I guess I lost because
I was trying to cheat.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_Sebastia:
Everything's spinning around and
around. I can't take this anymore…

I'm getting dizzy from these rotating
doors…

You don't seem to be affected at all.
Or do you have your poker face on?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaIn:
When I heard there was a strange
house, I had to check it out.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_SophiaPo:
I'm sure having a good time checking
this place out.

It's a challenge I've found worth
repeating!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle6_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisIn:
Whoever wins will get through here
first. That's the feeling I get.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlexisPo:
You're solving all the puzzles in the
TRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroDe: This outcome I didn't see coming…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroIn: I ever so closely watched you coming!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_AlvaroPo:
Well, anyway, we both picked a weird
place to get acquainted.

As one weirdo to another,
let's do our best!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_EverettP:
I was hoping to switch places with you
when I beat you, but…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaDe:
Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong!
How do you do it?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaIn:
The TRICK MASTER always vanishes
like smoke. How does he do it?
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_JoshuaPo:
I wish I could appear and disappear as
if I were smoke, too.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaI:
Nufufufu, here at last!
Let's get right with it!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_MarielaP:
Humph! I'm not upset!
Not me!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_Patricia:
Going around the same spot…
It begets ill fortune…

I've circled the same spot over ten
times now… It's ill fortune…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle7_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraDef:
This isn't right!
I can't lose!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraInt:
Consider yourself lucky to be
battling me!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_KeiraPos:
It's a miracle that you beat me.
You can brag about it.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyDef:
I see…
You possess an extraordinary style.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyInt:
You've been slugging through the TRICK
HOUSE challenge, too.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_LeroyPos:
Seeing someone like you should please
the TRICK MASTER.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentD: That must mean you're tough, too…
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentI:
Not many TRAINERS have made it
this far.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_VincentP:
You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION? That's too much!
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle8_Text_WroteSec:
{PLAYER} wrote down the secret code
on the door.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_Memorized:
{PLAYER} memorized the secret code
written on the scroll.
Route110_TrickHousePuzzle_Text_SecretCod: A secret code is written on it.
Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_DontNeedT:
Is that so?
You don't need to be shy about it.
Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_RestUpHer:
Oh, dear, dear.
Aren't your POKéMON exhausted?

If you'd like, rest up here.
That's a fine idea! You should do that.
Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_StillTire:
Oh, dear, dear.
Are your POKéMON still tired?

You should take another rest here.
That's a fine idea. You should do that.
Route111_OldLadysRestStop_Text_TakeYourT:
That's right.
Take your time and rest up!
Route111_Text_BattleOurFamily: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.

How's this? What do you say to taking
on our family of four in a series of
POKéMON battles?
Route111_Text_BeauDefeat: I can't win on spirit alone…
Route111_Text_BeauIntro:
Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me
feel like a superhero.
Right now, nobody can beat me!
Route111_Text_BeauPostBattle:
I'm going to be a real hero one day.
I'm going to work harder to make me
and my POKéMON stronger.
Route111_Text_BeckyIntro:
I heard there are fossils to be found
in the desert. Where could they be?
Route111_Text_BeckyPostBattle:
If they can find fossils in the desert,
it must have been a sea before.
Route111_Text_BiancaDefeat:
Ooh lala!
That's a lot to take!
Route111_Text_BiancaIntro:
Did you come from MAUVILLE?
Then you should be full of energy!
Route111_Text_BiancaPostBattle:
This road here…
You have quite a ways to travel.
Route111_Text_BrandenDefeat:
Tch! I thought a sandwich would be
enough of a bribe…
Route111_Text_BrandenIntro:
I'll give you some of my sandwich
if you'll lose.
Route111_Text_BrandenPostBattle:
My SANDSHREW loves eating
my sandwiches.
Route111_Text_BrookeDefeat:
They didn't just look strong,
they are strong!
Route111_Text_BrookeIntro:
Oh, your POKéMON look like serious
actors.
I have to ask you for an engagement.
Route111_Text_BrookePostBattle:
I thought I was raising my POKéMON
diligently, but, oh no, there is still
much to be done.
Route111_Text_BrookePostRematch:
Maybe I should have stopped my
POKéMON from evolving until they
learned better moves…
Route111_Text_BrookeRegister:
I wish I could become friends with
more strong people like you!
Route111_Text_BrookeRematchIntro:
You can make POKéMON stronger or
weaker depending on the moves you
teach them.

What kinds of moves do your POKéMON
know?
Route111_Text_BryanDefeat:
Oh! Your strength!
It is shrouded in mystery!
Route111_Text_BryanIntro:
How tough are you?
We shall expose that secret!
Route111_Text_BryanPostBattle:
This desert hoards mysteries in
its shifting sands!
Route111_Text_CeliaDefeat:
Aww!
I really shouldn't have come!
Route111_Text_CeliaIntro:
I shouldn't have come to a place like
this for a picnic!
Route111_Text_CeliaPostBattle:
In a sandstorm like this, I can't set
the places for a picnic even with my
GO-GOGGLES on…
Route111_Text_CelinaDefeat:
Oh… My…
That was too much excitement.
Route111_Text_CelinaIntro:
Show me how to put a little excitement
into my life.
Route111_Text_CelinaPostBattle:
My pulse is still racing.
You're one fabulous TRAINER.
Route111_Text_ClawFossilDisappeared:
The CLAW FOSSIL disappeared into
the sand…
Route111_Text_DaisukeIntro:
To train myself, I challenge all
whom I meet!
Route111_Text_DaisukePostBattle:
All I can do is keep training until
I can defeat strong TRAINERS such
as yourself.
Route111_Text_DontHaveAnyRoom: Oh, you don't have any room for this.

I'll hold on to it, so come back for it
another time, okay?
Route111_Text_DontWantThis:
Oh, you don't want this?
If you change your mind, tell me, okay?
Route111_Text_DrewDefeat:
I couldn't see what was happening at
my sides because of the GO-GOGGLES.
Route111_Text_DrewIntro:
Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.
But I think they look better on me.

Let's decide who they look better on
with a battle!
Route111_Text_DrewPostBattle:
The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to
get through sandstorms.
That makes me happy!
Route111_Text_DustyDefeat:
While I have searched for ruins,
I've not searched for strong POKéMON.
Route111_Text_DustyIntro:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!
I am to be challenged?
Route111_Text_DustyPostBattle:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years?
Which was it now?
Route111_Text_DustyPostRematch:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years
I've searched?

Hmm… It could even be fifty…
How long have I been at this?
Route111_Text_DustyRegister:
I haven't been searching for any
tough POKéMON.

But, for some reason, I sure do like
POKéNAVS.
Route111_Text_DustyRematchDefeat:
I've found no ruins, nor have I found
any strong POKéMON…
Route111_Text_DustyRematchIntro:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!

No, wait, was that forty years?
Anyway, am I to be challenged?
Route111_Text_ExplainSecretPower:
Find a big tree that looks like it might
drop some vines.

Use SECRET POWER in front of the tree.
Some vines should get free and drop
down, so you can climb the tree.

You'll find a lot of space for putting
your favorite things.

It'll be your own secret room…
A SECRET BASE!

Another thing, you don't always have
to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.

Try using SECRET POWER on rock walls
that have small indents in them.

I'm going to look for other places, too.
Okay, bye!
Route111_Text_GoingToTryToMakeDifferentC:
I'm going to try really hard and make
BERRIES in different colors.
I hope you try hard, too!
Route111_Text_HaydenIntro:
When you're as famished as I am,
there is no room for pity!
Route111_Text_HaydenPostBattle:
My stomach is grumbling!
Maybe I can grill some BERRIES…
Route111_Text_HeidiIntro: I'm having a picnic in the desert.

You can always find a TRAINER,
so I can enjoy a battle here, too!
Route111_Text_HeidiPostBattle:
When you're battling in a sandstorm,
watch out for your POKéMON's HP.

It can faint if you don't keep
an eye on it!
Route111_Text_IreneIntro:
I don't know where you're going,
but would you like to battle?
Route111_Text_IrenePostBattle:
I'm thinking that I should go to
MT. CHIMNEY, but the view around
here is very nice, too.
Route111_Text_IsThatSo:
Is that so?
Drop in, if you change your mind!
Route111_Text_MakingRoomUseTMToMakeYourO:
What's that?
What am I doing?

I'm thinking about making my own room
here using a POKéMON move.

I know! I'll give you this TM.
Will you use it to make your own room?
Route111_Text_MauvilleUncleToldMeToTakeR:
My uncle in MAUVILLE told me to take
ROCK SMASH with me if I was going to
ROUTE 111!

My uncle? He lives across from
the bike shop in MAUVILLE.
Route111_Text_MirageTowerClearlyVisible:
I see it!
The tower of sand!

The sand tower they called a mirage
is clearly visible!

But it looks so fragile…
It could crumble away anytime…

I want to go inside it, but I can't
get my courage up for it…
Route111_Text_MirageTowerHasntBeenSeenSi:
Since I spoke to you, the tower of sand
hasn't been seen.

Perhaps it really was
the MIRAGE TOWER…
Route111_Text_OldLadysRestStopSign:
OLD LADY'S REST STOP
“Come in and rest your tired bones.”
Route111_Text_RootFossilDisappeared:
The ROOT FOSSIL disappeared into
the sand…
Route111_Text_ShouldBeMirageTowerAroundH:
There should be a tower made of sand
around here somewhere.

But for some reason, it can be seen
sometimes, and sometimes not.
That's why I call it the MIRAGE TOWER.
Route111_Text_ThatWasShockingSandRainedD:
Sand rained down in chunks all of
a sudden.

What was it like inside?
Were there sandy ghosts and such?
Route111_Text_ToughToKeepWinningUpTheRan:
If you don't raise your POKéMON some
more, it could be tough to keep winning
up through the ranks.

I've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's
ELITE FOUR are far stronger than
any GYM LEADER.
Route111_Text_TrainerTipsSpAtkSpDef:
One of the indicators of a POKéMON's
powerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for
“SPECIAL ATTACK.”

Likewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL
DEFENSE.”
Route111_Text_TravisIntro:
I'm full of pep!
And my POKéMON is peppy, too!
Route111_Text_TravisPostBattle:
When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,
I can't help looking.
Route111_Text_TyronDefeat:
Wait!
Did you get a good look at my POKéMON?
Route111_Text_TyronIntro: This is my favorite kind of POKéMON!
Route111_Text_TyronPostBattle:
When having a battle, I get a kick out
of showing off my POKéMON.

I bet everyone feels that way when
they enter a battle!
Route111_Text_VickyDefeat:
Kwah! You are strong…
My granddaughter was right…
Route111_Text_VickyIntro:
How dare you make my granddaughter
cry!

For that, I'm going to smack you!
Prepare to lose!
Route111_Text_VickyPostBattle:
If you're not in any hurry,
visit with us awhile.
Route111_Text_VictorDefeat:
Aiyah!
You're a lot tougher than I expected!
Route111_Text_VictorIntro: That's the spirit! I like you!
Route111_Text_VictorPostBattle:
Hey, all!
I've found a pretty strong TRAINER!
Route111_Text_VictoriaDefeat:
Oh, gosh!
I can't get over how strong you are!
Route111_Text_VictoriaIntro: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?

You must be quite the TRAINER to beat
my husband, though.
It's my turn to battle now!
Route111_Text_VictoriaPostBattle:
There's a strong TRAINER here!
This one's really strong!
Route111_Text_ViviIntro:
But I'm strong, too!
Really! Honestly!
Route111_Text_WateredPlantsEveryDayTakeB:
I watered the plants every day.
They grew lots of flowers.
And they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.

Here you go!
You can have it!
Route111_Text_WhatColorBerriesToLookForT:
I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look
for today?
Route111_Text_WiltonDefeat:
I see, you've toughened them
considerably.
Route111_Text_WiltonIntro:
Show me how much you've toughened
your POKéMON.
Route111_Text_WiltonPostBattle:
POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much
through battling.

What's important is to never give up
even if you lose.
Route111_Text_WiltonPostRematch:
Since you're that strong, you should
aim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.
Route111_Text_WiltonRegister:
There is much to be learned from
your training style.

I request a rematch if it
behooves you.
Route111_Text_WiltonRematchIntro:
We're training here to elevate our
game to the next level.
Stay and train with us!
Route111_Text_WinstrateFamilyDestroyedMe:
I challenged the WINSTRATE family,
but four matches in a row is tough
going… They destroyed me.
Route111_Text_WinstrateHouseSign:
“Our family's hearts beat as one!”
THE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE
Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Gran: There's no question that you're strong.

But if you were to battle my grandson,
you'd end up crying in frustration.

He's much stronger than any TRAINER
our family knows.

He must be challenging the POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.

Knowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!

My grandson must be challenging the
POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.

Knowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!
Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Like:
We use this MACHO BRACE to more
effectively strengthen our POKéMON
in training.

Since you've beaten all of us here,
I don't know if you need it, but we
would like you to have our MACHO BRACE.
Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_MySo:
You're the first TRAINER I've seen who
deploys POKéMON so masterfully.

But, I should tell you--my son is
stronger than you.

He even took the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge, I'll have you know.
Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Pass:
When it comes to POKéMON battles,
we tend to be pretty passionate.
Route111_WinstrateFamilysHouse_Text_Stro:
But my big brother is even stronger
than Grandma.
Route112_CableCarStation_Text_CableCarRe:
The CABLE CAR is ready to go up.
Would you like to be on it?
Route112_CableCarStation_Text_RideAnothe: Please ride with us another time.
Route112_Text_BriceIntro:
Hahahaha!
