How about we have a battle?
You and me!
Hahahaha!
Route112_Text_BricePostBattle:
Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!
Hahahaha-hatchoo!
Route112_Text_BryantDefeat: What a bumpy ride that was!
Route112_Text_BryantIntro:
I caught hot POKéMON in FIERY PATH!
Take a look!
Route112_Text_BryantPostBattle:
I like the way you battle.
It has a certain flair to it.
Route112_Text_CantLetAnyonePassUntilThey:
You got it. And until they come back,
we're not to let anyone pass, right.
Route112_Text_CarolIntro:
When you're out on a picnic, why,
you simply have to sing!
Come on, sing with me!
Route112_Text_CarolPostBattle:
It doesn't matter if you're good or bad
at singing or POKéMON.
If you have the most fun, you win!
Route112_Text_LarryIntro:
I'm strong.
I won't cry if I lose.
Route112_Text_LarryPostBattle:
I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!
Snivel…
Route112_Text_LeaderGoingToAwakenThing:
Hey, man, is our leader really going
to awaken that thing?
Route112_Text_MtChimneyCableCarSign:
MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR
“A short walk {UP_ARROW} way!”
Route112_Text_MtChimneySign:
“For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,
please take the CABLE CAR.”
Route112_Text_NotEasyToGetBackToLavaridg:
Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if
I went down these ledges, it'd be no
easy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.
Route112_Text_OhThatsWhyCrewWentToFallar:
Oh, I get it now. That's why the rest
of the crew went out to FALLARBOR.
Route112_Text_ShaylaDefeat:
Oh, how strong you are!
You've given me quite a shock!
Route112_Text_ShaylaIntro:
Oh, aren't you an adorable TRAINER!
Please, I need a romantic battle!
I'm somewhat decent!
Route112_Text_ShaylaPostBattle:
Are you busy right now?
I was thinking that maybe we can have
a rematch right now…
But it's all right if you're busy.
Route112_Text_TrentIntro:
My legs are solid from pounding up
and down the mountains.

They're not going to buckle easily,
friend!
Route112_Text_TrentPostBattle:
Try hiking, and I mean really
pounding, on these mountain trails
with a heavy pack weighing dozens of
pounds.

That, my friend, will get your body
into serious shape.
Route112_Text_TrentRegister:
Ow, my legs have cramped up.
Can you grab me some bandages from
my backpack?

No, that's my POKéNAV!
Oh, fine, I'll register you.
Route112_Text_TrentRematchIntro:
I've been keeping fit by hiking.
Power, I have in spades!
Route112_Text_TrentRematchPostBattle:
I hear there are some seriously tough
TRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.

I intend to get up there and give them
a challenge!
Route112_Text_YeahWeNeedMeteorite:
Sounds like it, yeah. But I heard
we need a METEORITE to do it.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_AllThatAshBu:
You've collected all that ash, but you
don't want anything, huff-puff?
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_ExplainSootS:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk
through piles of ash, huff-puff.

And it will fill up with the volcanic ash,
huff-puff.

Once you think you've collected a good
amount, come see me, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_FunToBlowGla:
It's fun to blow a glass flute while
my boss is talking.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_GoCollectAsh:
This area is covered in volcanic ash,
huff-puff!

I make glass out of volcanic ash
and make items, huff-puff.
Go collect ashes with this, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_HaventGotYou:
Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK
with you, huff-puff.

You have to keep it with you to collect
volcanic ash, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IllMakeItemF:
Okay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff.
Just wait a little while, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IsThatTheIte:
A {STR_VAR_1}, huff-puff?
Is that the one for you, huff-puff?
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_IveFinishedG:
Ah, I've finished your {STR_VAR_1}.
Take it, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_LetsSeeColle:
Have you collected ashes, huff-puff?
Let me see, huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInBag:
Oh?
You've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.

I'll hold on to it, so come back later,
huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NoRoomInPC:
Oh?
You've no room in your PC, huff-puff?

I'll hold on to it, so come back later,
huff-puff.
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_NotEnoughAsh:
Hmmm…
There's not enough ash here, huff-puff.
I can't make glass with this, huff-puff.

Let's see… {STR_VAR_1} is the number of steps
you'll need to walk for me to make you
a BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.

There's not enough ash here to make
that, though, huff-puff.

Let's see… {STR_VAR_2} is the number of steps
you'll need to walk through volcanic ash
for me to make that item, huff-puff.

Which item would you rather have me
make instead, huff-puff?
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichGlassIt:
Oh!
You've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!

I'll make you a glass item, huff-puff!
Which one would you like, huff-puff?
Route113_GlassWorkshop_Text_WhichWouldYo: Which one would you like, huff-puff?
Route113_Text_AshCanBeFashionedIntoGlass:
Wahahaha! Today's technology is a
wondrous thing!

Take this volcanic ash here.
It can be fashioned into glass.
Route113_Text_CobyIntro:
Pfft, with these wings I can
flick you away!
Route113_Text_CobyPostBattle:
I don't know what to say when I get
beaten so easily…
Route113_Text_DillonIntro:
The volcano's eruption is proof that
the earth is alive.
Route113_Text_DillonPostBattle:
Ouch! Owww! I can't see!
I got ashes in my eyelashes!
Route113_Text_FunWalkingThroughAsh:
It's fun walking through the volcano's
ashes on the ground and grass.

You can see where you walked--it's
really neat!
Route113_Text_GlassWorkshopSign:
GLASS WORKSHOP
“Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”
Route113_Text_JaylenIntro:
Can you guess why it's so cool
around here?
Route113_Text_JaylenPostBattle:
The volcanic ash blocks the sun,
so it doesn't get very warm.
That's good for me--I can't stand heat!
Route113_Text_LaoIntro:
From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!
I challenge thee!
Route113_Text_LaoPostBattle:
I must refine the art of concealment.
I bid thee farewell.
Route113_Text_LaoPostRematch:
My flawless concealment was let down
by my immature battle skills…
Route113_Text_LaoRegister:
Yiiyaah! Witness the ancient ninja
technique of POKéNAV registration!
Route113_Text_LaoRematchIntro:
From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!
I challenge thee!
Route113_Text_LawrenceIntro:
Were you maybe in the middle
of gathering volcanic ashes?
Route113_Text_LawrencePostBattle: I ought to hide under the ashes, too.
Route113_Text_LungDefeat:
I'll use my ninjutsu on you…
“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!
Route113_Text_LungIntro:
Thanks for finding me!
But we still have to battle!
Route113_Text_LungPostBattle:
You know what's crummy about hiding?
It's lonely if no one comes along.
Route113_Text_MadelineIntro:
I use this parasol to ward off this
filthy, yucky volcanic ash from
my dear NUMEL.
Route113_Text_MadelinePostBattle:
You're very good at this.
I must say I'm impressed!
Route113_Text_MadelinePostRematch:
You've remained very good at this.
I must say I'm impressed!
Route113_Text_MadelineRegister:
Here, slide under my parasol.
Let me register you in my POKéNAV.
Route113_Text_MadelineRematchIntro:
Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?
May I invite you to battle?
Route113_Text_SophieDefeat:
This is a dream.
I'm sure of it…
Route113_Text_SophieIntro:
The warmth here is making me drowsy.
Battle with me so I can stay awake.
Route113_Text_SophiePostBattle:
Losing burns me up…
I'm just going to sleep right here!
Zzz!
Route113_Text_TiaDefeat:
TIA: We couldn't win… It's boring,
so I'm getting some more ashes.
Route113_Text_TiaIntro:
TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.
We battle POKéMON, too.
Route113_Text_TiaNotEnoughMons:
TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.
If we don't, we won't win!
Route113_Text_TiaPostBattle:
TIA: We have a lot of ashes!
I think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!
Route113_Text_ToriDefeat:
TORI: We lost… It's boring, so I'm going
to get some more ashes.
Route113_Text_ToriIntro:
TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.
We battle POKéMON, too.
Route113_Text_ToriNotEnoughMons:
TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.
If we didn't, we would lose!
Route113_Text_ToriPostBattle:
TORI: How much ash do we have?
Enough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.
Route113_Text_TrainerTipsRegisterKeyItem:
You may register one of the KEY ITEMS
in your BAG as SELECT.

Simply press SELECT to use
the registered item conveniently.
Route113_Text_WyattDefeat:
Y-you're all happy to win?
Even though it's only me?
Route113_Text_WyattIntro:
Y-you want to battle with me?
Even though I just caught my POKéMON?
Route113_Text_WyattPostBattle:
Oh, so now you want to say a word to
the loser?

Aren't you just the coolest?
Humph!
Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_Crammed:
THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA…
HOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND…
STONES, SOIL, AND ROCK…
Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_DigRetu:
If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a
cave, you're returned to the entrance…
Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_HaveThi:
My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC…
He's a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…

He loves digging holes, too…
He dug this hole by himself…

You can have this, so you can DIG
holes just like my big brother…
Route114_FossilManiacsHouse_Text_RocksFi:
Rocks in peculiar shapes fill
the display case…
Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_DevonC:
You found a FOSSIL, didn't you?
That's so nice… It's so dreamy…

What are you going to do with that
FOSSIL?

From what I've heard, DEVON is doing
research on reviving POKéMON from
FOSSILS…

I love my FOSSILS, so I would never
do anything like that…
Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_Fossil:
FOSSILS are so… Wonderful…
It's so dreamy…
Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_LookIn:
I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC…
I'm a nice guy who loves FOSSILS…

But the FOSSILS around these parts all
belong to me… None for you…

If you can't bear to go without
a FOSSIL, look in a desert where there
are boulders and sand that may hide
FOSSILS…
Route114_FossilManiacsTunnel_Text_NotSaf:
Oh…
It's not safe that way…

I was digging away, you see…
When the whole wall collapsed…

I think there's a giant cavern
underneath now…

But I've left it alone because I don't
think there are any FOSSILS there…
Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EmailFromBil:
There's an e-mail from someone on
the PC.

“Your Storage System offers more
convenience than mine.

“It has a lot of user-friendly features
that make it fun and useful, too.

“It makes me proud that I played
a part in its development.

“Here's hoping that you'll continue
research in Storage Systems.
Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_EverythingCl:
I'm sorry everything is so cluttered…
When I get engrossed in research,
things end up this way…

This is embarrassing… Please keep
this a secret in exchange for this.
Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_OrganizeYour:
May I offer advice about my POKéMON
Storage System?

You should organize your BOXES so you
can tell which POKéMON are in them.
Route114_LanettesHouse_Text_ResearchNote:
It's LANETTE's research notes.
There's information about BOXES.
Design BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.

Each TRAINER should be able to store
420 POKéMON on the PC system.

A marking system should be added to
make POKéMON easier to organize.

The name and wallpaper design of each
BOX will be made changeable to please
the stored POKéMON.

When storing a POKéMON, it should be
sent to the BOX inspected last.

If that BOX is full, the received
POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.

In other words, when a BOX is examined,
it is automatically selected as the BOX
to which POKéMON are sent.
Route114_Text_AllMyMonDoesIsRoarTakeThis:
All my POKéMON does is ROAR…
No one dares to come near me…

Sigh… If you would, please take
this TM away…
Route114_Text_AngelinaDefeat:
Oh, I see.
That's good to know.
Route114_Text_AngelinaIntro:
Have you made your POKéMON evolve
very much?
Route114_Text_AngelinaPostBattle:
Some POKéMON change so much when
they evolve, it's startling!
Route114_Text_BernieIntro:
If you're lighting a campfire,
make sure you have water handy.
Route114_Text_BerniePostBattle:
You really do have to be careful with
any sort of fire in a forest.

Don't ever underestimate the power
of fire.
Route114_Text_BerniePostRematch:
You really do have to be careful with
any sort of fire in a forest.

Don't ever underestimate the power
of fire.
Route114_Text_BernieRegister:
You set my spirit on fire.
Let's register each other!
Route114_Text_BernieRematchDefeat:
I got hosed down before I could
flare up, I guess.
Route114_Text_BernieRematchIntro:
Have you learned to keep water handy
for campfires?
Route114_Text_CharlotteDefeat: That wasn't cute in the least!
Route114_Text_CharlotteIntro:
Me!
I'm not just a pretty face!
Route114_Text_CharlottePostBattle:
I don't want a POKéMON that's
just cute.

I adore cute ones that have a quirk
or two!
Route114_Text_ClaudeDefeat: If we were fishing, I would've won…
Route114_Text_ClaudeIntro:
If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand
a chance against me.
So, bring on your POKéMON!
Route114_Text_ClaudePostBattle:
I think I'll try my luck at landing
a big one at METEOR FALLS.

There has to be something in there.
I just know it.
Route114_Text_ExplainRoar:
TM05 contains ROAR.
A ROAR sends POKéMON scurrying.
Route114_Text_FunToThinkAboutBerries:
Which BERRY should be planted?
Should you use or hoard BERRIES?
Route114_Text_IvyDefeat: IVY: What an amazing battle style!
Route114_Text_IvyIntro: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?
Route114_Text_IvyNotEnoughMons:
IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON?
I think it must feel lonesome.
Route114_Text_IvyPostBattle:
IVY: I started training POKéMON
because TYRA, my student mentor,
taught me!
Route114_Text_KaiDefeat:
What was that about?
Did mine lose in size?
Route114_Text_KaiIntro:
I landed a big one!
A huge one, I tell you!
Route114_Text_KaiPostBattle:
Okay!
I'll just fish me a bigger one!
Route114_Text_LennyIntro:
You're supposed to shout
“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't
echo here!
Route114_Text_LennyPostBattle:
When I was a wee tyke, I believed there
was someone copying me and shouting
back, “Yodelayhihoo.”
Route114_Text_LoveUsingBerryCrushShareBe:
I love using the BERRY CRUSH machine,
so I'm collecting BERRIES.
I'll share one with you, if you'd like.
Route114_Text_LucasIntro:
If you're not prepared, you shouldn't
be up in the mountains!
Route114_Text_LucasPostBattle:
In the winter, mountains turn deadly
with blizzards and avalanches.
Route114_Text_MeteorFallsSign:
METEOR FALLS
RUSTBORO CITY THROUGH HERE
Route114_Text_NancyIntro:
I need to exercise after a meal.
Let's have a match!
Route114_Text_NancyPostBattle:
I just had a tasty meal.
I'm getting drowsy…
Route114_Text_NolanDefeat:
I like to battle, but that doesn't
mean I'm good at it…
Route114_Text_NolanIntro:
I like to fish. But I also like to
battle!

If anyone challenges me, I'm there,
even if I'm fishing.
Route114_Text_NolanPostBattle:
I always think that, so I can't walk
away from fishing or POKéMON.
Route114_Text_ShaneIntro:
Camping's fun! You can fish, roast
marshmallows, and tell spooky stories!

But the best of all are the POKéMON
battles!
Route114_Text_ShanePostBattle:
I think it's great that I can go
camping with my POKéMON.
Route114_Text_SteveIntro:
Ufufufufufu…
Want to battle against my POKéMON?
Route114_Text_StevePostBattle:
A big body that's all lumpy and hard,
enormous horns, and vicious fangs…

Ufufufufu…
I wish I had a POKéMON like that…
Route114_Text_StevePostRematch:
When I see POKéMON battling, I get all
shivery and shaky…
Route114_Text_SteveRegister:
Don't forget what you've done to me!
I'll make it so you can't forget!
Route114_Text_SteveRematchDefeat:
I feel so lucky getting to see your
POKéMON…
Route114_Text_SteveRematchIntro:
Ufufufufufu…
Come on, battle my POKéMON…
Route114_Text_TryBerryCrushWithFriends:
You should try the BERRY CRUSH
machine with your friends.
Route114_Text_TyraDefeat: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!
Route114_Text_TyraIntro:
TYRA: Well, sure.
I'm in the mood for it.
I'll teach you a little about POKéMON.
Route114_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons:
TYRA: Giggle…
If you want to battle with us, just one
POKéMON isn't enough!
Route114_Text_TyraPostBattle:
TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY
about POKéMON.
Route115_Text_AlixIntro:
Our eyes met!
There's no getting away now!
Route115_Text_AlixPostBattle:
Oh, well.
I think I will TELEPORT home.
Route115_Text_CyndyIntro:
This beach is my secret training spot!
Don't come butting in!
Route115_Text_CyndyPostBattle:
The sand acts as a cushion to reduce
impact and prevent injury.
This is the perfect place to train.
Route115_Text_CyndyPostRematch:
Even when I lose, I still get some
enjoyment out of it.
It must be that I love POKéMON.
Route115_Text_CyndyRegister:
Okay, fine, you're free to come here.
In return, I'd like to battle you again.
Route115_Text_CyndyRematchDefeat: I can battle but my POKéMON…
Route115_Text_CyndyRematchIntro: Okay, let's get this battle on!
Route115_Text_HectorDefeat:
You…
You want my POKéMON, don't you?
Route115_Text_HectorIntro:
I have a rare POKéMON!
Would you like me to show you?
Route115_Text_HectorPostBattle:
I have this rare POKéMON.
It's enough to keep me satisfied.
Route115_Text_HeleneIntro:
My POKéMON have black belt-level
strength!
Route115_Text_HelenePostBattle:
I rarely meet anyone who's better
than me…

I get it now!
You're a GYM LEADER, aren't you?
Route115_Text_JaidenIntro:
Take that!
Ultra POKéMON ninja attack!
Route115_Text_JaidenPostBattle:
But my POKéMON were ultra,
weren't they?
Route115_Text_KoichiPostBattle:
So long as they seek power, I will
grow strong with them!
Route115_Text_KyraIntro:
I'll battle while I'm running!
Try to keep up with me!
Route115_Text_KyraPostBattle:
I made the mistake of trying to battle
while running!
I should take a run to calm down…
Route115_Text_MarleneIntro:
You've disturbed my meditation…
You'll be punished for it.
Route115_Text_MarlenePostBattle:
I was meditating with my POKéMON.
But this place isn't very peaceful…
Route115_Text_MeteorFallsSign:
METEOR FALLS
FALLARBOR TOWN THROUGH HERE
Route115_Text_NeverKnowWhenCavePokemonWi:
Exploring a cave isn't like walking
on a road.

You never know when wild POKéMON will
appear. It's full of suspense.
Route115_Text_NobIntro:
My strongest skill is busting bricks
with my forehead!
Route115_Text_NobPostBattle: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.

It looks like they'll get a lot better
than me. I'm excited about that.
Route115_Text_NobPostRematch:
My POKéMON will grow stronger!
I'll redouble my training!
Route115_Text_NobRegister:
You impress me! Give me a rematch
after I redo my training!
Route115_Text_NobRematchIntro:
After you beat me, we trained hard to
improve our skills.
Come on, give us a rematch!
Route115_Text_TimothyDefeat:
You're much stronger than
I'd imagined!
Route115_Text_TimothyIntro:
Hm…
You seem rather capable…
Let me keep you company!
Route115_Text_TimothyPostBattle:
There is no such thing as a born genius.
It all depends on effort!
That is what I believe…
Route115_Text_TimothyPostRematch:
I lost because I haven't put in enough
effort!
Route115_Text_TimothyRegister:
Hmm… A loss this thorough has been
a distant memory.

If you would allow it, I wish for
another opportunity to do battle.
Route115_Text_TimothyRematchIntro:
Hm… As always, your agility speaks
for itself.
Come, keep me company!
Route116_Text_BagIsJamPacked:
Your BAG is jam-packed.
I can't give you this REPEAT BALL.
Route116_Text_CanYouHelpMeFindGlasses:
I dropped my glasses…
Can you help me find them?
Route116_Text_CantFindGlassesNotHere:
Hmm…
I can't find my glasses anywhere…
Maybe they're not around here…
Route116_Text_ClarkDefeat:
Gasp… Gasp…
Losing made me tired…
Route116_Text_ClarkIntro:
If the tunnel doesn't go through, then
I'll just go over the top.
Route116_Text_ClarkPostBattle:
It's no big deal if there's no tunnel.
To a HIKER, mountains are roads!
Route116_Text_DawsonDefeat: Oh, baby, say it isn't so!
Route116_Text_DawsonIntro:
When you lay your eyes on my POKéMON's
gorgeous fur, their beauty will render
you helpless!
Route116_Text_DawsonPostBattle:
Oh, no, no, no!
You've mussed up my POKéMON's fur!
You've ruined my hairdo, too!
I'll have to call my stylist now!
Route116_Text_DevanPostBattle:
I should try different POKéMON
types, that's what I ought to do.
Route116_Text_DiggingTunnelWhenGoonOrder:
I was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!

That tunnel's filled with POKéMON
that react badly to loud noises.
They could cause an uproar.

That's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling…

I'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle the
POKéMON into an uproar.
Route116_Text_GoonHightailedItOutOfTunne:
That goofy goon hightailed it out of
the tunnel! I can go back to digging!
Route116_Text_JaniceIntro:
Let me teach you how strong my
adorable POKéMON is!
Route116_Text_JanicePostBattle:
POKéMON that possess cuteness and
power, that's ideal, I think.
Route116_Text_JerryDefeat:
I slacked off in school…
That's why I lost.
Route116_Text_JerryIntro:
We learn all sorts of things at the
TRAINER'S SCHOOL.
I want to test things out for real!
Route116_Text_JerryPostBattle:
I'll have to redo some courses at
the TRAINER'S SCHOOL.
If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
Route116_Text_JerryPostRematch:
I'll have to redo some courses at
the TRAINER'S SCHOOL.
If I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.
Route116_Text_JerryRegister1:
I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL
that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.

I don't really get what that means,
so can I just try it?
Route116_Text_JerryRegister2:
I learned at the TRAINER'S SCHOOL
that a POKéNAV can register TRAINERS.

I don't really get what that means,
so can I just try it?
Route116_Text_JerryRematchIntro:
I've been studying seriously at the
TRAINER'S SCHOOL.
I won't lose like I did last time.
Route116_Text_JoeyDefeat:
Ouch! A scrape!
I have to put on a bandage!
Route116_Text_JoeyIntro:
My POKéMON rule!
Check them out!
Route116_Text_JoeyPostBattle:
Bandages are signs of toughness!
I've got another one!
Route116_Text_JohnsonDefeat: That was fun even though I lost.
Route116_Text_JohnsonIntro:
It's a dead end up here.
I'm bored, so can we battle?
Route116_Text_JohnsonPostBattle:
Want to stay here and keep
me company?
Route116_Text_JoseDefeat:
I lost!
I thought I had you!
Route116_Text_JoseIntro:
My BUG POKéMON are tough!
Let's battle!
Route116_Text_JosePostBattle:
BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.
So they get strong quickly, too.
Route116_Text_KarenIntro:
I study at school, and I study on
the way home, too!
Route116_Text_KarenPostBattle:
Awww, I'll never become an elegant
TRAINER like ROXANNE this way!
Route116_Text_KarenPostRematch:
You've beaten ROXANNE?
I can't beat you, then. Not yet.
Route116_Text_KarenRegister1:
Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?
I have one, too! Please register me!
Route116_Text_KarenRegister2:
Oh, wow! Isn't that a POKéNAV?
I have one, too! Please register me!
Route116_Text_KarenRematchDefeat:
I'm in shock.
I lost again?
Route116_Text_KarenRematchIntro:
I studied a whole lot since I saw you.
You must see my achievements!
Route116_Text_MayISeeThoseGlasses:
Those glasses!
May I see them for a second?
Route116_Text_NewBallAvailableAtMart:
Our new POKé BALL will be available
at the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.

Please do try it out!
Thank you and bye-bye!
Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingFor:
Hmm…
These are BLACKGLASSES.
They're not what I'm looking for…
Route116_Text_NotWhatImLookingForMaybeTh:
Hmm…
These are BLACKGLASSES.
They're not what I'm looking for…

Maybe my glasses aren't around
here…
Route116_Text_SarahDefeat:
Oh, my goodness.
This is a new experience for me.
Route116_Text_SarahIntro:
Just so you know, I've never once been
bested by anyone at anything.
Route116_Text_SarahPostBattle:
My life of luxury affords me all that
I could possibly desire.

However, when it comes to POKéMON,
my wealth has no meaning.
Route116_Text_ScoundrelMadeOffWithPeeko: Ohhh, what am I to do?

We were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when
we were jumped by an odd thug…

The scoundrel made off with my
darling PEEKO!
Route116_Text_ThankYouTokenOfAppreciatio:
You're that person who not only helped
me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also got
back my stolen package and then even
graciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!

CAPT. STERN informed us that the
package arrived, too!
I thank you very, very much!

Why, if I were a rain cloud, I would
shower you with gratitude and hail
you as a hero!

For you, the most wonderful TRAINER,
I bear good news!

Recently, our company developed
a new kind of POKé BALL.

As a token of our appreciation, this
is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!
Route116_Text_TokenOfAppreciation:
As a token of our appreciation for
your delivering our package, I have
a gift of a new kind of POKé BALL
for our most wonderful TRAINER!
Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBToStopEvolutio:
If you want to stop a POKéMON from
evolving, press the B Button while it
is trying to evolve.
The startled POKéMON will stop.
This is called an evolution cancel.
Route116_Text_TrainerTipsBagHasPockets:
Items you obtain are automatically
placed in the appropriate POCKETS.

No TRAINER can afford to be without
a BAG of their own.
Route116_Text_WantToDigTunnel: I want to dig that tunnel!
Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_GetToVe:
To get to VERDANTURF without using
this TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the
sea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,
then travel through MAUVILLE.
Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_ManDigg:
There's a man digging his way to
VERDANTURF all by his lonesome.
He's desperate to get through.

He says that if he digs little by little
without using machines, he won't
disturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid
harming the natural environment.
I wonder if he made it through yet.
Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_TunnelH:
Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF
has gone through!

Sometimes, if you hope strongly enough,
dreams do come true.
Route116_TunnelersRestHouse_Text_WeHadTo:
At first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.
But, we had to stop.

It turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON in
the area.

So, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_GoodToSeeYo:
Ah, it's you! Good to see you.
Your POKéMON can only be doing good!
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_HusbandWasL: My husband was looking for you.
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_ItWillCostX:
If you want your {STR_VAR_1} back,
it will cost ¥{STR_VAR_2}.
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TakeBackWhi: Which POKéMON will you take back?
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TakeOtherOn:
Will you take back the other one,
too?
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TakeYourMon: Will you take your POKéMON back?
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_TookBackMon:
{PLAYER} took back {STR_VAR_1} from
the DAY-CARE LADY.
