We can raise two of your POKéMON.
Would you like us to raise one more?
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WellRaiseYo:
Fine, we'll raise your {STR_VAR_1}
for a while.
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYou:
If you leave me that POKéMON,
what will you battle with?
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhichMonSho:
Which POKéMON should we raise for
you?
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_WouldYouLik: We can raise POKéMON for you.
Would you like us to raise one?
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouHaveJust:
Oh? But you have just one
POKéMON.
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YoullBeLeft:
If you leave that POKéMON with
me, you'll be left with just one.

You will be better off if you catch
some more, I dare say.
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YourMonHasG:
By level, your {STR_VAR_1} has
grown by {STR_VAR_2}.
Route117_PokemonDayCare_Text_YourTeamIsF:
Your POKéMON team is full.
Make room, then come see me.
Route117_Text_AishaDefeat:
I don't waste any time being angry
over a loss--I would rather train.
Route117_Text_AishaIntro:
Concentrate on getting the win.
That's how I battle!
Route117_Text_AishaPostBattle:
I think that if you worry about losing,
you're more likely to lose.
Route117_Text_AnnaAndMegRegister:
ANNA: We can't take this lying down!
You will come back, won't you?
Route117_Text_AnnaDefeat:
ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student
partner! Let me win!
Route117_Text_AnnaIntro:
ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student
partner. I have to do good!
Route117_Text_AnnaNotEnoughMons:
ANNA: If you want to battle us,
bring two POKéMON with you.
Route117_Text_AnnaPostBattle:
ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good
combinations.
I'd say you're second only to us!
Route117_Text_AnnaPostRematch:
ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good
combinations.
I'd say you're second only to us!
Route117_Text_AnnaRematchDefeat: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.
Route117_Text_AnnaRematchIntro:
ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of
my junior partner, right?
Route117_Text_AnnaRematchNotEnoughMons:
ANNA: If you want to battle us,
bring two POKéMON with you.
Route117_Text_ArentTheseFlowersPretty:
What do you think?
Aren't these flowers pretty?
Route117_Text_BrandiIntro:
Let me demonstrate the power
hidden within a PSYCHIC POKéMON!
Route117_Text_BrandiPostBattle:
PSYCHIC POKéMON are complex.
You should try catching some.
Route117_Text_DayCarePokemonHadNewMove: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.

When I got it back, it had a new move
that I didn't teach it.
I was really, really surprised.
Route117_Text_DayCareSign:
POKéMON DAY CARE
“Let us raise your POKéMON.”
Route117_Text_DerekIntro:
Once a BUG CATCHER!
And now a BUG MANIAC!

But my love for POKéMON remains
unchanged!
Route117_Text_DerekPostBattle:
All I did was follow my heart, and now
they call me a BUG MANIAC…

Still, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON,
so it's only natural that they call me
a BUG MANIAC.
Route117_Text_DoYouWantEgg:
We were raising your POKéMON,
and my goodness, were we surprised!

We don't know how it got there,
but your POKéMON had it.
Route117_Text_DylanIntro:
I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,
whatever, let's have a battle!
Route117_Text_DylanPostBattle:
I might have dropped to last during
that battle…
Route117_Text_DylanPostRematch:
I was tops in swimming and cycling,
but I'm not quite that confident with
POKéMON yet.
Route117_Text_DylanRegister:
POKéMON have to be strong, too?
I'd like you to train me!
Route117_Text_DylanRematchDefeat: I ran out of energy again!
Route117_Text_DylanRematchIntro:
I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon,
but I'm comfortably ahead.
Let's make this a quick battle!
Route117_Text_FriendlyWithOtherTrainersM:
By the way, about your {STR_VAR_1},
it seemed to be friendly with
{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3}.

I may even have seen it receiving
a piece of MAIL.
Route117_Text_IWillKeepDoYouWantIt:
I really will keep it.
You do want this, yes?
Route117_Text_IllKeepIt:
Well then, I'll keep it.
Thanks!
Route117_Text_IsaacIntro:
Listen, could I get you to battle
the POKéMON I'm raising?
Route117_Text_IsaacPostBattle:
Polishing a unique aspect of one's
character is another way of enjoying
POKéMON.
Route117_Text_IsaacPostRematch:
Your POKéMON are growing good!
You should enter them in CONTESTS.
Route117_Text_IsaacRegister:
I'm going to redouble my training.
Would you come look in on us?
Route117_Text_IsaacRematchDefeat:
You know how to raise them properly.
You might have DAY CARE skills…
Route117_Text_IsaacRematchIntro:
The POKéMON I've been raising are
looking good, just like before.
Route117_Text_LydiaIntro:
Please, allow me to evaluate if you
have raised your POKéMON properly.
Route117_Text_LydiaPostBattle:
Try raising POKéMON with more
attention to their character traits.
Route117_Text_LydiaPostRematch:
POKéMON seem to like different kinds
of {POKEBLOCK}S, depending on their nature.
Route117_Text_LydiaRegister:
I'm glad I met a superb TRAINER in you.
I hope to see you again.
Route117_Text_LydiaRematchIntro:
Allow me to reevaluate if you have
raised your POKéMON properly.
Route117_Text_MariaDefeat:
I need to get more practices in,
I guess.
Route117_Text_MariaIntro:
I do my triathlon training with POKéMON,
so I'm pretty confident about my speed.
Route117_Text_MariaPostBattle:
Training is meaningful only if you
keep it up regularly.

Okay! I'll resume my training!
Tomorrow!
Route117_Text_MariaPostRematch:
I'll resume training tomorrow.
Let's battle again sometime!
Route117_Text_MariaRegister:
You appear to be training properly…
If you'd like, I'll battle you later!
Route117_Text_MariaRematchDefeat:
I need to get more practices in,
I guess.
Route117_Text_MariaRematchIntro:
Are you keeping up with your training?
I sure am!
Let me show you the evidence!
Route117_Text_MegDefeat:
MEG: Oh, no!
I'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down…
Route117_Text_MegIntro:
MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super
senior student partner and beat you!
Route117_Text_MegNotEnoughMons:
MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?
We can't battle with you, then.
We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
Route117_Text_MegPostBattle:
MEG: I dragged ANNA down…
If I didn't, she would have won!
Route117_Text_MegPostRematch:
MEG: I battled together with my
senior partner, but we lost…
Route117_Text_MegRematchIntro:
MEG: I'm going to tag up with my
senior partner and win this time!
Route117_Text_MegRematchNotEnoughMons:
MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?
We can't battle with you, then.
We want to have a 2-on-2 battle.
Route117_Text_MelinaIntro:
Isn't it nice? To battle while looking
at pretty flowers?
Route117_Text_MelinaPostBattle:
It feels wonderful to go for a jog
while looking at flowers.
Route117_Text_ReceivedEgg:
{PLAYER} received the EGG from
the DAY-CARE MAN.
Route117_Text_SeeWifeIfYouWantToPickUpMo:
If you want to pick up your POKéMON,
have a word with my wife.
Route117_Text_SeeWifeIfYoudLikeMeToRaise:
I help take care of the precious
POKéMON of TRAINERS.

If you'd like me to raise your POKéMON,
have a word with my wife.
Route117_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForIt:
You have no room for it…
Come back when you've made room.
Route117_Text_YourMonIsDoingFine:
Ah, it's you! Good to see you.
Your {STR_VAR_1}'s doing fine.
Route117_Text_YourMonsAreDoingFine:
Ah, it's you! Your {STR_VAR_1} and
{STR_VAR_2} are doing fine.
Route118_Text_BarnyDefeat:
I thought I was doing okay in my
training…
Route118_Text_BarnyIntro:
I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.
I'm raising the POKéMON I caught.
Route118_Text_BarnyPostBattle:
I couldn't win by training POKéMON
while I fished…
Was I doing things in half measures?
Route118_Text_CanCrossRiversWithSurf:
Even if there isn't a boat, you can
cross rivers and the sea if you have
a POKéMON that knows SURF.

POKéMON can be counted on to do so
much!
Route118_Text_ChesterPostBattle:
If they'd get stronger, they'd be able
to fly more freely…
Route118_Text_DaltonIntro: Let my melody rock your soul!
Route118_Text_DaltonPostBattle:
An electric guitar doesn't always
have to be noisy…

It can be strummed to squeeze out
this heart-stirring melody…
Route118_Text_DaltonPostRematch:
When I play, my emotions should reach
you through my electric guitar…
Route118_Text_DaltonRegister:
When I compose better melodies,
you have to come listen, okay?
Route118_Text_DaltonRematchIntro:
A melody from my POKéMON and me…
Let us deliver it to your soul.
Route118_Text_DeandreDefeat:
Come in, POKéMON! Are you okay?
POKéMON 1, 2, and 3?!
Route118_Text_DeandrePostBattle:
Isn't it cool that I have a POKéMON
battle team?
You can copy me--I don't mind!
Route118_Text_PerryIntro:
BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in
the sky… They're the best!
Route118_Text_PerryPostBattle:
You've got great POKéMON.
I'll have to train mine better.
Route118_Text_RoseDefeat:
Oh, dear me.
I seem to have lost.
Route118_Text_RoseIntro:
The aroma of flowers has a magical
power. It cleanses us body and soul.
Route118_Text_RosePostBattle:
Flowers, POKéMON…
I love whatever smells nice.
Route118_Text_RosePostRematch:
If you use a sweet aroma properly,
POKéMON will be attracted by it.
Route118_Text_RoseRegister:
Sniff… That odor--it's a POKéNAV!
We must register each other!
Route118_Text_RoseRematchDefeat:
The power of aroma…
It didn't seem to do much.
Route118_Text_RoseRematchIntro:
Were you drawn here by the sweet
aroma?
Route118_Text_StevenQuestions:
It's me, STEVEN!
We met in the cave near DEWFORD.

Have you met many kinds of POKéMON
since I last saw you?

There are many, many kinds of POKéMON
in this wide world of ours.

If you wanted to raise only your
favorites, that's fine.

Perhaps you find it more fun to raise
all sorts of POKéMON.

As a TRAINER of POKéMON,
what do you think?
Of course, it's not any of my business.

It would be nice if we were to meet
again somewhere.
Route118_Text_TryCatchingMonWithGoodRod:
Try catching all sorts of POKéMON
with your GOOD ROD.
Route118_Text_TryYourLuckFishing:
Wherever there's water, try your luck
at fishing.
Route118_Text_WadeIntro: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.

But for TRAINERS, the key ingredients
are POKéMON and heart, of course!
Route118_Text_WadePostBattle:
Come to think of it, fishing is a battle
between a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.
Route118_Text_YouAgreeGoodRodIsGood:
Hmm!
A GOOD ROD is really good!
Route119_House_Text_RumorAboutCaveOfOrig:
I heard about a cave called the CAVE
OF ORIGIN.

People rumor that the spirits of
POKéMON are revived there. Could
something like that really happen?
Route119_Text_BrendanDefeat:
Hmm…
You've gotten pretty darn decent.
Route119_Text_BrendanExplainFly:
BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON
instantly carries you to any town
you've already visited.

But you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE 
to do that.
Anyway, I have to move along.
Route119_Text_BrendanIllGiveYouThis:
BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough
to search for POKéMON anywhere.

Here, I'll give you this.
Try it out.
Route119_Text_BrendanIntro:
BRENDAN: {PLAYER}! So this is where
you've been looking for POKéMON?

Let me see how good you got.
I'll test you!

Now!
It's a battle, so battle!
Route119_Text_BrentIntro:
We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!
We MIMIC what you do!
Route119_Text_CanYourMonMakeSecretBase:
Can your POKéMON use its SECRET POWER
on a big pile of grass and make a
SECRET BASE?
Route119_Text_CatherineDefeat:
Accidents happen when you're not
prepared!
Route119_Text_CatherineIntro:
For someone on an adventure,
you're traveling awfully light.
Route119_Text_CatherinePostBattle:
You're traveling light but you have
everything you need.

You're on top of things mentally and
physically, too.
Route119_Text_CatherinePostRematch:
In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,
rely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON
rely on you.
Route119_Text_CatherineRegister:
Do you have a POKéNAV?
It's a must-have tool for any TRAINER.

Oh, you do have one!
Let's register each other, then!
Route119_Text_CatherineRematchIntro:
How's your journey with POKéMON
going?
Route119_Text_ChrisDefeat:
I don't have a clue about what it
takes to win.
Route119_Text_ChrisIntro:
You spoke to me…
So you want to challenge me!

Sure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught
while SURFING!
Route119_Text_ChrisPostBattle: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON…
Route119_Text_DaytonIntro:
Hohoho!
I like kid TRAINERS!
Let's have a good one!
Route119_Text_DaytonPostBattle:
Hohoho!
I'll try emulating the pep of kid
TRAINERS like you!
Route119_Text_DonaldIntro:
So, we finally meet!
My BUG POKéMON will keep you company!
Route119_Text_DonaldPostBattle:
I want to MIMIC you some more.
Can you hurry up and move?
Route119_Text_DontGoNearWeatherInstitute:
Hey, you! Please don't go near the
WEATHER INSTITUTE.
Route119_Text_DougDefeat: Whoop, that was a great match!
Route119_Text_DougIntro:
Yep, you've finally caught me!
Or were you trying to avoid me?
Route119_Text_DougPostBattle:
We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!
I hope you enjoyed our performance.
Route119_Text_FabianDefeat:
You showed me who's the boss!
We'll have to take the loss, oh, no!
Route119_Text_FabianIntro:
Hit me with a power chord!
Victory is mine!
It's our time to shine, whoa, yeah!
Route119_Text_FabianPostBattle:
Hit me with another power chord!
Leave me alone!
Your win you have to atone!
Route119_Text_GregIntro: You don't know who I am, do you?

But, I also don't know you.
So, we'll battle!
Route119_Text_GregPostBattle:
Until you go away somewhere, we'll
keep on mimicking your every move.
Route119_Text_HideoIntro: To hide a tree, use a forest!
Route119_Text_HideoPostBattle:
To hide a tree, use a forest!
To hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!

There is no deep, hidden meaning
to that.
Route119_Text_HughIntro: The vast sky holds untold promise!

Nothing can compare to the sheer
exhilaration of flight!
Route119_Text_HughPostBattle:
My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of
flying come true!
Route119_Text_JacksonDefeat:
I didn't have enough POKéMON
know-how…
Route119_Text_JacksonIntro:
Who has the knowledge and
the technique for survival?
Route119_Text_JacksonPostBattle:
To break away from civilization and
awaken the wild spirit within!
Route119_Text_JacksonPostRematch:
Believe in your POKéMON.
Believe in yourself.
The road will reveal itself to you.
Route119_Text_JacksonRegister:
I hope you'll give me a rematch without
mocking my lack of knowledge.
Route119_Text_JacksonRematchIntro:
I'm going to regain my wild spirit by
being together with POKéMON.
Route119_Text_KentIntro:
The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people
who like to MIMIC.
A battle starts the instant we meet!
Route119_Text_KentPostBattle: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?
Route119_Text_MayDefeat:
I was worried that you might be
struggling with your training.
Route119_Text_MayExplainFly:
MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will
instantly carry you to any town you've
already visited.

But, to use FLY, you have to get
the GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY.
That's important, so don't forget.

You should FLY home and visit
LITTLEROOT for a change.

I bet your mom's worried about you,
{PLAYER}{KUN}.
Route119_Text_MayIntro:
MAY: {PLAYER}{KUN}!
Where were you? I was looking for you!

How much stronger have you gotten?
Let me check for you!

Ready with your POKéMON?
Of course you are! Go!
Route119_Text_MayPresentForYou:
MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to
worry about! Keep it up!
And, here! I have a present for you.
Route119_Text_PhilIntro:
I'll show you the true potential of me
and my BIRD POKéMON!
Route119_Text_PhilPostBattle:
Ever since I was a little kid, I always
admired BIRD POKéMON…
Route119_Text_RachelIntro:
Wherever and whenever I may be,
I always have my parasol in hand.
Route119_Text_RachelPostBattle:
You're asking if my parasol is heavy?
Your BAG is filled with more junk than
I ever carry around.
Route119_Text_ScottWayToGoBeSeeingYou:
I just passed by a TRAINER riding
a BIKE.

You just beat that TRAINER, didn't you?
It was pretty obvious that you did.

The kid looked really upset with
a face all red from anger.

I sure seem to run into you often.
Are you off to FORTREE GYM next?

I expect that you'll do well at the GYM.
Well, I'll be seeing you!
Route119_Text_ScottYouWonAtFortreeGym:
Just as I thought, you won at
the FORTREE GYM.

Your strength…
Perhaps you really are the TRAINER
that I've been searching for.

Remember, you have a fan in me.
I'll be cheering from the sidelines.
Keep up the great work!
Route119_Text_StayAwayFromWeatherInstitu:
Hey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER
INSTITUTE. It's not safe.
Route119_Text_TakashiIntro:
If you're not on your guard,
you're in for some pain!
Route119_Text_TakashiPostBattle:
My surprise attack ended in
failure…
Route119_Text_TallGrassSnaresBikeTires:
The tall grass snares BIKE tires.
There's no way you can cycle here.
Route119_Text_TaylorDefeat: But if you win, I lose…
Route119_Text_TaylorIntro: If you step forward, we step forward.
If you turn right, we turn, too…
Route119_Text_TaylorPostBattle:
I can't MIMIC you winning the match.
That's just impossible…
It's burning me up…
Route119_Text_ThoughtFlyByCatchingBirdMo:
I thought you FLY by catching a whole
flock of BIRD POKéMON, and then
hanging on to them somehow.

But it turns out there's an HM move
called FLY!

I wish I'd known about that a long
time ago…
Route119_Text_TrainerTipsDecoration:
Up to sixteen decorations and
furniture items can be placed in
a SECRET BASE.

Pick your favorite items and create
your very own SECRET BASE exactly the
way you want.
Route119_Text_YasuIntro:
To lurk in shadows, and live in
darkness… That is my destiny.
Route119_Text_YasuPostBattle:
Those defeated in battle withdraw
quietly back into the shadows.
That, too, is destiny…
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Everyo:
While I was sleeping, everyone went
upstairs!
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt1:
Blast it…
Blasted by a kid…

The BOSS got interested in
the research they have going here,
so he sent us out.

But I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know
about what he's thinking?
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Grunt4:
Huh?
What's a kid doing here?

Oh, no…
I'll catch an earful for losing to a kid…
I should just take a nap in the bed…
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_Notici:
On the 2nd floor of the INSTITUTE,
we study the weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

We've been noticing temporary and
isolated cases of droughts and
heavy rain lately…
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_ProfSt:
The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.

But if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.

And thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_TakeRe:
There's a bed…
Let's take a rest.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WhatWe:
Hello!
We've been saved by your actions!

What I don't understand is what on
earth the AQUAS were up to.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_1F_Text_WowYou:
I wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER
like you!
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Changi:
I've been researching rain for many
years, but it's ridiculous to think that
humans can freely change the weather.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Groudo:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

Presently, a drought has been recorded
in {STR_VAR_1}.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt2: Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?

The INSTITUTE created a type of
POKéMON that has something to do with
the weather. We're here to take them!

If the POKéMON they made here can
control the weather freely, then we of
TEAM AQUA definitely need it!
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt3:
We're TEAM AQUA!
We appear wherever anything rare is
found!

You don't have any idea what we of
TEAM AQUA are working towards!
You stay out of our way!
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Grunt5: Oh, will you look at my POKéMON?

Don't tell me you're looking for that
weather POKéMON, too?

That's a no-no!
We were here to get it first!

Humph, so what?
What we want…

What we really want isn't here…
Ihihihihi…
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Kyogre:
I track weather patterns over
the HOENN region.

Presently, heavy rainfall has been
recorded over {STR_VAR_1}.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoAbno:
Abnormal weather conditions are
no longer being reported.

The occasional rainfall is a blessing,
really.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_NoRoom:
Hm? You don't seem to have any room
for this POKéMON.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Pokemo:
That POKéMON changes shape according
to the weather conditions.

There're plenty of them in the
INSTITUTE--go ahead and take it.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Shelly:
You're going to meddle in TEAM AQUA's
affairs?

You're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!

You're so cute, you're disgusting!
I'll put you down, kiddy!

It's bad enough to have TEAM MAGMA
blunder about, but now there's you!

What makes you want to sniff around
in our business, anyway?
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_TeamMa:
A TEAM MAGMA mob just passed
the WEATHER INSTITUTE.

They appear to be headed for
MT. PYRE!
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_Thanks:
Thanks!
Thanks to you, we're safe!

It might be an odd way of thanking you,
but take this POKéMON.
Route119_WeatherInstitute_2F_Text_WeHave:
We can't waste any more time here!
We have to hurry to MT. PYRE, too!

Ahahahaha!
TEAM MAGMA, just you wait!
Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_BagIsFull:
{PLAYER}{KUN}の　バッグ
いっぱい　みたい　だね
Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ManInLavend:
Don't you think it's hard to think
up good names for POKéMON?

Especially if you've caught a
whole bunch?

In LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man
who rates POKéMON nicknames.

He can even help you rename your
POKéMON, too.
Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_RockTunnelT:
If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER
TOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.

You can get to ROCK TUNNEL from
CERULEAN CITY.
Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_BigMonAslee:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…
A big POKéMON is asleep on a road!
Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainItem:
There are items on the ground that
may be hidden from view.

Use the ITEMFINDER to detect any
hidden items close to you.

The machine is a bit limited.
It can't pinpoint item locations.

What it does is show the direction
where the item is.

Use it to get your bearings, then
search the suspect area by hand.
Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemfin:
Hi! Remember me?
I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.

If your POKéDEX has complete data
on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to
give you a reward.

PROF. OAK entrusted me with the
{STR_VAR_2} for you.

Have you gathered data on at least
{STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?
Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYo:
Great! You have caught or owned
{STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!
Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_RockTunnelG:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…

To get to LAVENDER TOWN from
CERULEAN CITY…

ROCK TUNNEL appears to be a good
route to take.
Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_WhatABreath:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…
Route11_Text_BerniePostBattle: Well, better get back to work.
Route11_Text_BernieRematchIntro: Keep your eyes out for live wires!
Route11_Text_BraxtonIntro:
Careful!
I'm laying down some cables!
Route11_Text_BraxtonPostBattle: Spread the word to save energy!
Route11_Text_BraxtonRematchIntro:
But be careful!
I'm still laying down some cables!
Route11_Text_DarianRematchIntro:
Perhaps I am destined to remain
that way…
Route11_Text_DaveIntro:
I raised my POKéMON carefully.
They should be ready by now!
Route11_Text_DavePostBattle:
Tch…
I better go find stronger ones!
Route11_Text_DaveRematchIntro:
I raised my POKéMON carefully.
They should be ready by now.
This time, they should win, too.
Route11_Text_DillonDefeat:
My POKéMON couldn't win…
Haven't they grown enough?
Route11_Text_DillonIntro:
I just became a TRAINER.
But, I think I can win.
Route11_Text_DillonRematchIntro:
I became a TRAINER a while ago.
But, I think I can win.
Route11_Text_DirkPostBattle: You were just lucky, that's all.
Route11_Text_DirkRematchIntro:
…And if I did, I've forgotten all
about it!
Route11_Text_EddiePostBattle:
I did my best.
I have no regrets.
Route11_Text_EddieRematchIntro:
You know, right?
Let's go, but don't cheat!
Route11_Text_HugoPostBattle:
POKéMON is life!
And to live is to play games!
Route11_Text_HugoRematchIntro:
Win, lose, or draw!
Now for our rematch!
Route11_Text_JasperPostBattle:
You can't be a coward in the world
of POKéMON!
Route11_Text_JasperRematchIntro:
Competing is the ultimate thrill.
I still can't get enough!
Route11_Text_YasuDefeat:
Darn!
My POKéMON need to be stronger!
Route11_Text_YasuIntro:
I'm the best in my class.
I train every morning.
Route11_Text_YasuPostBattle:
There's a fat POKéMON that comes
down from the mountains.

I bet it'd be strong if you can
catch it.
Route11_Text_YasuRematchIntro:
I'm the best in my class.
I train every morning and night!
Route120_Text_AngelicaIntro:
If any one of them is missing,
the picture of beauty will be ruined.
Route120_Text_AngelicaPostBattle: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.

Why, something like this would only
get in your way.
Route120_Text_BerriesExpressionOfLoveIsn: BERRIES grow by soaking up sunlight.

We help the BERRIES grow by watering
them regularly.
It's an expression of love, isn't it?
Route120_Text_BerryIsRareRaiseItWithCare:
I think that BERRY is rare.
I hope you raise it with loving care.
Route120_Text_CallieDefeat:
Ouch!
I was the one to get hurt.
Route120_Text_CallieIntro:
If you don't pay attention,
you could get hurt!
Route120_Text_CalliePostBattle:
I wonder… Should I evolve my POKéMON?
They're cute the way they are, though.
Route120_Text_ChipIntro:
Are you perhaps searching for ancient
ruins that are rumored to possibly
exist according to legend?
Route120_Text_ChipPostBattle:
That giant rock… I would like to
believe it may indeed contain ancient
ruins. But I see no entrance.
Route120_Text_ClarissaDefeat:
A parasol can't ward off POKéMON
attacks…
Route120_Text_ClarissaIntro: Why am I carrying this parasol?
I'll tell you if you can win against me.
Route120_Text_ClarissaPostBattle:
I don't think strong sunlight is good
for my POKéMON.
So I shield them with my parasol.
Route120_Text_ColinIntro:
Do you have any moves that can strike
a flying POKéMON?
Route120_Text_ColinPostBattle:
The move FLY is convenient,
don't you think?

While the POKéMON is flying,
almost no moves can strike it.
Route120_Text_IllGetMoreBerriesFromBerry:
I'll get more BERRIES from
the BERRY MASTER.
Route120_Text_JeffreyPostRematch:
… … … … … …
… … … … … …
I'll try harder…
For my precious BUG POKéMON…
Route120_Text_JennaIntro:
How's your physical fitness?
If you're not fit, you could have a
rough time in critical situations.
Route120_Text_JennaPostBattle:
Fitness training is in my routine.
I always run with my POKéMON.
Route120_Text_JenniferIntro:
POKéMON have many special abilities.
If you want to become a first-class
TRAINER, learn about them.
Route120_Text_JenniferPostBattle:
The special abilities of POKéMON
will make battle styles change.
Route120_Text_KeigoDefeat:
The creation of new ninja techniques
is but a distant dream…
Route120_Text_KeigoIntro:
I will adopt the movements of POKéMON
and create new ninja techniques.
Route120_Text_KeigoPostBattle:
Perhaps I ought to apprentice under
a ninja sensei.
Route120_Text_LeonelDefeat: I've seen your policy in action!
Route120_Text_LeonelIntro:
Your party POKéMON…
Do you have different types?
Route120_Text_LeonelPostBattle:
I think it's awesome you're so strong
battling with your favorite POKéMON.
Route120_Text_LorenzoDefeat:
With POKéMON that strong, you're in
no danger of needing rescue!
Route120_Text_LorenzoIntro:
I'll check your POKéMON and see if
they're fit for the outdoors.
Route120_Text_LorenzoPostBattle:
To travel wherever your heart desires
with POKéMON…
That's the joy of being a TRAINER.
Route120_Text_MakeYourOwnImpressions:
Oh… But it is important to make your
own impressions, I guess…
Route120_Text_RileyDefeat:
I lost!
I should camouflage my shame!
Route120_Text_RileyIntro:
We ninja conceal ourselves under our
camouflage cloaks.
I bet you didn't know where I was!
Route120_Text_RileyPostBattle:
Our camouflage cloaks are all
handmade.
Route120_Text_RobertIntro:
My POKéMON is strong!
How about yours?
Route120_Text_RobertPostBattle:
A POKéMON that grows steadily is one
you can count on.
Route120_Text_RobertPostRematch:
My POKéMON are growing stronger.
I have to grow stronger, too.
Route120_Text_RobertRegister:
You can be counted on to get better.
I'd like to register you in my POKéNAV!
Route120_Text_RobertRematchIntro:
A POKéMON that grows steadily is one
you can count on.
Route120_Text_StevenGiveDevonScope:
STEVEN: I see…
Your battle style is intriguing.

Your POKéMON have obviously grown
since I first met you in DEWFORD.

I'd like you to have this
DEVON SCOPE.

Who knows, there may be other
concealed POKéMON.
Route120_Text_StevenGoodbye:
I enjoy seeing POKéMON and TRAINERS
who strive together.
Route120_Text_StevenGreeting:
STEVEN: Hm? {PLAYER}{KUN}, hi.
It's been a while.

There's something here that you can't
see, right?

Now, if I were to use this device on
the invisible obstacle…

No, no. Rather than describing it,
I should just show you.
That would be more fun.

{PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON ready for
battle?
Route120_Text_StevenIllWaitHere: I'll wait here, so you can get ready.
Route120_Text_StevenReadyForBattle:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, are your POKéMON
ready for battle?
Route120_Text_StevenShowMeYourPower:
STEVEN: {PLAYER}{KUN}, show me your true
power as a TRAINER!
Route120_Text_StevenUsedDevonScope:
An invisible POKéMON became completely
visible!
Route120_Text_YesYouUnderstand:
Yes, yes.
You understand what I mean.
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_ComeInA: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_FirstTi:
When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you
start with 30 SAFARI BALLS for
catching POKéMON.

The SAFARI Game is over when you run
out of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've
walked 500 steps.
Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_NotEnou:
You don't have enough money.
Sorry.
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PCIsFul:
Excuse me!
Your PC BOX is full.
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_PleaseE:
We'll let you know when your game
is over.

So, until then, enjoy yourself, please!
Off you go on your wild excursion!
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Trainer:
Throw {POKEBLOCK}S at wild POKéMON to make
them less likely to flee.
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_Welcome:
Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!
Is it your first time here?

Here, you may witness many kinds of
POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.

And, you'll see them in their wild,
untamed state in natural habitats.

What's more, we've thrown open the
gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.

You're encouraged to catch POKéMON
for keeps!
Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_WouldYo:
All you can catch for just ¥500!
Would you like to play a SAFARI Game?
Route121_SafariZoneEntrance_Text_YouNeed:
Excuse me!
You seem to be without a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.

Your SAFARI Game will be much more
fruitful if you use {POKEBLOCK}S.
Please come back with a {POKEBLOCK} CASE.

You may obtain a {POKEBLOCK} CASE from
the LILYCOVE CONTEST HALL.
Route121_Text_AheadLoomsMtPyre:
It is a natural monument to the spirits 
of departed POKéMON…
Route121_Text_CaleDefeat:
Of course I lost!
I'm holding stuff in both hands!
Route121_Text_CaleIntro:
Can't you see that I have all this
stuff with me?

Despite that, you still insist that
we battle?
Route121_Text_CalePostBattle:
I bought too much stuff at
the LILYCOVE DEPT. STORE.

It's up the road from here.
I wish I had a BAG like yours.
Route121_Text_CristinIntro:
I have this routine.
Defeat five TRAINERS a day.
Guess what? You're number five!
Route121_Text_CristinPostBattle:
I didn't expect to lose this easily…
I'll win next time!
Route121_Text_CristinPostRematch:
An opponent I just can't beat…
Snivel…
I can't believe this is happening…
Route121_Text_CristinRegister:
That was total humiliation!
I won't forget you…
Hand over your POKéNAV!
Route121_Text_CristinRematchDefeat:
Wait! That's nasty!
I demand a rematch!
Route121_Text_CristinRematchIntro:
I have this new routine.
Defeat ten TRAINERS a day.
Guess what? You're number ten!
Route121_Text_JessicaDefeat:
Oh, how dare you!
Don't take it so seriously!
Route121_Text_JessicaIntro:
Stop! Have a good look at my precious
POKéMON!
Route121_Text_JessicaPostBattle:
Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at
the SAFARI.
Route121_Text_JessicaPostRematch:
Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at
the SAFARI.
Route121_Text_JessicaRegister:
I took it easy on you this time!
It won't be that way the next time!
Route121_Text_JessicaRematchDefeat:
Oh, how dare you!
You still won't take it easy!
Route121_Text_JessicaRematchIntro:
My precious POKéMON grew!
Have a good look!
Route121_Text_JoyIntro:
JOY: Together, we're fearless!
We'll demonstrate how tough we are!
Route121_Text_JoyNotEnoughMons:
JOY: You need at least two POKéMON
if you're going to challenge us!
Route121_Text_JoyPostBattle:
JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE,
my senior student partner, again.
Route121_Text_KateDefeat:
KATE: I blew it in front of my junior
student partner…
Route121_Text_KateIntro:
KATE: Together, we're fearless!
We'll demonstrate how tough we are!
Route121_Text_KateNotEnoughMons:
KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON,
we can't battle with you.
Route121_Text_KatePostBattle:
KATE: When someone's relying on me,
I get this urge to look cool in front
of them…
Route121_Text_MarcelIntro:
My POKéMON have never tasted defeat!
On their next win, I'm entering them
in CONTESTS.
Route121_Text_MarcelPostBattle:
I may have to train my gang some more
before entering any CONTEST.
Route121_Text_MtPyrePierSign:
…The sign is old and worn out.
The words are barely legible…
Route121_Text_MylesIntro:
There's nothing I love more than
checking out other people's POKéMON!
Route121_Text_MylesPostBattle:
They're great, your POKéMON!
How do you raise them?
Route121_Text_OkayMoveOutToMtPyre:
Okay!
We're to move out to MT. PYRE!
Route121_Text_PatIntro:
I want everybody to see the POKéMON
I've raised!
Route121_Text_PatPostBattle:
I raise every POKéMON with the same
love and care--I don't pick favorites.
Route121_Text_TammyIntro:
There are powers beyond our
understanding in the world…
Route121_Text_TammyPostBattle:
MT. PYRE…
There is a mysterious power
at work there…
Route121_Text_VanessaIntro:
Will you play with my delightfully
pretty POKéMON?
Route121_Text_VanessaPostBattle: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.

My POKéMON should have no problem
sweeping the MASTER CLASS.
Route121_Text_WalterIntro:
With my POKéMON, I have traveled
to the world's four corners.

You might say I have some confidence
in my abilities.
Route121_Text_WalterPostBattle:
I would like to circle the globe once
again with my POKéMON.
Route121_Text_WalterPostRematch:
Your prowess together will be
considered strong, even overseas.
Route121_Text_WalterRegister:
Your POKéMON prowess is remarkable.
Allow me to register you as a memento.
Route121_Text_WalterRematchIntro:
With my POKéMON, I have traveled
to the world's four corners.

You might say I have some confidence
in my abilities.
Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_DoneForT:
I'm done for today.
Come again another day.
Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_GoodSayi:
Oh! A good saying it is.
You're quite remarkable.
I want you to have this.
Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_HeardAGo:
The way my husband grows BERRIES,
oh, he's the best in the world.
He makes me proud, that he does.

Incidentally, child, have you heard
a good saying lately?
Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_Inspirat:
Ah! What a remarkable saying!
Inspirational, it is!
I want you to have this.
Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_JoyNever:
Our four grandchildren should become
more accomplished than my husband.
Joy never goes out of my life!
Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_VisitPre:
Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL
flower shop near RUSTBORO.
Route123_BerryMastersHouse_Text_YoureDes: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.

I dream of filling the world with
beautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES
and hand them out to everyone.
Route123_Text_AlbertoDefeat: Even in defeat, BIRD POKéMON are cool!
Route123_Text_AlbertoIntro:
I have to tell you, BIRD POKéMON
are my obsession!

Birds are cool!
They're the best!
Route123_Text_AlbertoPostBattle:
I gather BIRD POKéMON feathers that
scatter during battles.

I'm going to make a hat with
BIRD POKéMON feathers.
Route123_Text_BraxtonIntro:
You seem to have a big collection
of GYM BADGES.

Let me see if you're actually worthy of
those BADGES!
Route123_Text_BraxtonPostBattle:
You did your BADGES proud in that
match!
Route123_Text_CameronIntro: Being a psychic is about willpower.

I've willed myself not to lose to
anyone. That makes me strong!
Route123_Text_CameronPostBattle:
Being a psychic is about willpower.
I thought I wouldn't lose to you…
Route123_Text_CameronPostRematch:
I should train at MT. PYRE…
I'll never beat you this way…
Route123_Text_CameronRegister:
I sense it!
You and I shall battle again!
I can't tell if I'll win, though…
Route123_Text_CameronRematchIntro:
I've convinced myself that I won't
lose anymore. That makes me strong!
Route123_Text_CheckTreesWithMyGrassMon:
I check trees with my GRASS-type
POKéMON. I'm like a tree doctor.
Route123_Text_DavisIntro:
This is my awesome BUG POKéMON!
My big brother got it for me.
Route123_Text_DavisPostBattle:
Don't tell my brother I lost.
You have to keep it a secret!
Route123_Text_EdDefeat: I kind of like your POKéMON.
Route123_Text_EdIntro:
When there are no TRAINERS around,
I let my POKéMON battle each other.
I watch them.
Route123_Text_EdPostBattle:
Hehe, I'm swiping your battling ideas!
I think they'll make me better.
Route123_Text_FernandoDefeat:
Hey, hold it!
I was still playing the intro!
Route123_Text_FernandoIntro:
I'll turn your lights out while
I rip through this tune!
Route123_Text_FernandoPostBattle:
You're rock steady.
I'd like to write a tune about you.
Route123_Text_FernandoPostRematch:
I thought you'd be so enthralled
by my tune, you'd lose.
Route123_Text_FernandoRegister:
The next time, lend your ears to
the full tune, will you?
Route123_Text_FernandoRematchDefeat:
Hey, hold it!
I haven't even hit the chorus!
Route123_Text_FernandoRematchIntro:
Today's the day I'm going to do it!
I'll turn out your lights before
I finish singing my song!
Route123_Text_FrederickDefeat:
Ah, a mighty capable child!
Let me contribute to your allowance.
Route123_Text_FrederickIntro:
Hello, child!
Can you spare some time?
Route123_Text_FrederickPostBattle:
Contribute to your allowance?
Wasn't the prize money enough?
Route123_Text_JackiIntro:
Don't be too happy if your POKéMON
develop psychic powers.

You need to refine those powers to
make them really useful.
Route123_Text_JackiPostBattle:
We all have psychic powers.
We've just forgotten how to use them.
Route123_Text_JackiPostRematch:
Your power with POKéMON…
That could be a psychic power, too.
Route123_Text_JackiRegister:
I would like to face you again.
Is that okay with you?
Route123_Text_JackiRematchIntro:
Have you awoken the psychic powers
within you?
Route123_Text_JazmynIntro:
My confidence will get a boost by
beating someone obviously strong!
Route123_Text_JazmynPostBattle:
They say that you can't judge a person
by their appearance.
But often, their looks don't lie…
Route123_Text_JonasDefeat:
If you don't lose, how am I supposed
to have fun playing ninja?
Route123_Text_JonasIntro:
I lay in ambush, and a TRAINER has
landed in my trap!
Route123_Text_JonasPostBattle:
I'm going to ambush a weaker-looking
TRAINER next time.
Route123_Text_KayleyDefeat:
You're better than me by about
five times!
Route123_Text_KayleyIntro:
I just bought this parasol.
My cuteness should be up by a third!
Route123_Text_KayleyPostBattle:
Using accessories effectively is
the secret behind fashion appeal.
Route123_Text_KindraIntro:
MT. PYRE…
Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep…
Will your POKéMON sleep?
Route123_Text_KindraPostBattle:
MT. PYRE…
Where the spirits of POKéMON sleep…

It must overflow with a power that
soothes spirits…
Route123_Text_LoveGrassMonsHaveAny: Do you have any GRASS-type POKéMON?
Route123_Text_MiuIntro:
MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your
POKéMON won't cry when they lose.
Route123_Text_MiuNotEnoughMons:
MIU: It's no fun to battle if you
don't have two POKéMON.
Route123_Text_MiuPostBattle:
MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are
strong because you are friends.
Route123_Text_RouteSignMtPyre:
{UP_ARROW} MT. PYRE
“Forbidden to the faint of heart.”
Route123_Text_VioletDefeat:
Oh…
I smell the bitter scent of misery…
Route123_Text_VioletIntro:
They say that good times are filled
with good aromas.
Route123_Text_VioletPostBattle:
The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled
with uplifting fragrances.
Route123_Text_WendyIntro:
Want to determine how strong you are?
I'll be the test!
Route123_Text_WendyPostBattle:
To best even me…
Your strength is marvelous!
Route123_Text_YouLikeGrassMonsTooHaveThi:
You like GRASS-type POKéMON, too,
don't you?

I'm so happy, you can have this!
It's a token of our friendship.
Route123_Text_YukiIntro:
YUKI: Okay!
We're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!
Route123_Text_YukiNotEnoughMons:
YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you
don't have two POKéMON.
Route123_Text_YukiPostBattle:
YUKI: Why are you so strong?
We've never lost before.
Route124_DivingTreasureHuntersHouse_Text:
Whoops, your BAG's full.
Get rid of some items, friend!

No? That's a downer.
Well, if you change your mind, come back.

I'm the awesome dude who makes
deep-sea dives to gather treasures
resting at the bottom.

Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of
tools made in ancient times?

It's a done deal!
Use that wisely!

Oh, hey! That…
That's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!

Oh, man, you've got to trade that
with me! I'll give you something good!
Do you want to trade something else?
What do you want to trade?

You haven't got any treasures
for me…

If you see any SHARDS, like the RED
SHARD, you've got to trade it with me!

You'll trade your {STR_VAR_1} for
my {STR_VAR_2}, then?
Route124_Text_ChadIntro:
Fufufufu… I dive deep underwater
to go deep under cover.
Plumbing the depths is where I excel!
Route124_Text_ChadPostBattle:
I have it on good authority that
there's a DIVE spot around here.

It gives me the urge to go deep
again…
Route124_Text_DeclanDefeat:
I'm feeling blue.
Blue as the sky…
Route124_Text_DeclanIntro:
Here I am swimming by my lonesome
on this wide, beautiful sea.

There's no other word for it.
This is pathetic!
Route124_Text_DeclanPostBattle:
I should chat up lady SWIMMERS
and invite them on a long swim.
Route124_Text_GraceDefeat:
I had no idea that you were
this strong!
Route124_Text_GraceIntro:
I'm growing bored of swimming…
How about a battle?
Route124_Text_GracePostBattle:
All the effort you put in must have
made you this strong.
Route124_Text_IsabellaDefeat:
I've only got sweat in my eyes!
I am not crying!
Route124_Text_IsabellaIntro:
I'm not going to lose to some
surfer TRAINER.
Route124_Text_IsabellaPostBattle:
You can find pretty colored shards
of things around here.
Route124_Text_JennyDefeat:
Oh, darn.
I've gone and lost.
Route124_Text_JennyIntro:
If you just float in the sea like
this, POKéMON come around to play.
Route124_Text_JennyPostBattle:
While swimming, I noticed that some
POKéMON attack, and some just watch.

I guess POKéMON have personalities
of their own.
Route124_Text_JennyPostRematch:
This has nothing to do with anything,
but maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.
Route124_Text_JennyRegister:
It's only on a whim, but maybe I'll get
you to register me in your POKéNAV.
Route124_Text_JennyRematchIntro:
If you just float in the sea like this,
TRAINERS challenge you!
Route124_Text_LilaDefeat:
LILA: ROY! It's your fault we lost!
You're in for it later!
Route124_Text_LilaIntro:
Here I am in the sea, but who's with me?
My little brother!

Let's battle so I won't have to dwell
on that!
Route124_Text_LilaNotEnoughMons:
LILA: You're planning to battle us?
Not unless you have two POKéMON.
Route124_Text_LilaPostBattle:
If only it wasn't my little brother
next to me, but a nice boyfriend…
Route124_Text_LilaPostRematch:
If I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat
anyone with lovely combinations…
Route124_Text_LilaRematchDefeat:
LILA: ROY!
It's your fault we lost again!
We're having a training session later!
Route124_Text_LilaRematchIntro:
Here I am in the sea, but who's with me?
My little brother!

Oh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle
so I won't have to dwell on things!
Route124_Text_LilaRematchNotEnoughMons:
LILA: You're planning to battle us?
Not unless you have two POKéMON.
Route124_Text_LilaRoyRegister:
ROY: Will you battle with us again?
But take it easy next time, okay?
Route124_Text_RolandIntro:
Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead
of swimming yourself…
Route124_Text_RolandPostBattle:
I'm getting chilled…
I've been in the water too long…
I wish I could ride a POKéMON like you…
Route124_Text_RoyDefeat:
ROY: Uh-oh…
My big sister will chew me out…
Route124_Text_RoyIntro: ROY: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!
Route124_Text_RoyNotEnoughMons:
ROY: Did you want to battle us?
Bring two POKéMON, then.
Route124_Text_RoyPostBattle:
ROY: My big sister is really scary
when she gets angry.

That's why she doesn't have a
boyfriend.
Route124_Text_RoyPostRematch:
ROY: My big sister is really scary
when she gets angry.

She's going to make me train really
hard with POKéMON later…
Route124_Text_RoyRematchDefeat:
ROY: Uh-oh…
My big sister will chew me out again.
Route124_Text_RoyRematchIntro:
ROY: If we lose, I'll catch heck.
I'm going to go totally all out!
Route124_Text_RoyRematchNotEnoughMons:
ROY: Did you want to battle us?
Bring two POKéMON, then.
Route124_Text_SpencerDefeat: I lost my bearings in battle!
Route124_Text_SpencerIntro: Hey, are you lost at sea?

If you can beat my POKéMON,
I can serve as your pilot.
Route124_Text_SpencerPostBattle: Many people lose their bearings at sea.

If you're that sort, you should refer
to the POKéNAV's MAP.
Route125_Text_AuronDefeat:
Oh, you weren't throwing trash into
the sea.
Route125_Text_AuronIntro:
Hey! Was it you throwing garbage
into the sea?
Route125_Text_AuronPostBattle:
I found an unsightly bottle bobbing
in the waves earlier.

It angers me that someone would
pollute the sea!
Route125_Text_ErnestIntro:
Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!
I've braved the world's seas!
Route125_Text_ErnestPostBattle:
The tide ebbs and flows inside the
SHOAL CAVE.

By the way, it's about six hours from
high tide to low tide. Did you know?
Route125_Text_ErnestRegister:
Register me in your POKéNAV,
and I'll tell you something good.
Route125_Text_ErnestRematchDefeat:
I couldn't win!
I flat out couldn't win!
Route125_Text_ErnestRematchIntro:
It's high time I get my payback
from you! Come on, we're battling!
Route125_Text_ErnestRematchPostBattle:
There are places you can and can't
get to depending on the rise and fall
of the tide.

By the way, it's about six hours from
high tide to low tide. Don't forget!
Route125_Text_IrisDefeat: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.
Route125_Text_IrisIntro:
IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're
looking for out here?
Route125_Text_IrisNotEnoughMons:
IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do
anything like a 2-on-1 battle.
Route125_Text_IrisPostBattle:
IRIS: KIM, are we really going into
the SHOAL CAVE?
We'll get all wet.
Route125_Text_KimDefeat: KIM: I thought we would win.
Route125_Text_KimIntro:
KIM: A funny old man lives in the
SHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.
Are you going to see him, too?
Route125_Text_KimNotEnoughMons:
KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,
or it's just no good!
Route125_Text_KimPostBattle:
KIM: A funny old man lives in the
SHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?
Route125_Text_NolenIntro:
I heard you approaching, so I hung
around for you!
Route125_Text_NolenPostBattle:
Sound travels faster in water than
it does through air.
Route125_Text_PresleyDefeat:
Okay.
I'll tell you why I'm here.
Route125_Text_PresleyIntro:
Why would a BIRDKEEPER like me
come out to the sea?
Route125_Text_PresleyPostBattle:
I put a message in a bottle and put
it out to sea.

I'm sure that a girl SWIMMER will
find it!
Route125_Text_SharonIntro:
How would you like to take on the
WATER-type POKéMON I raised?
Route125_Text_SharonPostBattle:
Your power… You're the real deal.
I'm amazed!
Route125_Text_StanIntro:
Hey, there!
Check out my sweet POKéMON!
Route125_Text_StanPostBattle:
I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,
so I started swimming, too.
Route125_Text_TanyaIntro:
I'm tired of swimming.
Are you up for a battle with me?
Route125_Text_TanyaPostBattle:
Whew…
Which way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?
Route126_Text_BarryIntro:
Swimming is a full-body workout!
You will get fit!
Route126_Text_BarryPostBattle:
Thanks to my daily swimming routine…
Look! Feast your eyes on this physique!
Route126_Text_BrendaIntro:
Hello, kiddo!
Want a battle with me?
Route126_Text_BrendaPostBattle:
I love frolicking with POKéMON in
the sea like this!
Route126_Text_DeanIntro:
This towering white mountain of rock
is SOOTOPOLIS CITY.
Route126_Text_DeanPostBattle:
I can't find the entrance to
SOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?
Route126_Text_IsobelIntro:
If seawater gets up your nose,
doesn't it feel terrible?
Route126_Text_IsobelPostBattle:
Ooh, I choked on some water!
It's bitter! It's salty!!
Route126_Text_LeonardoDefeat:
Sheesh, getting greedy didn't do
a thing for me.
Route126_Text_LeonardoIntro:
I couldn't even swim last year,
but now I'm a decent SWIMMER.
I think I'm capable of anything now.
Route126_Text_LeonardoPostBattle:
If you practice at something,
you will get better at it.

You're young--don't be afraid to
try all sorts of things!
Route126_Text_NikkiDefeat:
My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!
Blub, blub, blub…
Route126_Text_NikkiPostBattle:
You thrashed me… I want to
disappear in a wave of despair…
Route126_Text_PabloDefeat:
Whoops! Too strong!
Not bad! Not bad at all!
Route126_Text_PabloIntro:
Check out this sculpted body!
I'm more cut than a BLACK BELT!
Route126_Text_PabloPostBattle:
Losing to you stimulated my senses!
I'll train myself and POKéMON harder!
Route126_Text_PabloPostRematch:
I'm going to train even harder!
You're a great motivator!
You have to come back again!
Route126_Text_PabloRegister:
Yep, you're not bad at all!
I'd like to get to know you more!
Route126_Text_PabloRematchDefeat:
Whoops! Really too strong!
Not bad! Not bad at all!
Route126_Text_PabloRematchIntro:
Check out this beautiful body!
I'm more shapely than a SWIMMER!
Route126_Text_SiennaIntro:
I'm throwing my whole heart
into this!
Route126_Text_SiennaPostBattle:
I need to cool down now…
I think I'll go for a dive.
Route127_Text_AidanIntro:
BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.
They spot prey from great heights.
Route127_Text_AidanPostBattle:
There're lots of diving spots in
the sea around here.

You can spot them easily from the sky
because of their darker color.
Route127_Text_AthenaDefeat:
You didn't give me the chance to
do any strategizing.
Route127_Text_AthenaIntro:
We should have a slow and methodical
match.
Route127_Text_AthenaPostBattle:
When I'm surrounded by the blue sea
and sky, it feels as if time slows down.
Route127_Text_CamdenIntro:
I can see it in your face.
You want to challenge me.
Route127_Text_CamdenPostBattle:
A well-played match leaves me feeling
refreshed and serene.
Route127_Text_DonnyIntro:
Do you have a rival whom you just
hate to lose against?
Route127_Text_DonnyPostBattle:
If you have a rival, don't you get the
feeling that you have to keep getting
better?
Route127_Text_HenryIntro:
Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged
a SURFING POKéMON?
Route127_Text_HenryPostBattle:
It'd be a handful if I hooked
your tough POKéMON!
Route127_Text_JonahDefeat:
Though I have lost, my heart remains
calm…
Route127_Text_JonahIntro:
Through fishing, I have attained a
state of becalmed serenity…
Route127_Text_JonahPostBattle:
It matters not that I catch nothing.
The line remains in the water…
Route127_Text_KojiDefeat:
Yowch!
I got a pebble under a toenail!
Route127_Text_KojiIntro:
Run in your bare feet.
That will toughen up your soles!
Route127_Text_KojiPostBattle:
Going barefoot feels great.
But your RUNNING SHOES are cool, too.
Route127_Text_KojiPostRematch:
Want to go barefoot for a while?
So I can try your RUNNING SHOES?
Route127_Text_KojiRegister:
This is what I do to people who beat me!
I hope we can do this again.
Route127_Text_KojiRematchDefeat:
Yowch!
Pebbles dug into my arches!
Route127_Text_KojiRematchIntro:
I still run in my bare feet daily.
My soles are tough!
Route127_Text_RogerDefeat:
No! My line's all tangled!
The party's over!
Route127_Text_RogerIntro:
Well, hey! This is a match between
a POKéMON fan and a fishing buff!
Route127_Text_RogerPostBattle:
My fishing line's doing a dance!
The tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!
Route128_Text_AlexaIntro:
We've been working so hard to mount
a POKéMON LEAGUE challenge…
We can't afford to lose now!
Route128_Text_AlexaPostBattle:
After all I've done to get here,
I won't give up after one setback.
Route128_Text_ArchieWhatHappened:
ARCHIE: What happened…
What is this wretched scene…
Route128_Text_CarleeDefeat:
I couldn't see very well because of
the sun's glare.
Route128_Text_CarleeIntro:
The sunlight seems to be more harsh
in this area.
Route128_Text_CarleePostBattle:
I should go back soon.
I need to reapply my sunscreen.
Route128_Text_HarrisonDefeat:
Ouch!
I guess it was impossible to win.
Route128_Text_HarrisonIntro:
You're looking awfully tough.
I wonder if I can win?
Route128_Text_HarrisonPostBattle:
There are tough TRAINERS galore
around EVER GRANDE.

Do you think I may be out
of my league?
Route128_Text_IsaiahDefeat:
My first victory seems to be far
away, too…
Route128_Text_IsaiahIntro:
EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways
away…
Route128_Text_IsaiahPostBattle:
My whole life has been about losing,
but I will never give up!
Route128_Text_IsaiahPostRematch:
I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY
where I can eventually win…
Route128_Text_IsaiahRegister:
I know I'm not good now, but I think
I can win eventually.
Please register me in your POKéNAV.
Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchDefeat: I've yet to taste my first victory…
Route128_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro:
I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on
swimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.
Route128_Text_KatelynDefeat: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too…
Route128_Text_KatelynIntro:
You have to swim, cycle, and then run
a marathon in a triathlon.

It's a grueling race that consists
of three events.
Route128_Text_KatelynPostBattle:
I have to ride a BIKE next, but…
I'm about to throw in the towel…
Route128_Text_KatelynPostRematch:
You should give serious thought to
challenges on VICTORY ROAD.
Route128_Text_KatelynRegister:
Well, I may as well make the best
of this. I'd like a rematch sometime.
Route128_Text_KatelynRematchDefeat:
A POKéMON battle really is harsh
and unforgiving…
Route128_Text_KatelynRematchIntro:
A triathlon is long. But I guess the
road to become the POKéMON CHAMPION
is also a long and grueling one.
Route128_Text_MaxieDoYouUnderstandNow:
MAXIE: Do you understand now,
ARCHIE?

Do you finally see how disastrous
your dream turned out to be?

We have to hurry! We have to do
something before the situation goes
completely out of control!
Route128_Text_MaxieResposibilityFallsToA:
I know that I have no right to be
critical of ARCHIE…

But the way things are now, I doubt
that we humans will be capable of
doing anything about it.

But neither can we stand by and
just watch helplessly.

The responsibility for putting an end
to this falls to ARCHIE and me…
Route128_Text_MaxieThisDefiesBelief:
Their power is unbelievable.
They've upset the balance of nature…
Route128_Text_RubenIntro: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!
Route128_Text_RubenPostBattle:
There probably is no stronger TRAINER
than you!
Route128_Text_StevenImGoingToSootopolis:
{PLAYER}{KUN}…
I don't know what you intend to do,
but don't do anything reckless.
Route128_Text_StevenWholeWorldWillDrown:
After the scorching heat wave ended,
this deluge began.

If this doesn't stop, all of HOENN…
No, the whole world will drown.

This huge rain cloud is spreading
from above SOOTOPOLIS…
What in the world is taking place there?

There's no point arguing here…
SOOTOPOLIS might provide answers…
Route128_Text_WayneIntro:
I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I
caught myself a POKéMON that knows
the move WATERFALL to crest the falls.
Route128_Text_WaynePostBattle:
My POKéMON knows WATERFALL, but
I don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!
Route129_Text_AllisonIntro:
I'm in the middle of a triathlon,
but, sure, why don't we battle?
Route129_Text_AllisonPostBattle:
Do you know what's the greatest thing
about triathlons?

Testing the limits of your own
strength and endurance against
Mother Nature!
Route129_Text_ChaseIntro:
This is my first triathlon.
I'm all tense and nervous!
Route129_Text_ChasePostBattle:
If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to
give it my all.
Route129_Text_ClarenceIntro:
Surfing isn't as easy as it seems,
isn't that right?
Route129_Text_ClarencePostBattle:
You have your sights on the POKéMON
LEAGUE? Keep at it!
Route129_Text_ReedDefeat:
Beat, I'm beaten.
That's it, done!
Route129_Text_ReedIntro:
Say hey, hey!
Let's get on with it!
Route129_Text_ReedPostBattle:
There's nothing for a loser.
Time for me to beat it home.
Route129_Text_TishaDefeat:
Oh, my.
I wanted to relax a little more…
Route129_Text_TishaIntro:
What's the hurry?
Let's take it slow and easy.
Route129_Text_TishaPostBattle:
Don't you hate making mistakes when
you're in a rush?

That's why I try to take things
slowly.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_BlankChartOfSo: It's a blank chart of some sort.

It has spaces for writing in
records of some kind.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoYouLikeToFis:
I'm the FISHING GURU's younger
brother.

I simply looove fishing!
I can't bear to go without.
Tell me, do you like to fish?
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoesntLookLike:
Uh… That doesn't look much like
a MAGIKARP.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HmmXInchesDoes:
Hmm…
This one is {STR_VAR_2} inches long.

It doesn't measure up to the
{STR_VAR_3}-inch one you brought before.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HuhXInchesSame:
This is the same size as the one
I saw before.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_IfYouCatchBigM:
Fishing is a way of life!
It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out
and land the big one, my friend.

If you catch a big MAGIKARP 
with that ROD, I want to see it.

As much as I love to fish, I also
love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_LookForwardToG:
I'll look forward to seeing greater
records from you!
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_MostGiganticMa:
The most gigantic MAGIKARP
I have ever witnessed…
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_NoRoomForGift:
I had a gift for you, but you have
no room for it.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhMagikarpAllo:
Oh? {PLAYER}?
Why, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!
Allow me to see it, quick!
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_ReceivedSuperR:
{PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from
the FISHING GURU's brother.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TakeThisAndFis:
Grand! I like your style.
I think we can be friends.
Take this and fish, young friend!
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TryFishingBrin:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!
Have you been fishing?

Try fishing with the SUPER ROD in
any body of water.

You'll find different POKéMON in
different places.

Oh, and don't forget to bring me
gigantic MAGIKARP.
Route12_FishingHouse_Text_WhoaXInchesTak:
You have a rare appreciation for
the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!

You must take this.
I insist!
Route12_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_LookoutSpo:
There's a lookout spot upstairs.
The view is magnificent.
Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_DontHaveRo: You don't have room for this.
Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainTM2: TM27 is a move called RETURN…

If you treat your POKéMON good,
it will return your love by working
its hardest in battle.
Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsPokemon:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…
Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedTM:
{PLAYER} received TM27
from the little girl.
Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDont:
My POKéMON's ashes are stored in
POKéMON TOWER.

You can have this TM.
I don't need it anymore…

My POKéMON's ashes are stored in
POKéMON TOWER.

You can have this TM.
I don't need it anymore…
Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TheresManF:
Let's see what the binoculars have
to show…
Route12_Text_AndrewIntro:
You never know what you could
catch!
Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle:
I catch them all the time, sure.
But, boy are they wimpy.
Route12_Text_AndrewRematchIntro:
You'll never know unless you beat
me!
Route12_Text_ChipIntro:
Be patient.
Fishing is a waiting game.
Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle:
With a better ROD, I could catch
better POKéMON…
Route12_Text_ChipRematchIntro:
You're finally here.
Fishing is a waiting game.
Route12_Text_ElliotIntro: I love fishing, don't get me wrong.

But it'd be best if I also had more
work.
Route12_Text_ElliotPostBattle:
It's all right.
Losing doesn't bug me anymore.
Route12_Text_ElliotRematchIntro:
I love fishing, don't get me wrong.
But, I wish I had more work…
…It's hard to give up fishing!
Route12_Text_GiaIntro: If we win, I'll marry you!
Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons:
GIA: I can't bear to battle
without my JES!
Don't you have one more POKéMON?
Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle:
GIA: JES, you silly!
You ruined this!
Route12_Text_GiaRematchIntro:
GIA: Hey, JES…
I've been waiting a long time now.
If we win today, I'll marry you!
Route12_Text_HankIntro:
The FISHING FOOL versus POKéMON
KID!
Route12_Text_HankPostBattle:
I guess you get to be good at
what you like.

Well, you beat me at POKéMON,
but you can't top me at fishing.
Route12_Text_HankRematchIntro:
The FISHING FOOL vs. POKéMON KID!
Another round, fight!
Route12_Text_JesDefeat:
JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you
let us win?
Route12_Text_JesIntro:
JES: If I win, I'm going to
propose to GIA.
Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons:
JES: GIA and I, we'll be
together forever.

We won't battle unless you have
two POKéMON of your own.
Route12_Text_JesPostBattle:
JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me,
my love!
Route12_Text_JesRematchIntro:
JES: I'll win here today and
propose to my GIA.
Route12_Text_JustinIntro:
I'm searching for a MOON STONE.
Have you found one?
Route12_Text_JustinPostBattle:
I could have made my POKéMON
evolve with a MOON STONE.
I would have won then, I bet.
Route12_Text_JustinRematchIntro:
Still can't find a MOON STONE…
Have you found one?
Route12_Text_LucaIntro:
I don't know a thing about POKéMON
of the sea, though.
Route12_Text_LucaPostBattle:
Water conducts electricity, so you
should zap sea POKéMON.
Route12_Text_LucaRematchIntro:
Electricity has always been my
specialty.

I don't know a thing about POKéMON
of the sea, though.
Route12_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber:
A POKéMON is sprawled out in
a deep and comfortable slumber.
Route12_Text_NedIntro:
Yeah!
I got a bite here!
Route12_Text_NedRematchIntro:
Yeah!
I got a bite, here!
Th-this might be the real thing!
Route130_Text_KatieDefeat:
Like the vast blue sea,
the world of POKéMON spans
depths beyond belief.
Route130_Text_KatieIntro:
In the deep blue sea,
my shattered blue heart finds
comfort among waves.
Route130_Text_KatiePostBattle:
The world's children dream
of one day becoming
the POKéMON CHAMPION.
Route130_Text_RodneyIntro:
What a surprise! I didn't expect to
see a TRAINER out in the sea.
Route130_Text_RodneyPostBattle:
Your eyes have that look of someone
who's experienced harsh challenges
and won. It suits you well!
Route130_Text_SantiagoDefeat: I needed to be a little less peaceful!
Route130_Text_SantiagoIntro:
Floating on the open sea like this…
It's peaceful.
Route130_Text_SantiagoPostBattle:
Swimming and battling like this…
I'm one happy guy…
Route131_Text_HermanIntro:
The sea… The sea… The sea…
The sea as far as these eyes can see!
I'm sick and tired of the sea!
Route131_Text_HermanPostBattle: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.

I'm a born swimmer!
That's what I am.
Route131_Text_IanDefeat:
IAN: I did my best with my sis,
but we still couldn't win…
Route131_Text_IanIntro:
IAN: I'm doing my best together with
my sis!
Route131_Text_IanNotEnoughMons:
IAN: If you have two POKéMON,
we'll take you on!
Route131_Text_IanPostBattle:
IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is
a floating town?

So, wherever there is the sea,
that's a part of PACIFIDLOG!
Route131_Text_KaraIntro: Why do men love bathing suits so much?
Route131_Text_KaraPostBattle:
Maybe it's not my bathing suit that
makes men look. It must be my beauty!
Route131_Text_KevinIntro:
The people of PACIFIDLOG are
a peaceful bunch.

They never get angry.
That goes for me, too.
Route131_Text_KevinPostBattle:
Tch! …Oh, wait.
I'm not angry. Honestly!
Route131_Text_ReliDefeat:
RELI: We couldn't win even though we
worked together…
Route131_Text_ReliIntro:
RELI: We'll work together as siblings
to take you on!
Route131_Text_ReliNotEnoughMons:
RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?
We can't enjoy a battle, then.
Route131_Text_ReliPostBattle:
RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are
together with the sea and POKéMON from
the time they are born.
Route131_Text_RichardDefeat:
POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are
seriously tough…
Route131_Text_RichardIntro:
The sea is teeming with POKéMON.
It's not easy swimming, I tell you.
Route131_Text_RichardPostBattle:
The going's easy. It's the leaving
that's the hard part.

Will I have any energy left to make
the return trip?
Route131_Text_SusieDefeat:
You're tough in spite of the way
you look!
Route131_Text_SusieIntro:
Hi, sweetie, wait!
We should battle, you and I!
Route131_Text_SusiePostBattle:
Did you see a guy over there who whines
that he's bored of the sea?

That's all talk.
He's hopelessly in love with the sea!
Route131_Text_TaliaIntro:
If you can beat me, I'll give you some
great information!
Route131_Text_TaliaPostBattle:
There is an odd place nearby.
There's a huge tower there.
Why don't you go take a look?
Route132_Text_DanaIntro:
I try not to swim where the currents
are too strong.
Route132_Text_DanaPostBattle:
If I get swept away, I'll lose all my
sense of place…
Route132_Text_DarcyDefeat:
Okay! I won't complain about other
people being here.
Route132_Text_DarcyIntro:
I liked training here by myself.
It's awful that all these people came!
Route132_Text_DarcyPostBattle:
I suppose I can partner up with that
old man and challenge that other team.
Route132_Text_GilbertIntro:
I used to catch colds all the time as
a kid, but I became totally fit after
I started swimming.
Route132_Text_GilbertPostBattle:
TRAINERS travel the fields and
mountains, so they must be fit, too.
Route132_Text_JonathanDefeat:
Wow!
That's pretty strong, all right!
Route132_Text_JonathanIntro:
Someone's been watching me intently.
Was it you?
Route132_Text_JonathanPostBattle:
I can't shake this feeling that
someone's watching me.
Route132_Text_KiyoDefeat:
I lose.
I will concede defeat.
Route132_Text_KiyoIntro:
I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.
How could you possibly beat me?
Route132_Text_KiyoPostBattle:
Urggh…
You're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?

You must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours
a day, don't you?
Route132_Text_MakaylaDefeat: Oh, I guess I wasn't good enough.
Route132_Text_MakaylaIntro:
I'm always with my husband,
but I can win even without him.
Route132_Text_MakaylaPostBattle:
That young man over there looks just
like my husband when he was young.
Route132_Text_PaxtonDefeat:
Ah, I see that I couldn't manage
to win on my own after all.
Route132_Text_PaxtonIntro:
Now where could my wife have gone?
I'm always with her.
I wonder if I can win on my own.
Route132_Text_PaxtonPostBattle:
My wife must be looking for me.
I'd best go find her right away.
Route132_Text_RonaldIntro:
Win or lose, you'll never know until
you try!
Route132_Text_RonaldPostBattle:
I never battle when I know I'll win.
I like to battle at the razor's edge of
victory and defeat!
Route133_Text_BeckIntro:
I came all the way out here with my
BIRD POKéMON.
Route133_Text_BeckPostBattle:
I'd like to go back to FORTREE,
but I've grown to like this place, too.
Route133_Text_ConorDefeat: You have a firm sense of purpose.
Route133_Text_ConorIntro:
Young people are too happy to go with
the flow. They're without direction.
Route133_Text_ConorPostBattle:
Don't let others lead you astray.
Don't lose direction as you grow older.
Route133_Text_DebraIntro:
I've led a life of woe and misery…
I've been cast away, and this is where
I've drifted…
Route133_Text_DebraPostBattle:
A life adrift…
I don't want it anymore!
Route133_Text_FranklinIntro:
Did the currents carry you here, too?
This must have been fated.
Let's battle!
Route133_Text_FranklinPostBattle:
It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER
like you would drift here…
I must be cursed…
Route133_Text_LindaPostBattle:
A strong child TRAINER…
That's so annoying!
Route133_Text_MollieDefeat:
I may have lost thousands of times,
but a loss still stings.
Route133_Text_MollieIntro:
I must have battled thousands
of times. I've lost count.
Route133_Text_MolliePostBattle:
Keep at this, youngster. So you can
become like my husband and me.
Route133_Text_WarrenDefeat:
Darn it!
My way is still too slack!
Route133_Text_WarrenIntro:
I want to win like everyone else, but I
won't raise POKéMON like everyone else.
Route133_Text_WarrenPostBattle:
It's way more fun to do things the way
I want than to be like everybody else.
I mean, that's obvious!
Route134_Text_AaronIntro:
The savage tide in this area serves to
make us stronger than ever.
Route134_Text_AaronPostBattle:
We will return for more training at
METEOR FALLS.

If you'd like, you should go, too.
It will definitely toughen you up!
Route134_Text_AlexIntro:
Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!
It's time for a match!
Route134_Text_AlexPostBattle:
My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after
a long flight…
Route134_Text_HitoshiIntro:
You're a POKéMON TRAINER.
No need for words. We battle now.
Route134_Text_HitoshiPostBattle:
It was I who challenged you, and yet
I lost. I am deeply shamed…
Route134_Text_HudsonIntro:
Listen, have you seen another SAILOR
around here?
Route134_Text_HudsonPostBattle: Our boat drifted out to sea.

My buddy's a timid fellow, so I'm
worried about him.
Route134_Text_JackIntro:
Even those POKéMON that can swim are
carried along by the rapid currents.
Route134_Text_JackPostBattle:
I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running
currents around these parts.
Route134_Text_KelvinIntro:
O-our boat!
The tide carried it away!
Route134_Text_KelvinPostBattle:
If we can't SURF, how are we supposed
to get home?

Actually, I know a fainted POKéMON
can still SURF, but it feels wrong.
Route134_Text_LaurelIntro:
My LUVDISC are looking for a fun
match. Will you join us?
Route134_Text_LaurelPostBattle:
There's a collector who's after
the SCALES of LUVDISC.
Route134_Text_MarleyDefeat:
I never knew such a technique existed!
You've defeated us thoroughly.
Route134_Text_MarleyIntro:
Can your POKéMON dodge our
lightning-quick attacks?
Route134_Text_MarleyPostBattle:
I haven't lost my passion for speed.
I will try harder.
Route134_Text_ReynaDefeat:
You're kidding!
Explain how I lost!
Route134_Text_ReynaIntro:
My POKéMON can't be taken down
easily!
Route134_Text_ReynaPostBattle:
I'll work my way back up by taking on
TRAINERS I happen to meet!
Route13_Text_AlmaDefeat:
Oh, too bad!
I just messed up!
Route13_Text_AlmaIntro:
I found CARBOS in a cave once
while I was spelunking.
Route13_Text_AlmaPostBattle:
CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my
POKéMON.
Route13_Text_AlmaRematchIntro:
I cleaned out my savings and
bought more CARBOS.
Route13_Text_GwenIntro:
My cute POKéMON wish to make your
acquaintance.
Route13_Text_GwenPostBattle:
You have to make POKéMON battle
to toughen them up.
Route13_Text_GwenRematchIntro:
My cutely grown POKéMON wish to
become reacquainted with you.
Route13_Text_LolaIntro: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.
Route13_Text_LolaPostBattle:
I wonder which is stronger, male or
female POKéMON?
Route13_Text_LolaRematchIntro:
Sure, I'll play again with you,
sweetie.
Route13_Text_LookToLeftOfThatPost:
Look, look!
Look to the left of that post!
Route13_Text_PerryIntro:
I'm not going to lose.
Not when the wind's blowing my way!
Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle:
I'm beat.
I guess I'll FLY home.
Route13_Text_PerryRematchIntro:
I'm not going to lose this time.
The wind's blowing my way!
Route13_Text_RobertIntro:
I always go with bird POKéMON.
I've dedicated myself to them.
Route13_Text_RobertPostBattle:
I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and
PIDGEOTTO…
Route13_Text_RobertRematchIntro:
