RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_DadHelped:
When they were expanding the city of
RUSTBORO, my dad helped out.

He made his POKéMON use CUT to clear
the land of trees.
RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_ExplainCu:
That HIDDEN MACHINE, or HM for
short, is CUT.

An HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON outside of battle.

Any POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINER
has earned the STONE BADGE.

And, unlike a TM, an HM can be used
more than once.
RustboroCity_CuttersHouse_Text_YouCanPut:
That determined expression…
That limber way you move…
And your well-trained POKéMON…

No, wait, don't say a word.
I can tell just by looking at you.

I'm sure that you can put this
HIDDEN MACHINE to good use.

No need to be modest or shy.
Go on, take it!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_HowCouldW:
It's beyond stupid.
How could we get robbed?
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_OnlyAutho:
I'm sorry, only authorized people
are allowed to enter here.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ProductDi:
Prototypes and test products fill
the glass display case.
There's a panel with a description…

“In addition to industrial products,
DEVON now markets sundries and
pharmaceuticals for better lifestyles.

“Recently, DEVON has begun marketing
tools for POKéMON TRAINERS, including
POKé BALLS and POKéNAV systems.”
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RobberWas:
Well, sure it's important, but it's not
anything that anyone can use.

In my estimation, that robber must not
have been very bright.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_RocksMeta:
Samples of rocks and metal are
displayed in the glass case.

There's a panel with some writing
on it…

“DEVON CORPORATION got its start as
a producer of stones from quarries.

“The company also produced iron from
filings in the sand.

“From that humble start as a producer
of raw materials, DEVON developed.

“DEVON is now a manufacturer of a wide
range of industrial products.”
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_SoundsLik:
It sounds like they've recovered
the ripped-off DEVON GOODS.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_StaffGotR:
One of our research staff stupidly
got robbed of an important parcel.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_ThoseShoe:
Hey, those RUNNING SHOES!
They're one of our products!

It makes me happy when I see someone
using something we made.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_WelcomeTo:
Hello and welcome to the DEVON
CORPORATION.

We're proud producers of items and
medicine that enhance your life.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_1F_Text_YoureAlwa:
Hi, there!
You're always welcome here!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopDe:
I've been trying to develop a device
that resurrects POKéMON from fossils…
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DevelopNe:
I'm trying to develop a new feature
for the POKéNAV…
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Developin:
I'm developing new kinds of
POKé BALLS…
But I haven't made much headway…
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceFor:
We're developing a device for talking
with POKéMON.
But we haven't had much success…
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_DeviceToV:
I'm trying to develop a device that
visually reproduces the dreams of
POKéMON…
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_FossilReg:
The FOSSIL REGENERATOR, which I made,
is incredible.

But it has one drawback--it takes
a long time to work.

So, uh… How about you go for a stroll
and look around for a while?
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_Fossilize:
Your fossilized POKéMON has been
brought back to life!

The fossil was an ancient POKéMON.
{STR_VAR_2}, it was!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_HandedFos:
Excellent!
Let's do this right away.

{PLAYER} handed the {STR_VAR_1} to
the DEVON RESEARCHER.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_IMadePoke:
As an engineer, I feel blessed to have
made something so great!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_OhIsThatS:
DEVON's technological expertise
is outstanding, I tell you.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TooManyPo:
Uh-oh, you've got too many POKéMON.
You have no room for this one.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_TwoFossil:
Oh, now that's a surprise!
You have not one, but two, fossils?

Unfortunately, my machine can only
regenerate one POKéMON at a time.

Would you like to pick one of your
fossils for regeneration?
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WantToBri:
Wait! That thing you have there…
Is that a POKéMON fossil?

Would you like to bring that POKéMON
back to life?

I can with my newly developed
FOSSIL REGENERATOR.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WeFinally:
We finally made new kinds of
POKé BALLS!

The REPEAT BALL makes it easier to
catch POKéMON you've caught before.

The TIMER BALL gets better at catching
POKéMON the longer a battle runs.

Both are proudly developed by
the DEVON CORPORATION.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WhatToWor:
Well, now what shall I work on
developing next?

Our company allows us to make our
inspirations into reality.

One couldn't ask for a better
environment as an engineer.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F_Text_WowThatsA:
It came about as a result of our
PRESIDENT's desire to learn about
the feelings of POKéMON.

Would you like me to describe its
features in detail?

No, no. I think you'll find out just by
trying the POKéNAV out.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_CountingO: MR. STONE: I'm counting on you!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ExplainEx:
MR. STONE: A POKéMON holding that
EXP. SHARE will be given some of the
EXP Points from battle.

It will get EXP Points even if it didn't
actually battle.

I would say EXP. SHARE is quite useful
for raising weak POKéMON.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneEx:
It's a POKéMON NAVIGATOR, or POKéNAV
for short.

It's an indispensable tool for any
TRAINER on an adventure.
It has a map of the HOENN region.

You can check the locations of
DEWFORD and SLATEPORT easily!

By the way, I've heard that sinister
criminals--MAGMA and AQUA, I believe--
have been making trouble far and wide.

I think it would be best if you rested
up before you go on your way.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneGo:
MR. STONE: Well, then, {PLAYER}{KUN},
go with caution and care!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneIH:
I'm MR. STONE, the PRESIDENT of
the DEVON CORPORATION.
I'd just got word about you!

You saved our staff not just once,
but twice!

I have a favor to ask of an amazing
person like you.

I understand that you're delivering
a package to SLATEPORT's SHIPYARD.

Well, on the way, could you stop off in
DEWFORD TOWN?

I was hoping that you'd deliver a
LETTER to STEVEN in DEWFORD.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_MrStoneWa:
MR. STONE: Now, you should know that
I am a great PRESIDENT.

So, I'd never be so cheap as to ask
a favor for nothing in return.
That's why I want you to have this!
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_NotFamili:
MR. STONE: Since my youth, I've immersed
myself in work.

Consequently, I'm not familiar with
trends and that sort of thing.

But do young people all want to be
TRAINERS in the POKéMON LEAGUE?
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RareRocks:
It's a collection of rare rocks and
stones assembled by the PRESIDENT.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_RepeatAnd:
DEVON's new products, the REPEAT BALL
and TIMER BALL, have become hugely
popular among TRAINERS.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThankYouF:
MR. STONE: You delivered my LETTER?
Thank you kindly!

This is my way of thanking you.
It should help you, a TRAINER.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_ThisIs3rd:
This is the DEVON CORPORATION's
third floor.

Our PRESIDENT's OFFICE is on
this floor.

Anyway, I can't tell you how much I'm
grateful for what you've done.

Um… By the way, that parcel
you got back for us…

Could I get you to deliver that to
the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT?

It would be awful if those robbers
tried to take it again.

Uh… Hehehe, so, uh, could I count
on you to do that for me?

Oh, that's right.
Could you wait here a second?
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_VisitCapt:
If you visit the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT,
you should go see CAPT. STERN.
RustboroCity_DevonCorp_3F_Text_WordWithP:
Our PRESIDENT would like to have
a word with you.
RustboroCity_Flat1_1F_Text_EveryPokemonH:
Every POKéMON has a special ability
that it can use.
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_BeenSayingXDo:
I've been saying “{STR_VAR_1}”
to amuse her lately.

Do you know of a better word or
a phrase that might work?
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ComingUpWithM: Oh, it's so hard every day…

What's hard?
You need to ask?

It's trying to figure out what to
make for meals every day.

It really isn't easy coming up with
meals every day.
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_HelloDoYouKno:
Oh, hello!
Welcome to the PEPPER household.

I have a question for you.
Have you ever baby-sat?

You see, I'm a new father, so raising
a child is all new to me.

And I have a problem. My daughter
WALDA doesn't laugh enough.

I think she'd laugh for me if I told
her something funny.

Do you know of a funny word or
phrase you can tell me?
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_LetsGiveItATr:
Ah, I see.
Well, let's give it a try, shall we?

Ah, I see.
Well, let's give it a try, shall we?
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhIsThatRight:
Well, if you come up with a good
suggestion, I'm all ears.
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhShesLaughin:
Oh, yes! She's laughing!
Oh, I am as delighted as she!
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_OhYouDontKnow:
Oh, so you don't know any good words.
I guess I'll try to amuse her with
the saying I used before.

Anyways, if you have a good suggestion,
don't hesitate in telling me, okay?
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ShesNotSmilin:
Hmmm… She's not smiling at all.
Maybe WALDA is one serious child…

Hmmm… She's not smiling at all.
Maybe WALDA is one serious child…
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThankYouIllGi:
Thanks to you, my darling WALDA
laughed for me!

Actually, I may not look all that
special, but I'm one of DEVON
CORPORATION's top researchers.

So, how about I do something in return
for you?

I know, I'll add some new wallpaper
patterns for the BOXES in the PC
POKéMON Storage System.

In the wallpaper pattern menu,
select “FRIENDS.”

That will give you access to the new
wallpaper patterns.
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_ThinkOfMyOwnP:
Oh, so you don't know any good words.
I'd better think for myself, then.

Hmm…
How about “{STR_VAR_1}”?
Let's see if that will work.
RustboroCity_Flat1_2F_Text_WonderfulLets:
Oh, that's wonderful.
So, let's hear it, your suggestion.
RustboroCity_Flat2_1F_Text_DevonWorkersL:
DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in
this building.
RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_DevonWasTinyI:
Way back in the old days, DEVON was just
a teeny, tiny company.
RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_GoingToWorkAt: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.

When I grow up, I'm going to work for
DEVON, too.
RustboroCity_Flat2_2F_Text_MyDaddyMadeTh: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.

My daddy made this!
But I can't use it, so you can have it.
RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentColl:
DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect
rare stones.
RustboroCity_Flat2_3F_Text_PresidentsSon:
I think the PRESIDENT's son also
collects rare stones.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRockTomb:
That TECHNICAL MACHINE, TM39,
contains ROCK TOMB.

It not only inflicts damage by dropping
rocks, it also lowers SPEED.

If you use a TM, it instantly teaches
the move to a POKéMON.

Remember, a TM can be used only once,
so think before you use it.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuideAdvice:
Listen, my friend!
Would you like to become the CHAMPION?

I'm no TRAINER, not me, but I can
sure give you winning advice.

That's settled, then! We'll aim for the
POKéMON CHAMPIONSHIP together!

It's your job as a TRAINER to collect
GYM BADGES, am I right?

And that's where I come in!
I'm here to provide expert advice!

ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, is a user
of ROCK-type POKéMON.

The ROCK type is very durable, but
it can't stand WATER-type and
GRASS-type moves.

Come see me afterwards, if you beat
the GYM LEADER.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_GymGuidePostVictor:
Whoa! What a breathtaking victory!
My cheering must've worked!

The STONE BADGE you got should be
properly recorded on it.

You've climbed the first step on
the stairs to the CHAMPIONSHIP!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshDefeat: You were too good for me…
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshIntro:
Don't take us GYM TRAINERS lightly!
I'll show you why we're better!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_JoshPostBattle:
You haven't seen anything of the ROCK
type's terrifying power!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcDefeat:
Oh, man oh man!
Our challenger is one feisty customer!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcIntro:
We might be in the middle of town,
but so what?

My ROCK POKéMON need room to
rampage!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_MarcPostBattle: I have to hand it to our LEADER.

It took smarts and sense for her to
pick the ROCK type at her young age.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_ReceivedStoneBadge:
{PLAYER} received the STONE BADGE
from ROXANNE.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RegisteredRoxanne:
Registered GYM LEADER ROXANNE
in the POKéNAV.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneDefeat:
It seems that I still have much more
to learn…

The POKéMON LEAGUE's rules state
that TRAINERS are to be given this
if they defeat a GYM LEADER.

Please accept the official POKéMON
LEAGUE STONE BADGE.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneIntro:
Hello, I am ROXANNE, the RUSTBORO
POKéMON GYM LEADER.

I became a GYM LEADER so that I might
apply what I learned at the POKéMON
TRAINER'S SCHOOL in battle.

Would you kindly demonstrate how you
battle, and with which POKéMON?
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostBattle:
Since you are so strong, you should
challenge other GYM LEADERS.

By battling many TRAINERS, you should
learn many things.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePostRematch:
ROXANNE: I still have much to learn
when it comes to battling POKéMON.

That awareness makes me love battling
all that much more!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxannePreRematch:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.

I'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.

I would like to see how much better
we've become. Let us battle!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRegisterCal:
ROXANNE: Oh, hello, {PLAYER}?
This is ROXANNE of RUSTBORO CITY.

I heard from BRAWLY that you're
moving up through the ranks of
TRAINERS at an incredible clip.

Well, I'd rather not think that
I can't beat you.

I promise, I will shape up my GYM
so that you may challenge us again.

I hope you'll be looking forward to
that occasion as much as me!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_RoxanneRematchNeed:
ROXANNE: I'm so glad to see you again.
I'm ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER here.

I'm sure we've both experienced many
battles since we last met.

I would like to see how much better
we've become…

Oh, no…
You only have one POKéMON with you?

Please return with at least one more
POKéMON.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_StoneBadgeInfoTake:
The STONE BADGE heightens the ATTACK
power of your POKéMON.

It also enables them to use the HM move
CUT outside of battle.
Please take this with you, too.
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyIntro:
If you can't beat me, you won't stand
a chance against ROXANNE!
RustboroCity_Gym_Text_TommyPostBattle:
ROXANNE is stronger than me by
several times.
You'd better be on your guard!
RustboroCity_House1_Text_AllSortsOfPlace:
In all sorts of places, there are all
sorts of POKéMON and people.

I find that fascinating, so I go to all
sorts of places.
RustboroCity_House1_Text_AnyPokemonCanBe:
Any POKéMON can be cute if you raise
it with care and kindness.
RustboroCity_House1_Text_DoesntLookLikeM:
Huh? That doesn't look anything like
a {STR_VAR_1} to me.
RustboroCity_House1_Text_IllTradeIfYouWa:
Huh? My POKéMON is cute?
Sure, I knew that.

But if you really want, I'm willing
to trade it to you.

I'll trade you my {STR_VAR_2} for
a {STR_VAR_1} if you want.
RustboroCity_House1_Text_PleaseBeGoodToM:
Eheheh…
Please be good to my POKéMON.
RustboroCity_House1_Text_YouDontWantToTh:
Oh, if you don't want to, that's okay.
But my POKéMON is cute, you know…
RustboroCity_House2_Text_RoxanneKnowsALo:
ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows
a lot about POKéMON.
RustboroCity_House2_Text_TrainerSchoolEx:
If you study there, you could even
become a GYM LEADER.
RustboroCity_House3_Text_IGivePerfectlyS:
For my own POKéMON, I give them
perfectly suited nicknames!

It's my expression of, uh…
originality, yes, that's it!
RustboroCity_House3_Text_NamingPikachuPe:
But giving the name PEKACHU to
a PIKACHU? It seems pointless.

I suppose it is good to use a name
that's easy to understand, but…
RustboroCity_Mart_Text_BuyingHealsInCase:
I'm buying some PARLYZ HEALS and
ANTIDOTES.

Just in case I run into SHROOMISH
in PETALBURG WOODS.
RustboroCity_Mart_Text_GettingEscapeRope:
I'm getting an ESCAPE ROPE just in
case I get lost in a cave.

I just need to use it to get back to
the entrance.
RustboroCity_Mart_Text_ShouldBuySuperPot:
My POKéMON evolved.
It has a lot of HP now.

I should buy SUPER POTIONS for it
instead of ordinary POTIONS.
RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HMCut: The man next door gave me an HM!

I used it to teach my POKéMON how to
CUT down skinny trees.
RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MaleA:
Just like people, there are male and
female POKéMON.

But no one seems to have any idea how
they're different.
RustboroCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokem:
My POKéMON has a NAIVE nature, and my
friend's has a JOLLY nature.

It's fascinating how POKéMON have
personalities!
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_AlwaysWa:
I always wanted a SEEDOT, and
I'm finally getting one!
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Blackboa:
The blackboard lists status changes
that may affect POKéMON in battle.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Confused:
You know how some POKéMON moves can
confuse a POKéMON?

A confused POKéMON will sometimes
attack itself without meaning to.

But once it leaves battle, it will
return to normal.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainB:
A burn reduces ATTACK power, and it
steadily reduces the victim's HP.

A burn lingers after battle.
Cure a burn using a BURN HEAL.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainF:
If a POKéMON is frozen, it becomes
completely helpless.

It will remain frozen after battle.
Thaw it out using an ICE HEAL.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainP:
If a POKéMON becomes paralyzed,
its SPEED drops.

It may also not be able to move while
it is in battle.

Paralysis remains after battle.
Cure it using a PARLYZ HEAL.

If a POKéMON is poisoned, it will
steadily lose HP.

The effects of poison remain after
a battle.

A poisoned POKéMON's HP will drop
while it is traveling.
Heal a poisoning using an ANTIDOTE.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainQ:
A POKéMON holding the QUICK CLAW will
occasionally speed up and get to move
before its opponent.

There are many other items that are
meant to be held by POKéMON.

Just those alone will give you many
topics to study!
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ExplainS:
If a POKéMON falls asleep, it will be
unable to attack.

A POKéMON may wake up on its own,
but if a battle ends while it is
sleeping, it will stay asleep.
Wake it up using an AWAKENING.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_PokemonH:
A POKéMON holding a BERRY will heal
itself…

There are many kinds of items that
POKéMON can hold…

Boy, it sure is hard taking notes
down…
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Pokemont:
POKéMON can hold items, but they
don't know what to do with man-made
items like POTION and ANTIDOTE.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ReadWhic: Which topic do you want to read?
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottMet:
Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.

Let me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.

I've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.

More specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.

So, what brings you to this SCHOOL?
Are you a TRAINER, too?

The first thing you should do is to
have a POKéMON learn the move CUT.

If I remember correctly, someone in
this town has CUT.

Hello? Didn't we meet before?
I think back in PETALBURG CITY.

Let me introduce myself.
My name's SCOTT.

I've been traveling everywhere in
search of outstanding TRAINERS.

More specifically, I'm looking for
POKéMON battle experts.

Oh, what's that?
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?

That's pretty impressive, I'd say, for
a starting TRAINER like yourself.

But, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.

It's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_ScottSto:
It's a STONE BADGE, isn't it?
That's pretty impressive, I'd say.

But, you know, I would've loved to see
you in battle.

It's hard to tell what you're like as
a TRAINER from a LEAGUE BADGE.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_StudentT:
The talent levels of the students here
are unknown. The potential's there.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_Students:
POKéMON are to be caught using
POKé BALLS.

Up to six POKéMON can accompany
a TRAINER.

A TRAINER is someone who catches
POKéMON, raises them, and battles
with them.

A TRAINER's mission is to defeat
the strong TRAINERS who await
challengers in POKéMON GYMS.

Students who don't study get a little
taste of my QUICK CLAW.

Whether or not you are a good student 
will be evident from the way you use
this item.
RustboroCity_PokemonSchool_Text_TradingR:
I'm trading POKéMON with my friend
right now.
RustboroCity_Text_AddedMatchCallPleaseCa:
I added a new feature named
MATCH CALL to your POKéNAV.

Using the MATCH CALL feature,
you can chat with people who have
been registered in your POKéNAV.

{PLAYER}, our PRESIDENT STONE should
be registered in your POKéNAV.

Test it out.
Please give our PRESIDENT a call.
RustboroCity_Text_BrendanHiLetsRegister:
You had a MATCH CALL feature put
on your POKéNAV! Cool!

Let's register each other so we can
get in touch anytime!
RustboroCity_Text_BrendanIWontGoEasy:
BRENDAN: I know you just became
a TRAINER, but I won't go easy!
RustboroCity_Text_BrendanMrBrineyHint:
BRENDAN: By the way, you know
MR. BRINEY? The guy I just passed?

I bet you didn't know this, since you
just moved here, {PLAYER}, but
MR. BRINEY was once a great sailor.
RustboroCity_Text_BrendanNoConfidenceInP:
BRENDAN: What's the matter? Don't have
any confidence in your POKéMON?
RustboroCity_Text_BrendanPassedBrineyWan:
BRENDAN: By the way, {PLAYER}, I walked
by MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.

I bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.

{PLAYER}, how's your POKéDEX?
Have you filled in any pages yet?

Want to have a battle to test how
far you've progressed?
RustboroCity_Text_BrendanWantToBattle:
BRENDAN: What's up?
Want to have a battle with me?
RustboroCity_Text_CatchRarePokemonIfIGoT:
If I go to this school, will I be able
to catch rare POKéMON easily?
RustboroCity_Text_CitySign:
“The city probing the integration of
nature and science.”
RustboroCity_Text_DevelopedNewPokenavFea:
I've been developing an added feature
for the POKéNAV…

{PLAYER}, may I see that POKéNAV?
The one our PRESIDENT gave you?
RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpBranchOfficeS:
“Access limited to DEVON employees
and authorized personnel.”
RustboroCity_Text_DevonCorpSign:
“For all your living needs, we make
it all.”
RustboroCity_Text_GymLeaderIsntEasyWithF: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but…

It's not going to be easy winning with
my FIRE-type POKéMON…

FIRE-type POKéMON don't match up
well against ROCK-type POKéMON…
RustboroCity_Text_GymSign:
RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: ROXANNE
RustboroCity_Text_HaveYouChallengedGym:
Have you taken the POKéMON GYM
challenge?

When you get that shiny GYM BADGE
in hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to
realize what is required of them.
RustboroCity_Text_HelpMeIWasRobbed:
You're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!

Help me! I was robbed by TEAM AQUA!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!

If I don't…
I'm going to be in serious trouble.
RustboroCity_Text_HeyThatsRustborosGymBa:
Out of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,
RUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.
RustboroCity_Text_IdBetterGetBackToWork:
Okay, I'd better get back to work.
Please take care, {PLAYER}!
RustboroCity_Text_MayDefeat:
Yikes!
You're better than I expected!
RustboroCity_Text_MayHiLetsRegister:
You had a MATCH CALL feature put
on your POKéNAV!

Let's register each other so we can
contact one another anytime!
RustboroCity_Text_MayImNotGoingToLose:
MAY: You just became a TRAINER,
{PLAYER}{KUN}. I'm not going to lose!
RustboroCity_Text_MayMrBrineyHint:
MAY: Oh, by the way, MR. BRINEY, who
I just passed…

{PLAYER}{KUN}, you just moved here so you
might not know this, but MR. BRINEY
was once a revered seafarer.
RustboroCity_Text_MayOhHaventRaisedPokem:
Haven't you caught or raised your
POKéMON very much?
That's not very good for a TRAINER!
RustboroCity_Text_MayPassedBrineyWantToB:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed
MR. BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.

I guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.

How's your POKéDEX coming along,
{PLAYER}{KUN}? Mine's looking pretty decent!

So…
How about a little battle?
RustboroCity_Text_MayWantToBattle:
MAY: So, what do you think?
How about a little battle here?
RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyLovesPeeko:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.

He said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.

That old sea dog, he must really love
that PEEKO.
RustboroCity_Text_MrBrineyWalksInTheTunn:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in
a cottage by the sea.

He goes for walks in the tunnel every
so often.
RustboroCity_Text_OutOfTheWay:
Get out!
Out of the way!
RustboroCity_Text_PleaseComeWithMe:
Excuse me, please!
Please come with me!
RustboroCity_Text_PokemonCanChangeLookFr:
If a POKéMON gains experience in
battles, it can sometimes change in
the way it looks.
RustboroCity_Text_PokemonChangeShape:
A POKéMON changes shape?
If one did that, I would be shocked!
RustboroCity_Text_ShadyCharacterTookOffT:
That shady character, I think he took
off towards the tunnel over there.
RustboroCity_Text_SneakyLookingManWentAr:
Come to think of it, yes, a shady-
looking guy went around the corner.
RustboroCity_Text_TradePokemonGrowFast:
A POKéMON you get in a trade from
someone grows fast.

But if you don't have certain GYM
BADGES, it may not obey you…
RustboroCity_Text_TunnelNearingCompletio:
…Is what it says on the sign, but
there's also a big “X” splashed
across it in red paint…
RustboroCity_Text_WeShortenItToDevon:
The DEVON CORPORATION…
We all just shorten it to DEVON.

That company makes all sorts of
convenient products.
RustboroCity_Text_WowYouHavePokemon: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.

When I get bigger, I'm going to go
places with POKéMON, too.
RustboroCity_Text_YouCanHave2On2Battle:
You can have a 2-on-2 battle even
if you're not with another TRAINER.

If you catch the eyes of two TRAINERS
when you have two or more POKéMON,
they'll both challenge you.

Don't you think it'd be cool if you
could beat two TRAINERS by yourself?
RustboroCity_Text_YouGotItThankYou:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?

You did!
You got them back!
You really are a great TRAINER!

I know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!
RustboroCity_Text_YoureLoadedWithItems:
You're loaded with items.
I can't give you this GREAT BALL.
RustboroCity_Text_YoureNewAroundHere:
Oh? Who might you be?
You're a new face around these parts.

Have you just transferred into the
POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?
RusturfTunnel_Text_BoyfriendOnOtherSideO:
On the other side of this rock…
My boyfriend is there.

He… He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.

He works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.
RusturfTunnel_Text_ComeAndGetSome:
What, are you coming?
Come and get some, then!
RusturfTunnel_Text_ExplainStrength:
If a muscular POKéMON were to learn
that, it would be able to move even
large boulders.
RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntDefeat:
Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to
a dead end!
RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntIntro:
That hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!

And to think I made a getaway…
In this tunnel to nowhere!

Hey! You!
So you want to battle me?
RusturfTunnel_Text_GruntTakePackage:
The BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.

All I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.

Tch!
You want it back that badly, take it!
RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeDefeat:
My POKéMON…
Ran out of power…
RusturfTunnel_Text_MikeIntro:
What do you call a wild man up in the
mountains? A mountain man, right?

So why don't they call a POKéMON in
the mountains a mountain POKéMON?
RusturfTunnel_Text_MikePostBattle:
They halted development here to
protect POKéMON, right?
There's a feel-good story!
RusturfTunnel_Text_PeekoGladToSeeYouSafe:
PEEKO!
Am I glad to see you're safe!
RusturfTunnel_Text_ThankYouLetsGoHomePee: PEEKO owes her life to you!

They call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?

Ah, so you are {PLAYER}{KUN}!
I sincerely thank you!

Now, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!

You can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.

Come, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.
RusturfTunnel_Text_ToGetToVerdanturf:
To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,
you need to go to DEWFORD, then pass
through SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE…
RusturfTunnel_Text_WandaReunion:
WANDA!
Now I can see you anytime!
Please, take some rest at my home.
RusturfTunnel_Text_WhyCantTheyKeepDiggin:
Why can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?

My beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here…

If RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visit
her every day…

But this…
What am I to do?
RusturfTunnel_Text_YouShatteredBoulderTa:
Wow! You shattered that boulder
blocking the way.

To show you how much I appreciate it,
I'd like you to have this HM.
SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_LeStrongSilentTy:
Bonjour!
I am le waiter on this ship!

I will be happy to serve you
anything you please!
SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_PassengersAreRes:
The passengers are restless from
this long voyage.

You might be challenged by the
more bored ones!
SSAnne_1F_Room1_Text_ImAGlobalPoliceAgen:
Ssh…!
I'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.

I'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET.
They're up to nothing good!
SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat:
Oh, no!
I went around the world for these!
SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro:
I collected these POKéMON
from all around the world!
SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle:
I demand that you heal them at a
POKéMON CENTER!
SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_CruisingAroundWorld:
We are cruising around the world,
my children and I.
SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle:
Listen, listen!
Let me be your friend, okay?

Then we can trade POKéMON and
do stuff.
SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_AlwaysTravelWithWig:
I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.
I never leave home without it.
SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_CruiseIsElegantAndC:
A world cruise is so elegant yet
cozy!
SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaiterCherryPiePlea:
Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,
please!
SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaitressCherryPiePl:
Waitress, I would like a cherry
pie, please!
SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat:
Humph! You rude child!
You have no sense of courtesy!
SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro:
You insolent pup!
How dare you barge in!
SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle:
I wish to be left alone!
Get out!
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefre:
I'm glad to see that everyone is
looking refreshed and chipper.
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyB:
Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.
You look like my little brother…
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyS:
Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you.
You look like my little sister…
SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest:
You look tired. Would you like to
take a short rest?
SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro: I am but a solitary traveler…

My sole companions and friends are
POKéMON I caught on my journeys…
SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle: You should be nice to friends!
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalDefeat:
At least you're raising your
POKéMON!
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro:
Imagine seeing you here!
{PLAYER}, were you really invited?

I already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere.

Crawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board.
But he was just a seasick old man!

CUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy.

You should go see him, too.
Smell ya!
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory:
{PLAYER}..！
ふなよい　してるのか！

もっと　からだ
きたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！
SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxury:
This ship, she is a luxury liner for
TRAINERS of the world!

At every port, we hold parties with
invited TRAINERS.
SSAnne_2F_Room1_Text_SleepingMonLookedLi:
I've journeyed far and wide, but in
all my travels I've never seen
any POKéMON sleep like this one!
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat:
Good match!
Ah, I feel young again!
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro:
Competing against the young keeps
me youthful.
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle:
Fifteen years ago, I would
have won!
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro: Check out what I fished up!
SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle:
The cruise ship's party should be
over by now.
SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SeenMonsFerryPeople:
Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON
ferry people across the water!
SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SomeTreesCanBeCutDo:
Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT.

But remember this!
CUT is an HM technique.

Once learned, it is not so easily
discarded.
SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro:
I don't believe I saw you at the
party?
SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle:
Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!
Oh, how I envy you for them!
SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro:
Which do you find more worthy,
a strong or a rare POKéMON?
SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle:
Personally, I prefer strong and
rare POKéMON.
SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_HaveYouGoneToSafari:
Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE
in FUCHSIA CITY?

There are many kinds of rare
POKéMON.
SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_WeThinkSafariZoneIs:
Me and my daddy think the SAFARI
ZONE is awesome!
I wish we could go there again.
SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_CaptainIsAwfullySic:
The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.
He was all pale.
SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_ManyPeopleGetSeasic: I hear many people get seasick.
SSAnne_3F_Corridor_Text_CaptainTeachesCu:
Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.
He's awesome at using CUT.

They say he even teaches CUT
to POKéMON!
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat:
Darn!
I let that one get away!
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro:
I can't tell if you're from the seas
or mountains, but stop and chat.
All my POKéMON are from the sea.
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle:
I was going to make you my
assistant, too!
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro:
Matey, you're walking the plank if
you lose!
SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle:
When we're out at sea, jellyfish
POKéMON sometimes drift by.
SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!
SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle:
We caught all our POKéMON while
we were out at sea.
SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro: I like feisty kids like you!
SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle:
Sea POKéMON live in deep water.
You'll need a ROD to fish them up!
SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro:
Come on, then!
My sailor's pride is at stake!
SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle:
Did you see the FISHING GURU in
VERMILION CITY?
SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro:
You know what they say about
sailors and battling!
SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle:
Hahaha!
Want to be a sailor, mate?
SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_MachokeHasStrength: My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!

He has enough STRENGTH to move
big rocks!
SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_CaptainIFeelS:
CAPTAIN: Ooargh…
I feel hideous…
Urrp! Seasick…
SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ExplainCut:
Using CUT, you can chop down
small trees.

Why not try it with the trees
around VERMILION CITY?
SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_HowToConquerS:
How to Conquer Seasickness…
The CAPTAIN's reading this!
SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_SSAnneWillSet:
Now that I'm not sick anymore,
I guess it's time.
The S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!

Farewell, until our return to
VERMILION CITY!
SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThankYouHaveH:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you!
I'm feeling much better now.

You want to see my hidden CUT
technique?

I could show you my prized CUT
technique if I weren't so ill…

I know! You can have this!
This HIDDEN MACHINE!

Teach CUT to your POKéMON, and
you can see it CUT anytime!
SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YouHaveNoRoom:
Oh, no!
You have no room for this!
SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle:
How many kinds of POKéMON do you
think there are in this big world?
SSAnne_Deck_Text_FeelSeasick:
I got seasick, so I stepped out to
get some air…
SSAnne_Deck_Text_ScrubbingDecksHardWork:
Whew!
Scrubbing decks is hard work!
SSAnne_Deck_Text_ShipDepartingSoon:
The party's over.
The ship will be departing soon.
SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle:
My pa said there are 100 kinds of
POKéMON. I think there are more.
SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_BusyOutOfTheWay:
You, mon petit!
We're busy here!
Out of the way!
SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_EelsAuBarbecue: Les guests will mutiny, I fear.
SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_HearAboutSnorlaxItsA:
Did you hear about SNORLAX?
It's a glutton.

No other POKéMON eats and sleeps
the way SNORLAX can and does!
SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_IAmLeChefMainCourseI:
Er-hem!
Indeed I am le CHEF!
SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_OnlyGetToPeelOnions:

challenge, please save the game.

you will be disqualified.

about to receive.

the order in which you rented them.

even when swaps are made.

swap for one of your defeated
opponent's POKéMON.

with the third TRAINER in the event.

used by the beaten TRAINER.
