“Over many years, the remains of
life-forms settle at the bottom of
the sea, making sedimentary layers.

“By analyzing these layers, the
ancient past is revealed.”

“When light passes through water,
most kinds of light lose color.

“However, blue light retains its
color, making the sea appear blue.”

“OCEANIC MINIFACT 2
Why is the sea salty?

“Seawater contains dissolved salt in
the form of sodium and chlorine ions.

“These ions leech out of rocks
and are carried out to sea by rain.

“The concentration of dissolved salt
makes the sea salty.”

“OCEANIC MINIFACT 3
Which is bigger? The sea or land?

“The sea covers about 70% of
the planet, and the rest is land.

“The sea is therefore more than twice
the size of land.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_OurB:
We were told to assemble here,
so we did, but…
Our BOSS, the linchpin, isn't here.
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Reme:
Aiyeeeh!
What are you doing here?

Me? I'm the TEAM AQUA member
you thumped before, remember?
Back in RUSTURF TUNNEL?

Here, take this!
You have to forgive me!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Rust:
If our goons didn't bungle things
in RUSTBORO, we wouldn't be here!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Ster:
I get all giddy and gooey when
I see the sea!

For me, CAPT. STERN is the number
one role model!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Tell:
Then, please, tell me anything of
interest that you experienced recently
involving POKéMON.
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_That:
I'll be sure to get your story told
on television.

It should be aired sometime, I think,
so please look forward to it.
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Want:
I think it would feel cool and nice
to hug.
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Wate:
A red ball is bobbing up and down
inside a glass vessel.

“This is an experiment simulating a
WATERFALL using the ball's buoyancy.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Whir:
A blue fluid is spiraling inside
a glass vessel.

“This is an experiment to create a
WHIRLPOOL artificially using wind.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_Woul:
If I ripped off the stuff here,
would it make me rich?

The entrance fee is ¥50.
Would you like to enter?
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_1F_Text_YouH:
Awww, come on!
You have to take this and let me go!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Arch:
We are TEAM AQUA,
and we love the sea!

And I am TEAM AQUA's leader,
ARCHIE!
What makes you interfere with us?

…No! You can't be!
You're not one of TEAM MAGMA?

Wait, that can't be right.
You're not dressed for the part.

POKéMON, people… All life depends on
the sea.

So, TEAM AQUA is dedicated to
the expansion of the sea.

Don't you agree? What we are doing
is a magnificent undertaking.

Ah, fine…
You're still too young to understand
our noble objective.

But, I warn you, don't even consider
interfering with our plans again.

The consequences will cost you
dearly!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Boss:
Oh, man, what a disaster…
The BOSS is going to be furious…
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Came:
I came to see what was taking so
long to snatch some parts, and you
simps are held up by a mere child?
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Deep: It's a display on the flow of seawater.

“Near the bottom of the sea, water
flows due to differences in such
factors as temperature and salinity.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Dont:
Don't you dare run around inside
the MUSEUM!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Hoen:
It's a miniature diorama of the
HOENN region.
Where is LITTLEROOT TOWN on this?
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_LetM:
Humph, sniveling wimp!
Let me take care of this!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Medd:
Now what? If we don't get the parts,
we're in for it!

Arrgh, I didn't count on being meddled
with by some meddling kid!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Pres:
A rubber ball is expanding and
shrinking.

“In the sea, the weight of water itself
exerts pressure.

“In shallow water, the pressure is not
very heavy.

“However, in extremely deep water,
the pressure can reach even tens of
thousands of tons on a small area.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Remi: I saw a model of a ship here.

It reminded me of the ABANDONED SHIP
near DEWFORD TOWN…
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSAn:
“A replica of the luxury liner that
circles the globe.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_SSTi:
“A scale replica of the ship under
construction at STERN'S SHIPYARD.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Ster:
CAPT. STERN: Whoops!
There's no time to lose!

We have to set out on our ocean-floor
expedition really soon.

Thanks again, but now I've got
to go!

Feel free to wander around and check
out our facilities, though.

CAPT. STERN: You're…
Ah, okay, you're {PLAYER}{KUN}…

Anyway, that was a tense situation!
Thank you for saving us!

Oh, yes, I almost forgot that you
even brought the parts from DEVON!

CAPT. STERN: Wh-what?
Who are you people?
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Subm:
“A replica of the high-performance
ocean floor exploration submarine.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Sumb:
“A replica of a compact, unmanned
pod for seafloor exploration.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Surf: It's a display on the flow of seawater.

“Toward the surface, seawater flows
as currents driven by the winds.”
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Than:
Yes? If you're looking for STERN,
that would be me.

Ah! Those must be the parts I ordered
from MR. STONE of DEVON.

Thank you! That's great!
We can prepare for our expedition now.
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Want:
Wow, the submarine's awesome!
I want to go for a ride!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Wate:
The sea is all connected, but the
water seems to differ by region.

Does the saltiness of seawater differ
by region, too?
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Well:
Hehehe, hold it!
We'll take those parts!
SlateportCity_OceanicMuseum_2F_Text_Were:
Our BOSS wants those parts!
Shut your yap and fork them over!
SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rais:
I'd say it's raising different kinds
of POKéMON in a balanced manner.

It's no good to make just one
POKéMON strong.

If it has a type disadvantage,
it might not stand a chance.
SlateportCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trad: I trade POKéMON with my friends.

If a traded POKéMON is holding an
item, it makes me twice as happy!
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AllowM:
Er-hem! I see you've participated in
a POKéMON CONTEST!

Please! Allow me to examine how you
have raised your POKéMON.

It delights me no end to see POKéMON
raised by other TRAINERS.

The happy expressions of POKéMON
raised with proper care…

The kindly eyes of the TRAINER that
nurtured and raised the POKéMON…

The very thought fills my heart to
overwhelming with joy.

Oh! I do beg your pardon!
Forgive me for prattling on so!

Please! Allow me to examine how much
your POKéMON has grown!
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Descri:
When you first met {STR_VAR_1},
what did you feel?

How would you describe your feelings
at the time?
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_EnjoyD:
I enjoy this job--you get to learn
about POKéMON by doing interviews.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Explai: Let a POKéMON hold that BLUE SCARF.

Its beauty will be accentuated much
more than now!
Let a POKéMON hold that GREEN SCARF.

That will enhance the
smartness of POKéMON!
Let a POKéMON hold that PINK SCARF.

It will draw out the cuteness of
the POKéMON some more!
Let a POKéMON hold that RED SCARF.

Everyone will recognize the coolness
of that POKéMON!
Let a POKéMON hold that YELLOW SCARF.

It will bolster your POKéMON's
toughness so much more!
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_GiveMo:
Hmmm… It's not bad, but it's not
good, either…

You, the TRAINER, must put more
effort into raising this POKéMON!

For instance, may I suggest that
you give it more {POKEBLOCK}S?
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HereGo:
Okay, here goes.
I just need quick answers, okay?
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HereIf:
Well, if you get the urge to tell me
about POKéMON, I'll be here!
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_HowIsY:
How is your POKéMON growing?
Allow me to examine it.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Interv:
Hi, you seem to be very close to your
{STR_VAR_1}.

Do you know what?
I'm a TV reporter.

I travel around interviewing people
about POKéMON.

I'm wondering if you'd be willing to tell
me a little about your {STR_VAR_1}?

It's plain to see that you lavish your
love on your {STR_VAR_1}.
Can I ask you a favor?

I'm a TV reporter, and I'm running
a survey on POKéMON.

Would you be willing to answer a few
simple questions for me?
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikeTo:
The POKéMON of a TRAINER who has
entered a POKéMON CONTEST…
That, I would like to see.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_LikenM:
If you were to liken it to something
that you like, what would it be?
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MeetCh:
Er-hem! I am the CHAIRMAN of the
POKéMON FAN CLUB!

Being the CHAIRMAN, I am naturally
the most important!

No one can best me when it comes
to raising POKéMON. No one!

Well, let me tell you about
POKéMON CONTESTS.

They're events where one can show off
POKéMON for the world to see!

However, they're held in far-off towns,
so I cannot participate often enough.

That is why we gather here to show
off our POKéMON, and have others
show us theirs.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonEnj:
Do POKéMON enjoy having items used
on them?

Mine acted really happy when I gave
it some PROTEIN.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_MonMos:
Your {STR_VAR_1}, it is growing in
a most impressive manner!
It is one fine specimen!

But! If you were to give it this,
it would grow even better! Indeed!
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_NoSpac:
Your POKéMON is growing quite well,
so you deserve a reward.

Unfortunately, you have no space for
this in your BAG.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Nothin:
I'm sorry, but I've nothing else to
give you! None at all!

After all, you're blessed with the gift
of raising POKéMON without resorting
to any items!
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pokemo:
For you, a most compassionate
TRAINER, a gift from the FAN CLUB!

If you keep letting a POKéMON faint
in battle, it'll come to resent it.

Soon, it will become less trusting
of the TRAINER.

In other words, it certainly won't
like you very much.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ShowMe:
I love seeing POKéMON that love
their TRAINERS.

POKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.

If you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.

When your POKéMON grow to love you,
please come show me.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TellMe:
Okay, then, please tell me anything
you'd like about your {STR_VAR_1}.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ThatsA:
Okay!
Thanks for helping me out.

It was fun and enlightening
chatting with you.

It's possible that our interview will
end up on TV. Tune in and check!

You really are tight with {STR_VAR_1},
aren't you?

I get the feeling that your account
will make a great TV story.

I promise that I'll turn this into
an entertaining show.
Keep your eyes out for it.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_TreatP:
POKéMON are very sensitive to
the feelings of their TRAINERS.

If you treat your POKéMON with love
and care, they'll love you back.
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_WhatAt:
This question also relates to your
beloved {STR_VAR_1}.

What was it about {STR_VAR_1} that
attracted you?
SlateportCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_WhatDo:
The next question might be a little
on the tough side.
What do POKéMON mean to you?
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Bri:
DOCK: Hi! MR. BRINEY's joined us to
lend us his help.

Thanks to the veteran sailor, the
ferry is steadily coming together.
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Can:
Umm… If this goes here, and that
goes over there…

Then where does this thing go?
And what about that doohickey?

Aaargh! I can't make heads or tails
of this!
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Cou:
A lot of things can't be figured out
just by calculating.

I really could use advice from a veteran
who knows the seas…

DOCK: Where could CAPT. STERN have
gone off to?

Could you go find CAPT. STERN and
deliver that parcel to him?
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Dec:
MR. BRINEY: Ah, {PLAYER}{KUN}!
It's been too long!

Aye, since I met you, this old sea dog's
been feeling frisky!

So I've decided to help DOCK make
a ferry.

Aye, after all, a ferry would be able
to carry a lot of people.

But, you know, that DOCK is really
something special.

With his knack for technology and
my experience, I'm sure that we can
build one great ship, aye!
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Fer: DOCK: The ferry is finally ready!

The new S.S. TIDAL is truly a marvel
of technology!

But, I get the feeling that we can
make something even better.

You know, there's never an end to
technology's march.
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Get:
I get seasick real easily.
So I get to help out here instead.
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Mee:
CAPT. STERN commissioned me to
design a ferry.

Oh! That there…
Are they DEVON GOODS?

CAPT. STERN went off somewhere.
He said he had some work to do.

Could I get you to go find CAPT.
STERN and deliver that to him?
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_1F_Text_Sea:
The seasons, the weather, where
the moon sits in the sky…

These and other conditions make
the sea change its expression.

That's right!
The sea is like a living thing!
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Flo:
Don't you think it's strange that
a ship made of heavy iron floats?

It floats because of a principle
called buoyancy.
SlateportCity_SternsShipyard_2F_Text_Shi:
Designing a large ship is more like
making a big building than putting
together a transportation vehicle.
SlateportCity_Text_AmIOnTV:
Hey! Are you watching?
Am I on TV?
SlateportCity_Text_AquaHasPolicy:
TEAM AQUA has a policy of
assembling and dispersing at
the operation site.
SlateportCity_Text_AquaWillAssumeControl:
We of TEAM AQUA will assume
control of your submarine!

Your objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!

Fufufu…
Just watch and learn what TEAM
AQUA has planned!
SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentBuiltRecent:
Recently, a BATTLE TENT was built
in SLATEPORT.

GYMS are fun, but the BATTLE TENT's
awesome in its own way.

You should go find tough POKéMON
for the BATTLE TENT!
SlateportCity_Text_BattleTentSign:
BATTLE TENT SLATEPORT SITE
“Find it! The ultimate POKéMON!”
SlateportCity_Text_BigSmileForCamera:
TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile
for the camera!
SlateportCity_Text_BossIsBrilliant:
What would he want to do with
a MUSEUM now?
SlateportCity_Text_BroughtMeSomeBerryPow:
Have you brought me some
BERRY POWDER?
SlateportCity_Text_BushedHikingFromMauvi:
I hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY.
But, boy, this city's huge.

If I'd known this, I would've ridden
my BIKE here.
SlateportCity_Text_BuyBricksSoDecorWontG:
If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on
the floor, they'll get dirty.

I'm going to buy some BRICKS so my
DOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty
when I leave them out.
SlateportCity_Text_BuyTooMuch:
Whenever I visit here, I get carried
away and buy too much.
SlateportCity_Text_CantChangeTradeMonNam:
Any POKéMON you get in a trade,
you can't change its nickname.

The original TRAINER's love for that
POKéMON is in the nickname.
SlateportCity_Text_CaptSternBeingIntervi:
I was hoping that it was a famous star
so I could get an autograph.

But who's that being interviewed?
Isn't that CAPT. STERN?
SlateportCity_Text_CaptainComeBackWithBi:
Did the good CAPTAIN come back with
a big fish from the ocean floor?
SlateportCity_Text_CaptainsACelebrity:
A TV interview! Here!
The CAPTAIN's a celebrity!
SlateportCity_Text_CitySign:
“The port where people and POKéMON
cross paths.”
SlateportCity_Text_ComeBackToTradeBerryP:
Come back if you'd like to trade your
BERRY POWDER for some medicine.
I'm always running a bazaar here.
SlateportCity_Text_DontButtIn:
Hey, you there!
Don't butt in!
SlateportCity_Text_DontHaveEnoughBerryPo:
Oh, dear. You don't have enough
BERRY POWDER.
SlateportCity_Text_EffortRibbonLooksGood:
Oh! Your {STR_VAR_1}, that EFFORT
RIBBON looks good on it!
SlateportCity_Text_EnergyGuruSellWhatYou:
I'm the ENERGY GURU! I'll go for it and
sell you what you need!
SlateportCity_Text_EveryoneCallsHimCaptS:
STERN, the fellow who built the
MUSEUM, also happens to be the leader
of an undersea exploration team.
So, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.
SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeBerryPowderFo:
Okay, you want to exchange your
BERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?
SlateportCity_Text_ExchangeWhatWithIt:
What would you like to exchange
it with?
SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerries:
If a wild POKéMON gets hurt, it heals
itself by chewing on BERRIES.

Somebody saw that and got the idea
of making medicine from BERRIES.

To turn BERRIES into medicine,
they must be crushed into powder.

You seem to have an interest
in BERRIES!

I've got something good for someone
like you.
SlateportCity_Text_ExplainBerryPowder:
I recently had machines installed at
POKéMON CENTERS for crushing BERRIES.

The BERRY CRUSH machines are at
the DIRECT CORNER upstairs.

Could you make BERRY POWDER for
me using those machines?

I can make you all sorts of medicine
if you bring me lots of BERRY POWDER.
SlateportCity_Text_FineBerryPowderTradeS:
This is fine BERRY POWDER.
It will make excellent medicine.

Would you like to trade more of your
BERRY POWDER for something else?
SlateportCity_Text_FromHarborTryingToTak:
The submarine!
They're trying to take it!
SlateportCity_Text_GabbyWonderfulThanksF:
GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN!
Thank you for taking the time from
your busy schedule to talk to us.

We hope we can interview you again
with news of more discoveries!
SlateportCity_Text_GetNameRaterToHelpYou:
If you want to change your POKéMON's
nickname, you'll have to get the NAME
RATER to help you.
SlateportCity_Text_GoForItLittleHarder: You have to go for it a little harder.

If you do, I'll give your POKéMON
something nice.
SlateportCity_Text_GoingToCompeteInBattl:
Wroooar! I'm going to compete in
the BATTLE TENT, too!

But before that, I need to catch
some POKéMON!
SlateportCity_Text_HarborFerryUnderConst:
“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under
construction in the SHIPYARD.
SlateportCity_Text_HarborSign:
“Enjoy a delightful cruise on
the ferry S.S. TIDAL.”
SlateportCity_Text_HotSpringsAfterOperat:
When this operation's over, I'll take
you to a hot spring spa!

That's what our leader said.
I can't wait!
SlateportCity_Text_HowTownIsBornAndGrows:
Where the water is clean, the fruits
of bountiful harvest gather.

And where people gather, a market
soon starts.
That is how a town is born and grows.
SlateportCity_Text_IllReadSignForYou:
You want to read this sign?
I'll read it for you!
SlateportCity_Text_InterviewerSoCool:
That lady interviewer is so cool
and pretty.

When I grow up, I'm going to be
an international journalist!
SlateportCity_Text_KeepEyeOnTrainersBeSe:
SCOTT: What I'd like to do is tag along
with you, but I do want to keep an eye
on the talents of other people, too.

So, I'll be off to roam other towns
a bit more.
SlateportCity_Text_LetsRegisterEachOther:
SCOTT: All right! I think you're going
to become a good friend.

So, let's register each other in our
POKéNAVS.
SlateportCity_Text_MarketSign:
SLATEPORT MARKET
“Unique items found nowhere else!”
SlateportCity_Text_MaybeThisTrainer:
SCOTT: Hmm…
Maybe, just maybe, this TRAINER…
SlateportCity_Text_MostInvaluableExperie:
GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most
invaluable experience…
SlateportCity_Text_OhPlayerWeMadeDiscove:
We made a huge discovery on our last
seafloor exploration.

We found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.

We think it's the habitat of a POKéMON
that's said to have been long extinct.
SlateportCity_Text_PleaseGiveItThisEffor:
As its reward, please give it this
EFFORT RIBBON.
SlateportCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign:
POKéMON FAN CLUB
“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”
SlateportCity_Text_QuitPushing:
Hey, there! Quit pushing!
This is the line, can't you see?
SlateportCity_Text_RegisteredScott:
Registered this SCOTT person
in the POKéNAV.
SlateportCity_Text_RemindsMeOfLongLineFo:
It reminds me of the times I lined up to
buy smash-hit games…
SlateportCity_Text_SaysSomethingLikeSeaI:
Um… I think it says something like
“the life in the sea is endless.”

Yup, I'm pretty sure that's what
it says.
SlateportCity_Text_SeaIsSoWet: The sea is just so vast…

Could the sea have been made by
the tears shed by POKéMON?
SlateportCity_Text_SeaweedFullOfLife:
The seaweed you can get around these
parts is fresh and full of life.

Why, it looks like it can even rear up
and attack!
SlateportCity_Text_ShouldTakeItAll:
If there's something we need in
the MUSEUM, we should take it all!
SlateportCity_Text_ShouldveBroughtMyGame:
I should've brought my Game Boy
Advance so I wouldn't get bored in line…
SlateportCity_Text_SinkOldBoats:
Do you know what they do with old
ships that become too creaky to sail?

They sink them in the sea so they
become habitats for POKéMON.
SlateportCity_Text_SlateportWonderfulPla:
Shopping where you can breathe the
scent of the ocean…
SLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!
SlateportCity_Text_SternMoveAheadWithExp:
CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to
move ahead with our exploration.
SlateportCity_Text_SternSaysDiscoveredSo:
CAPT. STERN says they discovered
something at the bottom of the sea.

I wonder what it is?
What could it be?
SlateportCity_Text_SternWhatWasAllThat: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?

It sounded like someone using
a megaphone…
SlateportCity_Text_SternWhewFirstIntervi:
That was my first time to be filmed for
TV. That was nerve-wracking.
SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardFerryCo:
“Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE
ferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the
HARBOR.”
SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardNearsCo:
“The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears
completion for serving the ports of
SLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”
SlateportCity_Text_SternsShipyardWantedS:
“Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing
in all currents.”
SlateportCity_Text_TakingBattleTentChall:
SCOTT: Oh, hey!
If it isn't {PLAYER}{KUN}!

{PLAYER}{KUN}, let me guess--you're going
to take the BATTLE TENT challenge?

Yeah! That's a good idea!
That's a really great idea!

After all, a tough TRAINER is
the perfect fit for the BATTLE TENT!
SlateportCity_Text_VisitedMuseumOften:
When I was a child, I visited
the MUSEUM often.

I used to dream about the mysteries of
the sea after seeing the exhibits.
SlateportCity_Text_WhatsLongLineOverTher:
What is that over there?
That long line…
SlateportCity_Text_WhatsNewSchemeIWonder: What's the new scheme, I wonder?

Our BOSS is scary when he's mad, so
I'd better not screw things up…
SlateportCity_Text_WhenYouGetMoreBringIt:
Okay! When you get some more
BERRY POWDER, bring it to me, please!
SlateportCity_Text_WhyAreWeLiningUp:
Why are we even lining up and paying?
We should just march in!
SlateportCity_Text_WonderIfLighthouseSta:
The light of the lighthouse reaches
dozens of miles away.

I wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON
in the sea.
SlateportCity_Text_YouDroveTeamAquaAway:
SCOTT: Huh?
I'm sure I met you somewhere before.

Have I introduced myself to you?
If not, my name's SCOTT.

I just saw TEAM AQUA run away from
here like they were stung.
Let me guess--you drove them away?
SmartShopper_Text_ClerkMax:
Let's interview the clerk to get the
lowdown.

CLERK: Oh, we're doing unbelievable
business. It's almost overwhelming.

Recently, a TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}
bought the item {STR_VAR_2} in bulk.

The TRAINER almost cleared out our
entire stock of {STR_VAR_2}S.

I never dreamt that any customer
would ever need so many {STR_VAR_2}S.
It's just unheard of!

INTERVIEWER: So that would be like 100
or 200 sold?
CLERK: Oh, no, much more than that!

INTERVIEWER: Oh, my goodness!
{STR_VAR_1} must be a special shopper!

CLERK: {STR_VAR_1} is a VIP customer,
no doubt about it.
SmartShopper_Text_ClerkNormal:
Let's interview the clerk to get the
lowdown.

Recently, {STR_VAR_2} has been
selling especially strongly.

Why, just the other day a TRAINER
named {STR_VAR_1} bought {STR_VAR_3}.
SmartShopper_Text_DuringSale:
CLERK: Plus, it was during a big sale.
That's smart shopping.
SmartShopper_Text_Intro: It's time for TODAY'S SMART SHOPPER.

Today we're visiting a shop
in {STR_VAR_2}.

Let's check on what the hot sellers
have been recently.
SmartShopper_Text_IsVIP:
CLERK: {STR_VAR_1} is a VIP customer,
no doubt about it.
SmartShopper_Text_OutroMax:
But why would the TRAINER need to buy
so many?

The mystery deepens, but this is all
the time we have today.
See you on our next broadcast!
SmartShopper_Text_OutroNormal:
INTERVIEWER: Hmm… {STR_VAR_1} sounds like
quite the shrewd bargain hunter!

Oops! We're out of time!
See you on our next broadcast!
SmartShopper_Text_RandomComment1:
INTERVIEWER: The TRAINER bought
{STR_VAR_3} {STR_VAR_2}S? That's a haul!

If I may say so, {STR_VAR_1} must have
been stocking up for a long journey
to far-off places.
SmartShopper_Text_RandomComment2:
INTERVIEWER: Speaking of the item
{STR_VAR_2}, I just bought {STR_VAR_3} of
them recently.
SmartShopper_Text_RandomComment3:
I didn't think there would be anyone
buying that many.

My goodness, I can only afford one or
two at a time…
SmartShopper_Text_RandomComment4:
INTERVIEWER: One time, I bought
a whole lot of the item {STR_VAR_2}.

But it turned out to be too many.
I ended up regretting it…

Since then, I only buy strictly what
I absolutely need…
There's no point talking about me!
SmartShopper_Text_SecondItem:
CLERK: {STR_VAR_1} also bought the item
{STR_VAR_2} in bulk, taking {STR_VAR_3}.

INTERVIEWER: Oh, that's smart.
{STR_VAR_2}'s a very good item, too.
SmartShopper_Text_ThirdItem:
CLERK: And, the TRAINER also bought
{STR_VAR_3} of the item {STR_VAR_2}.
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainRainBa:
Having the RAIN BADGE shall assure you
the full obedience of all your POKéMON
to your every command.

The RAIN BADGE also allows the use
of the HM move WATERFALL to scale
walls of cascading water.

And, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this…
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ExplainWaterP:
The TECHNICAL MACHINE I handed you
contains WATER PULSE.

In use, it will occasionally confuse
the target with ultrasonic waves.
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GoGetFortreeB:
There remains but one BADGE to
obtain in HOENN.

If you wish to challenge the POKéMON
LEAGUE, you must obtain the last
BADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuideAdvic:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound {PLAYER}?

SOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER JUAN is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.

And, to get to JUAN, an icy floor
will hamper your progress…

Listen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.

The rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_GymGuidePostV:
Yow! You've beaten even JUAN, who
was supposedly the best in all HOENN!
Okay! Check out your TRAINER CARD.

If you've gotten all the BADGES, you're
set for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanDefeat:
Ahahaha, excellent!
Very well, you are the winner.

From you, I sense the brilliant shine
of skill that will overcome all.

However, compared with me or even
WALLACE, you are lacking in elegance.

Perhaps I should make you a loan
of my outfit?

Rather than my clothes, I shall reward
you with this, the RAIN BADGE!
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanIntro:
Let me ask you.
Did you know?
Ah, I should not be so coy.

It was I who taught WALLACE everything
there is to know about POKéMON.

Once, I had given up my position as
the GYM LEADER.

In my place, I had entrusted WALLACE
with the GYM.

However, a compelling reason arose for
me to make a comeback.

Ah, but enough chatter.
Let us begin our match, shall we?

Please, you shall bear witness to
our artistry.

A grand illusion of water sculpted
by POKéMON and myself!
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostBattl:
The TRAINERS who have gathered all
the GYM BADGES of HOENN should make
way to the ultimate destination.

Travel to the easternmost reaches
of HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.

There, you shall find the POKéMON
LEAGUE.
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPostRemat:
JUAN: If I told you to become my
apprentice, you will refuse, I am sure.

I would like to make a gift of my coat
to you.

But again, you will refuse.
I imagine that to be so.

And that, my friend, is a certain sign
of nobility!
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanPreRematc:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…

But our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!

I shall be delighted to dance with you
as often as you wish!
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchDe:
Ahahaha, you are the winner!
You have defeated me again!
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_JuanRematchNe:
JUAN: Ah, this GYM had returned to its
usual state of serenity…

But our young typhoon has returned
to put us to the test again!

Well, my friend, most certainly!
I shall be delighted to dance with you…

Ah, no, no, no.
You have with you but one POKéMON.

I wish that you would return with
two, perhaps more, POKéMON, please.
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_ReceivedRainB:
{PLAYER} received the RAIN BADGE
from JUAN.
SootopolisCity_Gym_1F_Text_RegisteredJua:
Registered GYM LEADER JUAN
in the POKéNAV.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaIntro:
I'll show you the sublime techniques
I learned from our LEADER JUAN!
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AndreaPostBa:
Watch what happens if you crack all
the floor tiles.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaDefeat:
Oh, there now! Did you have a good look
at my POKéMON?
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaIntro:
I can battle with really rare POKéMON
if you'd like.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_AnnikaPostBa:
I came to this GYM because JUAN
praised me for my darling POKéMON.

Oh, if only I'd met JUAN years ago
when I was younger…
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyIntro:
When I'm with my POKéMON, the time
flies by before you can say, “Oops!”
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BethanyPostB:
I wish I could forget about lost causes
before I can manage an “Oops!”
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaDefea:
Oh, dear.
I went much too easy on you.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaIntro:
Giggle…
Your grim look is so charming.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BriannaPostB:
You couldn't lay a finger on JUAN,
I'm sure. Giggle…
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetDefea: What a high level you are!
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetIntro:
The POKéMON GYM of the highest level
in the HOENN region…
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_BridgetPostB:
Rather than being satisfied by being
in a strong GYM, I imagine training in
other places will make you stronger.
But above all, it looks more fun.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConnieIntro:
I should teach you how harsh battles
can be.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_ConniePostBa:
If you want to reach JUAN, you
need to walk on each floor tile once.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyDefeat:
You're strong!
I was fooled by your cute looks!
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyIntro:
You came all the way here, but you won't
get to see JUAN.
Not if you lose to me, you won't!
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_CrissyPostBa:
You might be good enough to avoid
being wiped out in one hit by JUAN.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneDefeat:
You battled with more beauty than
I could muster…
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphneIntro:
The sight of JUAN conducting
a battle…

The very beauty of it compelled me to
become a TRAINER.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_DaphnePostBa:
The grace you bring to battle is
fabulous.

Oh… I'm so fortunate to have found
POKéMON.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaIntro:
I train my POKéMON together with
JUAN.
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_OliviaPostBa:
I think you have potential.
Why don't you stay and train with us?
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyIntro:
A graceful glide across the ice while
crossing no lines…

A TRAINER putting on that performance
would be elegantly beautiful!
SootopolisCity_Gym_B1F_Text_TiffanyPostB:
This is really obvious, but how strong
you are as a TRAINER has nothing to do
with how young or old you are.
SootopolisCity_House1_Text_DevelopedThis:
For thirty years I've remained in
SOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.

I developed a shattering TM.
I bequeath it to you!
SootopolisCity_House1_Text_ExplainBrickB:
TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move
so horrible that I can't describe it.
SootopolisCity_House2_Text_DidYouKnowAbo:
At its peak are two orbs placed side
by side. Did you know?
SootopolisCity_House2_Text_OughtToVisitA:
Is that so?
Perhaps you ought to visit and see…
SootopolisCity_House2_Text_YesTwoOrbsSid: Yes, two orbs side by side…

The sight of them together…
It is somehow soothing…
SootopolisCity_House3_Text_JuanHasManyFa: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?

SOOTOPOLIS's JUAN has many fans.
Even more than his student WALLACE!
SootopolisCity_House3_Text_LonesomeTryWo:
Oh, dear…
That's a little lonesome.

Try working a little harder to get
a fan following.
SootopolisCity_House3_Text_TrainerFanClu:
Dedicated fans come over from even
outside of HOENN.

It was really wild when I went to the
TRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.
SootopolisCity_House3_Text_YouMustBePret: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.
SootopolisCity_House4_Text_AncientTreasu:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.

There's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.

There could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.
SootopolisCity_House4_Text_StrollUnderwa:
It would be nice if they existed, but
even if they didn't, it would be so
beautiful to take an underwater
stroll with my POKéMON.
SootopolisCity_House5_Text_BrotherUsedTo: My big brother used to study the sea.
SootopolisCity_House5_Text_SootopolisMtP:
There appears to be some connection
between SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.

My friends and I did some research on
it at the lab where I used to work.
SootopolisCity_House6_Text_DontWantThisD:
Are you sure?
You don't want this DOLL?
SootopolisCity_House6_Text_FirstGuestInW:
Hello! You're our first guest in
a good while.

You've brightened up my day, so I'll
give you a big WAILMER DOLL.
SootopolisCity_House6_Text_IllHoldItForY:
Oh, you want it, but not right now?
Okay, then I'll hold it for you.
SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CaveMadeToKee:
The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and
the outside world…

It seems as if the cave was made to
keep something from getting out.
Or am I just imagining things?
SootopolisCity_House7_Text_CityFromErupt:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.

Its crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.

That's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.
SootopolisCity_LotadAndSeedotHouse_Text_:
Hunh?
Your BAG is crammed full.

Hunh?
Your BAG is crammed full.

The biggest LOTAD in history!
{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} colossus!

A LOTAD bigger than a SEEDOT
always wanted!

The biggest SEEDOT in history!
{STR_VAR_2}'s {STR_VAR_3} giant!

A SEEDOT bigger than a LOTAD
always wanted!

Don't you have a big LOTAD?
How disappointing…

If you get a big LOTAD, please
come show me!

You don't have a big SEEDOT?
That's too bad…

If you get a big SEEDOT, please
come show me.

{STR_VAR_2}!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!

It might even beat the big LOTAD
my younger brother saw!

Thanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!

Do you know the POKéMON LOTAD?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.
I love, I mean love, big LOTAD!

My big brother says that SEEDOT is
bigger.

But that's wrong! Everyone knows that
LOTAD is a lot bigger.

Hunh? Do you have a LOTAD?
P-p-please show me!

Do you know the POKéMON SEEDOT?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.

Anyway, I love big SEEDOT.
The bigger the better.

But my younger brother, he says that
LOTAD is bigger.

That's silly.
SEEDOT has to be bigger than that!

Huh? Do you have a SEEDOT with you?
P-p-please, show me!
{PLAYER} received a POTION.
{PLAYER} received a POTION.
{STR_VAR_2}?

Hmm… I've seen a bigger LOTAD
than this one here.
{STR_VAR_2}, is it?

Hmm… I've seen a bigger SEEDOT
than this one.

Well, isn't this something!
But it's no LOTAD!

Oh, now this is quite something…
But it's not a SEEDOT!

{STR_VAR_2}!
Wow, that is big!

It might be even bigger than the huge
SEEDOT my big brother saw.

Thanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!
SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_FullRestoreItem:
Full restoration of HP!
Eradication of all status problems!
It's truly an item of your dreams!
SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_PPUpIsGreat:
It raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,
of a POKéMON move.
SootopolisCity_Mart_Text_TooScaryOutside:
I really want to know, but it's too
scary to go outside.
SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_1F_Tex: So, it became a standoff.

It was a brilliant match in which
neither side conceded a step!

A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1}
is visiting my home.

Would you like to challenge
{STR_VAR_1}?
The door appears to be locked.
I hope to see a good match!
Oh, good, good!
But my house isn't all that sturdy.

Could I ask you to keep it down to
a 3-on-3 match?

When I was young, I traveled the world
as a POKéMON TRAINER.

Now that I've become an old buzzard,
my only amusement is watching young
TRAINERS battle.

Before you two battle, you should
save your progress.
{STR_VAR_1}
{STR_VAR_1}
{STR_VAR_1}
That was superlative!

Why, it was like seeing myself in
my youth again!
Ah, too bad for you!

But it was a good match.
I hope you can win next time.

You won't battle? I'm disappointed
that I can't see you battle…
SootopolisCity_MysteryEventsHouse_B1F_Te: The match ended up a draw.
SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Alw:
Whenever, wherever, and whatever
happens, I will always be friends with
POKéMON.
Because it's fun to be with POKéMON!
SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Are: Why are they going wild this way?
SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Eve:
Everyone in town has taken refuge
and won't come out of their homes.

Even I would rather not venture
outside.
SootopolisCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Wal:
WALLACE is rumored to be the toughest
TRAINER in the whole HOENN region.

This town's GYM is led by the TRAINER
who taught WALLACE.

But the ELITE FOUR… They're said to be
even stronger than WALLACE's mentor.
SootopolisCity_Text_AfterAllOurScheming:
MAXIE: So the super-ancient POKéMON
weren't only GROUDON and KYOGRE…

After all our fruitless scheming and
frantic efforts, that one POKéMON's
simple action puts everything right
again as if nothing had happened…
SootopolisCity_Text_AquaMagmaDidntMeanHa:
The leaders of TEAM MAGMA and AQUA,
I don't think they meant harm.

It wouldn't hurt to hear what they
have to say for themselves.
SootopolisCity_Text_AwakenedPokemonClash:
The clash between the two awakened
POKéMON was quelled by the awakening
of a third POKéMON…
SootopolisCity_Text_BigPokemonFighting:
A big POKéMON is fighting with
another big POKéMON!
SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginPleaseLe: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.

The spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at
MT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.
SootopolisCity_Text_CaveOfOriginSleepsTo: This is the CAVE OF ORIGIN…

With the passing of the crisis,
the cave, too, shall sleep…
SootopolisCity_Text_CityRegainedCalm: The city has regained its calm…
SootopolisCity_Text_DazzledByMentor:
WALLACE: I'm sure that you will be
dazzled by my mentor's breathtakingly
elegant battle style.
SootopolisCity_Text_DoYouKnowMonNames:
Hi, do you know the names of those
POKéMON fighting over there?
SootopolisCity_Text_DoesThisMakeYourFear:
Does seeing GROUDON and KYOGRE make
you think POKéMON are to be feared?

But that's not true.
POKéMON are really more…

…Why am I asking you this?
You already know.
SootopolisCity_Text_ExplainWaterfallGoTo:
If you have the RAIN BADGE, a POKéMON
that has learned that HM move can
force its way up waterfalls.

And where does one get the RAIN BADGE?
You know, don't you?

That's right! You have to beat
the SOOTOPOLIS GYM LEADER.

When you're all set to go, step through
that door.
SootopolisCity_Text_FearedWorstWhenPokem:
When that third POKéMON flew down,
I feared the worst.
SootopolisCity_Text_FlyingMonStoppedRamp:
That flying POKéMON came down from
the sky and stopped the rampaging
POKéMON…
SootopolisCity_Text_GiantPokemonSuddenly:
These giant POKéMON suddenly appeared
in the middle of the city!
And, I've never seen them before!

Why are they smashing into each
other like that?

Why can't they be friends, those
POKéMON?
SootopolisCity_Text_GiganticPokemonFight:
When two POKéMON that gigantic
are fighting that savagely, there's
not much that we can do.
SootopolisCity_Text_GiveYouThisBerryToo:
KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!
I really like it lots!
SootopolisCity_Text_GoRedAndBlueMon:
Go for it, red POKéMON!
Don't back off, blue POKéMON!
SootopolisCity_Text_GreenOneSettlesThing:
I was wondering which one would win,
the red one or the blue one, but, oh no,
it's the green one that settles things!
Talk about a huge turn of events!
SootopolisCity_Text_GroudonPleaseStop:
MAXIE: G… GROUDON…
Please! Stop what you're doing!
I know the extent of your power now!

If you keep going, all HOENN, not just
SOOTOPOLIS, will be utterly ruined!
SootopolisCity_Text_GymSign:
SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: JUAN

“The GYM LEADER with the beauty
of pure water!”
SootopolisCity_Text_HaventYouScaledSkyPi:
Haven't you scaled the SKY PILLAR
yet?

I'm sure that you can make it to
the top of the SKY PILLAR…
SootopolisCity_Text_HereWereAreHelpWalla:
Inside here you'll find someone named
WALLACE.

I think you have what's needed to
help him…
SootopolisCity_Text_InvolvedWithCrisisCo:
STEVEN: Those POKéMON fighting…
GROUDON… And KYOGRE…

The two super-ancient POKéMON
were awakened from a long sleep…

And now they are smashing each other
with their uncontrollable energy…

You being here now I'll take to mean
that you're prepared to become
involved in this crisis.

Well, then, there's someone that
I'd like you to meet.
SootopolisCity_Text_KnowWhatsNeededToHel:
STEVEN: I think you have what's
needed to help him…
SootopolisCity_Text_KyogreCalmDown:
ARCHIE: KYOGRE! What's wrong?!
Look over here! It's the RED ORB!
Calm down! KYOGRE!

It's no good!
It's not responding at all!
SootopolisCity_Text_LeadSuperiorTrainerT:
A person with a strong will and
superior talent…

A TRAINER who has knowledge and
experience of many kinds of POKéMON…

If such a person were to appear, I was
instructed by WALLACE to lead that
TRAINER to this CAVE.
SootopolisCity_Text_LikeSeasonBornIn:
If you're born in springtime, do you like
the spring, and if you're born in the
summer, do you like the summer?
SootopolisCity_Text_MaxieArchieLeft:
STEVEN: It looks like both MAXIE and
ARCHIE have gone away somewhere.

Perhaps they've gone to MT. PYRE to
return those ORBS…
SootopolisCity_Text_NameIsKiriHaveOneOfT:
My mommy and daddy named me that so
I would grow healthy and warmhearted.
That's what they wished.
You can have one of these.
SootopolisCity_Text_NeverBeenToSkyPillar:
I've never been there.
I wonder where it could be?
SootopolisCity_Text_NightSkyFavoriteScen:
A circle of a night sky framed by
the crater of a volcano…

And in that ring, stars flicker and
blink as if they were alive…
It's my favorite scenery.
SootopolisCity_Text_NoOrdinaryTourist:
Hm!
You've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?
You're no ordinary tourist.

But I suppose that doesn't make you
an extraordinary tourist, either.
SootopolisCity_Text_OhDoesntMatter: There's so much that I want to know…
SootopolisCity_Text_PhysicallyFitLivingH:
Diving in the sea. Climbing up and
down stairs all the time…

If you live in this town, you end up
getting physically fit.
SootopolisCity_Text_PrettyMonCameFromSky:
A pretty POKéMON came down from
the sky…
SootopolisCity_Text_SawLegendWithOwnEyes:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by
a colossal battle between POKéMON.

Well, I saw that happen with
my very own eyes!

Whoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!
SootopolisCity_Text_SeeingLegendWithOwnE:
There's an ancient legend that claims
the land and sea were shaped by
a colossal battle between POKéMON.

Well, I'm seeing that happen with
my very own eyes!

Whoa! I never expected to be
witness to something this huge!
SootopolisCity_Text_SoThatsRayquaza:
It's incredible how the two rampaging
POKéMON would flee from it in fear…
SootopolisCity_Text_SootopolisSkyBeautif:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in
the crater of a volcano.

If you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.
So, all you see is the sky in a circle.

VerdanturfTown_BattleTentLobby_Text_Expl:
Here at the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,
POKéMON are required to think and
battle by themselves.

Unlike in the wild, POKéMON that live
with people behave differently
depending on their nature.

There are offensive moves that inflict
direct damage on the foe.

There are defensive moves that are
used to prepare for enemy attacks or
used to heal HP and so on.

There are also other somewhat-odd
moves that may enfeeble the foes with
stat problems including poison and 
paralysis.

POKéMON will consider using moves in
these three categories.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
may prefer to attack no matter what.

Another POKéMON may prefer to protect
itself from any harm.

Yet another may enjoy vexing or
confounding its foes.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON
will have favorite moves that it is good
at using.

It may also dislike certain moves that
it has trouble using.

When not under command by its TRAINER,
a POKéMON may be unable to effectively
use certain moves.

A POKéMON is not good at using any
move that it dislikes.

If a POKéMON only knows moves that
do not match its nature, it will often
be unable to live up to its potential.

In the VERDANTURF BATTLE TENT,
there is one crucial rule that must
be obeyed.

TRAINERS are permitted only to switch
their POKéMON in and out.

TRAINERS are otherwise forbidden to
command their POKéMON.

The POKéMON are to behave according
to their nature and battle on their own.

You must put your trust in your
POKéMON and watch over them.

If you achieve the honor of beating
three TRAINERS in succession,
we will present you with a prize.

If you want to interrupt your
challenge, please save the game.

If you don't save before interrupting,
you will be disqualified.

Depending on its nature, a POKéMON may
start using moves that don't match its
nature when it is in trouble.

If a POKéMON begins behaving oddly
in a pinch, watch it carefully.

…Oops! Look at the time!
I kept you too long!

Thanks for hearing me out!
I want you to have this!
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ComeBa:
Oh. Come back when you want to
hear my story!
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidYou: I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!

I raise more than a hundred
POKéMON!

I'm very fussy when it comes to
POKéMON! I surely am!

Did you come visit to hear about
my POKéMON?
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidntC:
Did you come see me about my
POKéMON again?
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Explai:
Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the
BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.

Exchange that for a BICYCLE
free of charge!

Don't worry, my favorite FEAROW
will FLY me anywhere I need to go.
So, I have no need for a BICYCLE.
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Listen:
Let's all listen politely to other
TRAINERS!
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pikach:
My PIKACHU is twice as cute as
that one!
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Receiv:
{PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER
from the CHAIRMAN.
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SeelFa:
My SEEL is far more attractive.
By double, I would say.
VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Someon: If someone brags, brag right back!
VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopFerry:
Would you like to board
a SEAGALLOP ferry?
VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopRainbow: Ah, you have a RAINBOW PASS.

Would you like to board
a SEAGALLOP ferry?
VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopTriPass:
Would you like to board
a SEAGALLOP ferry?
VermilionCity_Text_BuildingOnThisLand:
I'm putting up a building on this
plot of land. I own it all.

My POKéMON is tamping the land
to lay the foundation.
VermilionCity_Text_CitySign:
VERMILION CITY
The Port of Exquisite Sunsets
VermilionCity_Text_DidYouSeeSSAnneInHarb:
Did you see the S.S. ANNE moored
in the harbor?
VermilionCity_Text_DoYouHaveATicket: Excuse me, do you have a ticket?
VermilionCity_Text_DontHaveNeededSSTicke:
{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} doesn't have the needed
S.S. TICKET.
You need a ticket to get aboard.
VermilionCity_Text_GrimerMultipliesInSlu:
We've heard GRIMER multiplies in
toxic sludge.
VermilionCity_Text_GymSign:
VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM
LEADER: LT. SURGE
The Lightning American!
VermilionCity_Text_MachopStompingLandFla: A MACHOP is stomping the land flat.
VermilionCity_Text_OhAuroraTicketTakeYou:
Oh! That's an AURORATICKET!
Now that is rare.

We'll be happy to take you to
BIRTH ISLAND anytime.
VermilionCity_Text_OhMysticTicketTakeYou:
Oh! That's a MYSTICTICKET!
Now that is rare.

We'll be happy to take you to
NAVEL ROCK anytime.
VermilionCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign:
POKéMON FAN CLUB
All POKéMON fans welcome!
VermilionCity_Text_Route2AideHasPackageF:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}!
How are you doing?
It's me, one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.
Did you meet the other AIDE?

He had a package from PROF. OAK
for you, {PLAYER}.

He said he'd look for you around
ROUTE 2, {PLAYER}.

If you're in the ROUTE 2 area,
please look for him.
VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneHasDepartedForY: So, the S.S. ANNE has departed?

She'll be back in VERMILION about
this time next year.
VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneVisitsOnceAYear:
The S.S. ANNE is a famous luxury
cruise ship.
It visits VERMILION once a year.
VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop10Departing:
Okay, everything's in order for you
to board a special ferry.

SEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 10 will be
departing immediately.
VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop12Departing:
Okay, everything's in order for you
to board a special ferry.

SEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 12 will be
departing immediately.
VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop7Departing:
SEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 7 will be
departing immediately.
VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxBlockingRoute1:
ROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a
sleeping POKéMON.

Detour through ROCK TUNNEL to
LAVENDER TOWN.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertIntro:
I didn't come all this way to lose now.
That possibility doesn't exist!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_AlbertPostBattle:
That means I lack the qualifications
to become the CHAMPION…
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarIntro:
I've made it this far a couple times,
but the last stretch is so long…
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_EdgarPostBattle:
You've made it this far. Keep the
momentum going and become the
CHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopeIntro:
This seemingly infinite and harsh road
lives up to its name of VICTORY.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_HopePostBattle:
You seem to have the potential for
becoming the CHAMPION.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnIntro:
I have nothing to say to anyone
that's come this far. Come on!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_KatelynnPostBattle:
Humph, go right on ahead.
See if I care.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro:
I wonder if you are good enough
for me?
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle:
I never wanted to lose to anybody,
especially to a younger kid…
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyIntro:
What is the VICTORY ROAD?
I'll tell you if you win!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_QuincyPostBattle:
Getting through here safely--that's
the final test for any TRAINER aiming
to become the POKéMON CHAMPION.

That's why it's called the VICTORY
ROAD.
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro:
I can see you're good.
Let me see exactly how good!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle:
Tch!
I concede, you are better than I!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyDefeat:
Wow!
{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyEntranceDefeat:
Wow!
{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyIntro:
I've gotten stronger since that last
time! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyNotGoingToLoseA: I bet you're surprised to see me here!

I made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!

{PLAYER}, losing to you that time
made me stronger!
But I'm not going to lose anymore!

I'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostBattle:
WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,
too… But one of these days, {PLAYER},
I'm going to catch up to you…
VictoryRoad_1F_Text_WallyPostEntranceBat:
WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,
{PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll
catch up to you!
VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro:
This here is VICTORY ROAD.
It's the final test for TRAINERS!
VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle:
If you get stuck, try moving some
boulders around.
VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro:
If you can get through here,
you can go meet the ELITE FOUR.
VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle:
I can beat you when it comes to
knowledge about POKéMON!
VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle:
Many TRAINERS give up their
challenge here and go home.
VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro:
Ah, so you wish to challenge the
ELITE FOUR?
VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle:
You earned the right to be on
VICTORY ROAD…
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaIntro:
TRAINERS live to seek stronger
opponents.
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle:
By fighting tough battles, you get
stronger.
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro:
I'll show you just how good you
are. Not!
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle:
You showed me just how good
I was…
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro: Only the chosen can pass here!
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle:
All TRAINERS here are headed to
the POKéMON LEAGUE.
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro: I heard rumors of a child prodigy.
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle:
So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI
of TEAM ROCKET?
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro:
RAY: Together, the two of us are
destined for greatness!
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons:
RAY: Together, the two of us are
striving for the pinnacle.

We need you to bring two POKéMON
into battle with us.
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle:
RAY: You've beaten us.
Greatness remains elusive…
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro:
TYRA: We're trying to become
champions together.
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons:
TYRA: You can't battle with us if
you have only one POKéMON.
VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle:
TYRA: You've taught me that power
can be infinite in shape and form.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HalleIntro:
Okay, no need to get your back up!
Relax, let's take it easy!
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_HallePostBattle:
But it's not all that different from
the path you've taken so far.

Try to enjoy things the rest of
the way!
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichelleIntro:
This isn't the goal. It's only a place
on the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MichellePostBattle:
You'll do fine, for sure!
Your POKéMON are all eager to go!
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellDefeat: I've never met anyone like you before.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellIntro:
My POKéMON are cosmically
awe inspiring!
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_MitchellPostBattle:
Even outside of battle, I sense
incredible power emanating from you
and your POKéMON.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelIntro:
The thought that I'm getting closer to
the POKéMON LEAGUE…
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_SamuelPostBattle:
The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant
again… What a letdown…
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonDefeat:
Your relationship is based on
solid trust.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonIntro:
To win your way through the POKéMON
LEAGUE, you need the trust of your
POKéMON.
VictoryRoad_B1F_Text_ShannonPostBattle:
By being together all the time, trust
grows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineDefeat: No signs of tiring at all!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolineIntro: You must be getting a little tired.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_CarolinePostBattle:
VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE
are long and grueling challenges.
Beware of fatigue!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneDefeat: Not rattled in the least bit!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DianneIntro:
The elite among the elite gather in
this cave.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_DiannePostBattle:
You do have guts! I like that!
Keep it going!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixIntro:
I've come this far, but the tension's
giving me awful stomach pain…
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_FelixPostBattle:
I can't help getting all tense knowing
that I'm nearing the POKéMON LEAGUE.
It's all I can do to feign calm.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JulieIntro:
You shouldn't get complacent just
because you have a lot of GYM BADGES.

There's always going to be someone
who's better than you!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_JuliePostBattle:
Gaze on your collected BADGES and
remember the TRAINERS you've faced.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenIntro:
I'd heard that there was a tough
little kid around. Do they mean you?
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_OwenPostBattle:
The rumors I heard, that tough little
kid is from PETALBURG CITY.
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoDefeat:
Better than my family?!
Is that possible?!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoIntro:
I trained together with my whole family,
every one of us!
I'm not losing to anyone!
VictoryRoad_B2F_Text_VitoPostBattle:
I was better than everyone in my
family. I've never lost before…

I've lost my confidence…
Maybe I'll go home…
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiIntro:
Rrrroar!
I'm working myself into a rage!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeIntro:
Your POKéMON will cower at the
crack of my whip!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeT:
The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of
any level obey without question.

It is evidence of your mastery as
a POKéMON TRAINER.

With it, you can challenge the
POKéMON LEAGUE.

Consider it a gift for your POKéMON
LEAGUE challenge.
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM26:
It is a powerful attack that causes
a massive tremor.

I made it when I ran the GYM here,
far too long ago…
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat:
Ha!
That was a truly intense fight.
You have won!

As proof, here is the EARTHBADGE!
{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro:
It shall be so until I can restore
TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.

But, you have found me again.
So be it.
This time, I'm not holding back!

Once more, you shall face
GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_RG_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle:
Having lost in this fashion, 
I can't face my followers.
I have betrayed their trust.

As of today, TEAM ROCKET is
finished forever!

As for myself, I shall dedicate
my life to training again.

Let us meet again someday!
Farewell!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Even I don't know the VIRIDIAN
LEADER's identity.

But one thing's certain.
This will be the toughest of all
the GYM LEADERS.

Also, I heard that the TRAINERS
here like GROUND-type POKéMON.
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory:
Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the
GYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonIntro:
POKéMON and I, we make wonderful
music together!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonPostBattle:
Do you know the identity of our
GYM LEADER?
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoIntro:
Karate is the ultimate form of
martial arts!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoPostBattle:
If my POKéMON were as good at
karate as I…
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelIntro:
VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a
long time.
But now, our LEADER is back!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelPostBattle:
You can go on to the POKéMON
LEAGUE only by defeating our GYM
LEADER!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiIntro:
I'm the KARATE KING!
Your fate rests with me!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiPostBattle:
The POKéMON LEAGUE?
You? Don't get cocky!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenIntro: The truly talented win with style.
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenPostBattle:
The LEADER will scold me for
losing this way…
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YouDoNotHaveSpace: You do not have space for this!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiIntro:
Heh!
You must be running out of steam
by now!
ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiPostBattle:
You'll need power to keep up with
our GYM LEADER.
ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun:
Coming up with nicknames is fun,
but it's not so easy to do.

Clever names are nice, but simple
names are easier to remember.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotio: I've got to buy some POTIONS.

You never know when your POKéMON
will need quick healing.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParce:
{PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL
from the POKéMON MART clerk.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe:
Okay, thanks! Please say hi to
PROF. OAK for me, too.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusin:
This shop does good business in
ANTIDOTES, I've heard.
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak:
His order came in.
Can I get you to take it to him?
ViridianCity_Mart_Text_YouCameFromPallet:
Hey!
You came from PALLET TOWN?
ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FeelF:
Please feel free to use that PC in
the corner.

The receptionist told me so.
It's so kind of her!
ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeC:
There's a POKéMON CENTER in every
town ahead.

They charge no money, so don't
be shy about healing POKéMON.

POKéMON CENTERS heal your tired,
hurt, or fainted POKéMON.

They make all POKéMON completely
healthy.
ViridianCity_School_Text_BlackboardLists:
The blackboard lists POKéMON
STATUS problems during battles.
ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn:
A burn reduces ATTACK power.
It also causes ongoing HP loss.

A burn remains after a battle.
Use BURN HEAL to cure a burn.
ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze:
A frozen POKéMON becomes
helplessly immobile.

It stays frozen even after the
battle ends.

Use ICE HEAL to thaw out the
suffering POKéMON.
ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysi:
Paralysis reduces SPEED and may
prevent the POKéMON from moving.

Paralysis remains after battles.
Use PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.
ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison:
When poisoned, a POKéMON's health
steadily drops.

Poison lingers after battles.
Use an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!
ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's
asleep.

POKéMON will stay asleep even
after battles.

Use AWAKENING to awaken one
from sleep.
ViridianCity_School_Text_HeyDontLookAtMy:
GIRL: Hey!
Don't look at my notes!
ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFirstPa:
POKé BALLS are used to catch
POKéMON.

Up to six POKéMON can be carried
in your party.

People who raise and battle
with POKéMON are called TRAINERS.
ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthP:
The ultimate goal for all POKéMON
TRAINERS is simple.

It is to defeat the top eight
POKéMON GYM LEADERS.
Do so to earn the right to face…

The ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON
LEAGUE!
ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookSecondP:
A healthy POKéMON may be hard to
catch, so weaken it first.

Poison, burn, or cause another
status problem to weaken it.
ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookThirdPa:
POKéMON TRAINERS seek others to
engage in POKéMON battles.

To TRAINERS, the taste of victory
is sweet, indeed.

Battles are constantly waged at
POKéMON GYMS everywhere.
ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadBlackboardC:
Be sure to read what's on the
blackboard carefully!
ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadWhichTopic: Which topic do you want to read?
ViridianCity_School_Text_TryingToMemoriz:
Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my
notes.
ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere:
Those POKé BALLS at your waist!
You have POKéMON, don't you?

It's great that you can carry and
use POKéMON anytime, anywhere.
ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBatt:
Catch POKéMON and expand your
collection.

The more you have, the easier it
is to battle.
ViridianCity_Text_CitySign:
VIRIDIAN CITY 
The Eternally Green Paradise
ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle:
CATERPIE has no poison,
but WEEDLE does.

Watch that your POKéMON aren't
stabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.
ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOcca:
I go shopping in PEWTER CITY
occasionally.

I have to take the winding trail in
VIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.
ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeY:
Oh, Grandpa!
Don't be so mean!

I'm so sorry.
He hasn't had his coffee yet.
ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLead: This POKéMON GYM is always closed.
I wonder who the LEADER is?
ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!

But I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…

Incidentally, is my old TEACHY TV
helping you?
ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP:
The battle moves of POKéMON are
limited by their POWER POINTS, PP.

To replenish PP, rest your tired
POKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.
ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow:
Wahaha!
It's my grandson on the show!

Since he's the one doing the
teaching, you're bound to learn.
ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!

Hm?
What is that red box you have?

Ah, so you're working on your
POKéDEX.

Then let me give you a word of
advice.

Whenever you catch a POKéMON,
the POKéDEX automatically updates
its data.

…You don't know how to catch
a POKéMON?

I suppose I had better show you
then!
ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTake:
There! Now tell me, that was
educational, was it not?
ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty:
I absolutely forbid you from
going through here!
ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV:
Hm… You're too busy to not even
have the time for TEACHY TV…

Time is money, and neither should
be ill spent…
ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpi:
You want to know about the two
kinds of caterpillar POKéMON?
ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics:
If there's something you don't
understand, watch that.

It will teach you about the basics
of being a POKéMON TRAINER.
ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and
that's what I need to get going!

But I made it too strong.
It gave me a headache…

Incidentally, are you filling your
POKéDEX?

At first, focus on weakening the
POKéMON before trying to catch it.
ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyIntro:
I might be little, but I won't like
it if you go easy on me!
ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle: I lost some of my allowance…
ViridianForest_Text_AvoidGrassyAreasWhen:
If your POKéMON are weak and you
want to avoid battles, stay away
from grassy areas!
ViridianForest_Text_CantCatchOwnedMons:
You can't catch a POKéMON that
belongs to someone else.

Throw POKé BALLS only at wild
POKéMON to catch them!
ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?
ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle:
BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.
They're a lot of fun!
ViridianForest_Text_ContactOakViaPCToRat:
Contact PROF. OAK via a PC to
get your POKéDEX evaluated!
ViridianForest_Text_DougDefeat:
Huh?
I ran out of POKéMON!
ViridianForest_Text_DougIntro:
Yo!
You can't jam out if you're a
POKéMON TRAINER!
ViridianForest_Text_DougPostBattle:
That totally stinks! I'm going to
catch some stronger ones!
ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBatt:
I came here with some friends to
catch us some BUG POKéMON!

They're all itching to get into
some POKéMON battles!
ViridianForest_Text_LeavingViridianFores:
LEAVING VIRIDIAN FOREST
PEWTER CITY AHEAD
ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls:
I was throwing POKé BALLS to
catch POKéMON, and I ran out.

That's why you can never have too
many POKé BALLS.
ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro:
Hey! You have POKéMON!
Come on!
Let's battle 'em!
ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle:
Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.
Another time, okay?
ViridianForest_Text_SammyDefeat:
I give!
You're good at this!
ViridianForest_Text_SammyIntro:
Hey, wait up!
What's the hurry? Why the rush?
ViridianForest_Text_SammyPostBattle:
Sometimes, you can find stuff on
the ground.

I'm looking for the stuff I
dropped. Can you help me?
ViridianForest_Text_UseAntidoteForPoison:
For poison, use ANTIDOTE!
Get it at POKéMON MARTS!
gBirchDexRatingText_AreYouCurious:
Are you curious about how your
POKéDEX is coming along?

Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough
POKéMON to make it worthwhile.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan10:

for POKéMON more carefully.

can only be caught there.

found using ROCK SMASH.

by trading with others.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan140:
I've heard of POKéMON that evolve
when they come to fully love their
TRAINERS.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan150:
I had no idea that there were so
many POKéMON species in the HOENN
region.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan160:

in large numbers like outbreaks.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan170:

the POKéMON of the HOENN region
by looking through your POKéDEX.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan180:

a POKéMON PROFESSOR, and a good
one, too!
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan190:

you're a real professional at this!
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan20:
I guess you're getting the hang
of it. But, it gets harder from here.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan200:
You're very close to completing
this POKéDEX.

gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan30:

certain areas.

gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan40:

but this is looking more like
a POKéDEX now.
gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan50:

gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan60:

gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan70:

gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan80:
This is going to be a fantastic
POKéDEX.

gBirchDexRatingText_LessThan90:

gControlsGuide_Text_AButton:
Used to confirm a choice, check
things, chat, and scroll text.
gControlsGuide_Text_BButton:
Used to exit, cancel a choice,
and cancel a mode.
gControlsGuide_Text_DPad:
Moves the main character.
Also used to choose various data
headings.
gControlsGuide_Text_Intro:
The various buttons will be explained in
the order of their importance.
gControlsGuide_Text_LRButtons:
If you need help playing the
game, or on how to do things,
press the L or R Button.
gControlsGuide_Text_SelectButton:
Used to shift items and to use
a registered item.
gControlsGuide_Text_StartButton:
Press this button to open the
MENU.
gOakSpeech_Text_AskPlayerGender:
Now tell me. Are you a boy?
Or are you a girl?
gOakSpeech_Text_IStudyPokemon:
For some people, POKéMON are pets.
Others use them for battling.
I study POKéMON as a profession.
gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide:
…is inhabited far and wide by
creatures called POKéMON.
gOakSpeech_Text_LetsGo:
Your very own POKéMON legend is
about to unfold!

A world of dreams and adventures
with POKéMON awaits! Let's go!
gOakSpeech_Text_RememberRivalsName:
That's right! I remember now!
His name is {RIVAL}!
gOakSpeech_Text_TellMeALittleAboutYourse:
But first, tell me a little about
yourself.
gOakSpeech_Text_WelcomeToTheWorld:
Hello, there!
Glad to meet you!
Welcome to the world of POKéMON!

People affectionately refer to me
as the POKéMON PROFESSOR.
gOakSpeech_Text_WhatWasHisName:
He's been your rival since you both
were babies.
gOakSpeech_Text_YourNameWhatIsIt:
Let's begin with your name.
What is it?
gOakSpeech_Text_YourRivalsNameWhatWasIt: Your rival's name, what was it now?
gPikachuIntro_Text_Page1:
In the world which you are about to
enter, you will embark on a grand
adventure with you as the hero.

Speak to people and check things
wherever you go, be it towns, roads,
or caves. Gather information and
hints from every source.
gPikachuIntro_Text_Page2:
New paths will open to you by helping
people in need, overcoming challenges,
and solving mysteries.

At times, you will be challenged by
others and attacked by wild creatures.
Be brave and keep pushing on.
gPikachuIntro_Text_Page3:
Through your adventure, we hope
that you will interact with all sorts
of people and achieve personal growth.
That is our biggest objective.

Press the A Button, and let your
adventure begin!
